chapters.title: Chapter 110 - I Dont Ask to Be the Most Wealthy, but the Most Incredible!
paragraphs: “Dad, Mum, I’m home!” Once he reached back home, Hong Dali threw his bag on the sofa and started shouting, “I broughtUnexpectedly! home! Mum, Mum!”

“Oh my, our little prodigal has returned home? Don’t shout so loud, we heard you already!” Lan Ruoxi rushed out, feeling funny and angry at the same time. She helped Hong Dali take off his jacket and asked, “Why are you so rushed, you’re like you are shouting at a ghost.”

“Heh heh, the short film that I just completed, I have brought it home for you and Dad to watch.” Hong Dali grinned and said, “It hasn’t been released yet—you will be watching it firsthand!” Saying so, he took out the thumb-drive from his pocket and handed it to his mother.

Lan Ruoxi laughed till she bent over. She stretched out a finger and tapped on his forehead. “The little rascal has grown up, you know to let your Dad and me view the good stuff first now?” Saying so, she turned around and shouted, “Hubby, come out and watch the film that our little prodigal shoot!”

“I have heard already, heh heh.” Hong Weiguo held his smoking pipe and walked out of the private room. As he walked, he said, “Look at how excited Dali is, this film must be quite good. Hurry, let me watch it.”
Then, Lan Ruoxi plugged the thumb drive into the port on the television. Very quickly, the happy sound ofUnexpectedly! sounded out from the television.
Two minutes later.

Lan Ruoxi laughed till she collapsed in Hong Weiguo arms and couldn’t catch her breath. “Hahaha, our little rascal can really mess about, this film is quite interesting indeed. Look at his expression, so foolish!”

Hong Weiguo laughed out loud too and said, “I didn’t know you could shoot a short film in such a manner, haha. Not bad indeed.” Saying so, he touched his chin. “Speaking of which, the attendants that Dali found are not bad too. What’s the name of this guy who is acting the antagonist?”
Hong Dali pulled on his hair, thought for a while, before finally shaking his head. “Er, speaking of which, I never asked his name before...”
Lan Ruoxi: “You little rascal, you’re still so careless, heh heh.”
My name is Li Yang, and my hobby since a young age is to run errands. Of course, compared to that, I prefer to be a lackey; that is my interest too. Now, my profession is also to be a lackey.

What’s bad about being a lackey? Every day, I follow besides Young Master, eat good stuff, and have money to spend. Especially as Young Master is quite caring towards us lackeys. Normally, when he is in class, we will tend to have more freedom, so we can happily go and flirt around or surf online as long as we are not too far away from Young Master.
After he finishes his class, we will just have to run some errands for him. Every day, we follow Young Master and walk around, and this caused our view of the world to increase too.

Don’t see how we don’t have any spouses now, in the past it was because we weren’t capable of getting one. Now, it’s because we are not willing to settle for average standards anymore! Those who want to be the wife of us lackeys, they must at least be pretty and rich, have smooth, long hair, a good figure and must be of a tender age!
A few days ago, there were a number of girls who showed interest in me. Unfortunately, they didn’t meet the standards. Sigh, speaking of which, their standards were not too bad actually.
But who am I? I’m the most capable lackey under Young Master! I’m always at the foremost whenever some errand needs to be run!
Don’t look down on the lackey profession. If it were someone else, they won’t even have the chance to become a lackey!

Young Master once said, since ancient times, there has never been any lackey who was so much lackey-y than I am! Look at that, look at that! Young Master’s words are really impressive, a normal person wouldn’t be able to say something like that!
Also, being a lackey isn’t as simple as just running errands, you have to be able to act too!

A few days ago when we were filmingUnexpectedly! with Young Master, guess what? I’m a qualified lackey, Young Master even let me act in an important role! Is that something an ordinary person can act out?

I was excited and was totally immersed in the acting. When I was lying on the floor, my pose was accurate and the expression seducing. If it were an ordinary guy, don’t expect for him to be able to act that out.
Of course, that brother of mine wasn’t bad either. That scene of him running in the sunset, his pose was perfect and the speed just nice, it was impressive indeed!
Young Madam said that Old Master and Madam will be viewing the film first, before releasing it online.

So, I was pondering. When the film is released, the download rate will definitely be very high. It may even be higher than that of Lady Nianwei’s concert. At the very least, I predict that it will be around that standard!
Being a lackey, I’m going to be a famous person in the future! Do you know what it means to be a famous person? I don’t ask to be the most wealthy, but the most incredible!
Chenhui Building, 9th floor, Cai Wei Entertainment Private Limited.

“Hello, is this the Chief Editor of So Cool video-sharing website? I’m from Cai Wei Entertainment, Lady Nianwei’s manager Zhang Cai.” Zhang Cai held her phone, her voice projecting a deep sense of confidence. “The first episode of our Young Master’sUnexpectedly! has been completed. May I know if it’s possible to arrange for a recommendation slot from your website?”
Confidence comes from strength. Ever since Li Nianwei’s concert, Zhang Cai was certain that the other person wouldn’t reject her request.

Indeed, a young female voice sounded off from the phone. “Miss Zhang Cai, please hold on a second, the Chief Editor said that he couldn’t easily make a decision now. We need to hold a short meeting of ten minutes or so.” Towards the end, she didn’t forget to comfort Zhang Cai. “Miss Zhang Cai, please rest your heart. The meeting is about how best we can give you our resources.”
“OK, sure.” Zhang Cai smiled and hung up.

“Sister Cai, what did they say?” Li Nianwei normally would stay in the office. Hong Dali especially arranged a room of about 100 square feet for her to use as a bedroom—Li Nianwei was quite satisfied with this. After all, staying here would prevent a lot of trouble.

Zhang Cai smiled and said, “It shouldn’t be much of a problem. Young Master’s products have quite a quite reputation on So Cool video-sharing website, so they won’t be unwilling to use their resources on us.”
Li Nianwei lightly nodded and said, “Sister Cai, I have seen a lot of prodigies before, but someone like Young Master, this is the first time.”

“Heh heh, this Young Master, he can really mess around.” Speaking of Hong Dali, Zhang Cai wanted to smile. She said, “He can really come up with all sorts of ideas, and every time, it wouldn’t fail to amaze me.”
Li Nianwei was quite agreeable with her. “That’s right. My concert, the soon to begin ‘I Am a Singer,’ thisUnexpectedly!, each of these ideas will tend to surprise everyone.”

Zhang Cai looked out of the window, staring at the night view, and said, “Yup. Actually, in the beginning, both of us were working for Young Master because of our future. But now, I have changed my mind. Nianwei, are you curious about what kind of incredible and unimaginable things Young Master will do in the future?”

Li Nianwei nodded and said, “Of course. But being curious is one aspect, I also enjoy seeing how Young Master carefreely squanders his money. At those times, he always tends to attract people to him.”
“Have you fallen for Young Master?” Zhang Cai smiled and asked.
“Speaking of which, I’m not too sure.” Li Nianwei caressed the Dark Gold Ear Ring on her ear and said, “But I do know, if he gets hurt, my heart will hurt.”

If it were an ordinary guy, don’t expect for him to be able to act that out.
Of course, that brother of mine wasn’t bad either.
That scene of him running in the sunset, his pose was perfect and the speed just nice, it was impressive indeed!
Young Madam said that Old Master and Madam will be viewing the film first, before releasing it online.
So, I was pondering.
When the film is released, the download rate will definitely be very high.
It may even be higher than that of Lady Nianwei’s concert.
At the very least, I predict that it will be around that standard!
Being a lackey, I’m going to be a famous person in the future!
Do you know what it means to be a famous person?
I don’t ask to be the most wealthy, but the most incredible!
Chenhui Building, 9th floor, Cai Wei Entertainment Private Limited.
“Hello, is this the Chief Editor of So Cool video-sharing website?
I’m from Cai Wei Entertainment, Lady Nianwei’s manager Zhang Cai.” Zhang Cai held her phone, her voice projecting a deep sense of confidence.
“The first episode of our Young Master’sUnexpectedly! has been completed.
May I know if it’s possible to arrange for a recommendation slot from your website?”
Confidence comes from strength.
Ever since Li Nianwei’s concert, Zhang Cai was certain that the other person wouldn’t reject her request.
Indeed, a young female voice sounded off from the phone.
“Miss Zhang Cai, please hold on a second, the Chief Editor said that he couldn’t easily make a decision now.
We need to hold a short meeting of ten minutes or so.” Towards the end, she didn’t forget to comfort Zhang Cai.
“Miss Zhang Cai, please rest your heart.
The meeting is about how best we can give you our resources.”
“OK, sure.” Zhang Cai smiled and hung up.
“Sister Cai, what did they say?” Li Nianwei normally would stay in the office.
Hong Dali especially arranged a room of about 100 square feet for her to use as a bedroom—Li Nianwei was quite satisfied with this.
After all, staying here would prevent a lot of trouble.
Zhang Cai smiled and said, “It shouldn’t be much of a problem.
Young Master’s products have quite a quite reputation on So Cool video-sharing website, so they won’t be unwilling to use their resources on us.”
Li Nianwei lightly nodded and said, “Sister Cai, I have seen a lot of prodigies before, but someone like Young Master, this is the first time.”
“Heh heh, this Young Master, he can really mess around.” Speaking of Hong Dali, Zhang Cai wanted to smile.
She said, “He can really come up with all sorts of ideas, and every time, it wouldn’t fail to amaze me.”
Li Nianwei was quite agreeable with her.
“That’s right.
My concert, the soon to begin ‘I Am a Singer,’ thisUnexpectedly!, each of these ideas will tend to surprise everyone.”
Zhang Cai looked out of the window, staring at the night view, and said, “Yup.
Actually, in the beginning, both of us were working for Young Master because of our future.
But now, I have changed my mind.
Nianwei, are you curious about what kind of incredible and unimaginable things Young Master will do in the future?”
Li Nianwei nodded and said, “Of course.
But being curious is one aspect, I also enjoy seeing how Young Master carefreely squanders his money.
At those times, he always tends to attract people to him.”
“Have you fallen for Young Master?” Zhang Cai smiled and asked.
“Speaking of which, I’m not too sure.” Li Nianwei caressed the Dark Gold Ear Ring on her ear and said, “But I do know, if he gets hurt, my heart will hurt.”

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - Respect for Young Master
paragraphs: Shanghai, Tianhai City, So Cool Information and Culture Development Private Limited headquarters, So Cool Building twelfth floor, inside a small meeting room.
“Director Wu, why did you gather us in such a rush for?”
“That’s right, the last time we had such an urgent meeting, that must have been two years ago?”
“Could it be that something good has fallen upon us again?”

In the meeting room, seven executives of So Cool Enterprise were gathered. The leader was dressed in a suit, his face flushed and his hair combed till they shone. He was the Director of So Cool Enterprise, Wu Youdao.

He was called Youdao1. In fact, he really lived up to his name. During the internet time that was still before broadband existed, he had already started to develop the video-sharing website. At that time, it was said to be throwing money in the river and could only see the ripples. But in less than two years, broadband was created, and So Cool video-sharing website rose to fame, taking over all of the Heavenly State and becoming the undisputed leader in the field.
The net-worth of So Cool video-sharing website also rose from the original 10.2 million yuan to today’s three billion yuan.
This all happened because of Wu Youdao’s extraordinary insight.
This time, since he gathered everyone together in the middle of the night, it was definitely not a small matter.
“Chief Editor Zheng, you can start.” Wu Youdao looked at the 40 plus years old middle-aged man with a Mediterranean hairstyle besides him. “You explain first, I will fill in the rest.”

“Yup, OK.” Chief Editor Zheng coughed, cleared his throat and said, “The reason for gathering everyone here is because Miss Zhang Cai from Cai Wei Entertainment called me just now. She said that their Young Master’s new filmUnexpectedly! has finished producing. We haven’t seen the original video yet, but what I want to say is that we must be fast if we want it.”
When he finished, the other people instantly started discussing.
“Young Master? The organizer of Miss Nianwei’s concert?”
“That superprodigal? His ideas are always not bad!”
“That’s true. Although he is a superprodigal, his scenes are always big. His film shouldn’t be too bad, we should definitely give him more resources!”

Cough cough.Chief Editor Zheng coughed and said, “The reason for gathering everyone is because, the total cost used for producing the film was... 100,000 yuan or so, and the duration of the film is ten minutes.”
This time, everyone was dumbfounded. “100,000 yuan? How can that be? How is it possible that the legendary Young Master only spent 100,000 yuan on a film?”
“Exactly, even the tips that he normally gives are also in thousands and tens of thousands, but he only spent 10,000 on this film!?”
“Ten minutes? Short film? Even the duration of a normal lengthy advertisement is also about this timing, isn’t it?”

“Let me explain.” Then, Wu Youdao who sat at the center position spoke. “To be honest with everyone, this film, we must definitely win it over. Even if it’s just out of respect for Miss Nianwei, we have to take it. The question is, how many resources should we give.”

Pausing for a while, Wu Youdao continued, “Regardless of the quality of this short film, there is a very crucial point—this film is the work of Young Master. Young Master is someone who can think of using 40 luxury cars as lighting and helped Miss Nianwei rise to fame in a single night. I believe that the creativity of this film won’t be bad.

“As everyone knows, there are already three to four video-sharing websites in our country now. If we don’t accept it, because of Young Master’s influence, I definitely believe that another website will be willing to throw in money themselves to buy over the copyright for the film, even if it’s just the right to air it.

“Therefore, even if the viewership rating is low, we must still have it. There are two sides to everything. Regardless of the quality of the film, just the background behind it is worth the effort. If we don’t take it, it will definitely affect the impression Young Master has of our company. Next time, even if he has any good videos, he will not think of us. Also, if another website broadcast his video, and it gets popular, we will be creating a strong rival for ourselves.”
After finishing these words, Wu Youdao took in a deep breath and asked, “What do you guys think?”
“That’s true.” Everyone nodded.
Wu Youdao was indeed worthy of his name, his words really made sense.

None of the people present here dared to offend the current Hong Dali. Even if they didn’t consider his family background, just the fact that he pushed Li Nianwei to fame, coupled with the fact that Li Nianwei was extremely loyal to him, they could not afford to offend him. Once they really offended him, with his carefree character, no one could tell the consequences. But one thing they could be sure was that, if they were enemies, no matter which rival website Li Nianwei supported, it would definitely brood severe consequences for So Cool video-sharing website.

“Director Wu, I suggest that we give them our best resources.” One of the executives said. “Whatever the case, the videos of Miss Nianwei’s concert caused the traffic of our website to rise by an entire 6%. Just for this, we should show them our respect.”

Another executive said, “I agree. This time, regardless of the quality of the film, we should give them our best treatment. Just consider it to be an exchange for their friendship—it will definitely be worth it. My suggestion is also to give our best treatment.”
To this extent, everyone eventually agreed.
Actually, this was how things worked most of the time. Nothing came free—all those seemingly free things came because of one’s strength.
“Then it’s settled, I shall give them a call now.” Director Wu instantly decided.
Chenhui Building, 9th floor, Cai Wei Entertainment.
“Hello, this is Zhang Cai here.” Zhang Cai held up her phone, smiled and said, “May I know the result of your company’s discussion?”

“We have decided.” Wu Youdao’s voice came from the other side. “My company has decided to give the best resources and recommendation slots that we have for Young Master’s film. Including the default search, front page recommendation, website links and such.”
Zhang Cai instantly said, “OK. I believe that your company will definitely not be disappointed. I shall send the film over now.”
Five minutes later, So Cool Information and Culture Development Private Limited headquarters, inside a small meeting room.

“This... this...” Looking at the laptop’s screen on the desk, everyone was astonished. After a brief moment of silence, everyone burst out in laughter. “This Young Master, I admire him, I really admire him, hahaha!”
“Hahahaha, this film will definitely become popular. If it doesn’t, I shall eat the display screen!”
“I shall eat the meeting room table!”
“I shall eat the entire So Cool building!”

Wu Youdao laughed loudly while slapping the table. “OK, no more rubbish talk. Hahahaha, our decision this time was definitely correct, hahaha. Now, immediately start uploading this film online. I want the normal, hahaha, standard definition and high definition, all three versions to be uploaded. Wait wait, ask the subtitle department to start doing the English subtitle now! I want it to be pushed as much as possible on our website! Put all the other videos aside! I want all the visitors to our website to seeUnexpectedly! first thing when they open up our webpage!”

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - Youve Got to Look at This
paragraphs: As a Senior Music Producer from the Ku Ge Music Company, Sheng Wenshi was really getting bored from being idle for the past few days.

Since he had listened to Li Nianwei’s concert, till this day, he wasn’t able to derive any excitement from listening to any other songs. In reality, he wished that the entire Ku Ge Music Software could be used solely to recommend Li Nianwei’s songs. Of course, that was impossible. Regardless of how great Li Nianwei’s songs were, he had to follow the rules.

At the first glimmer of dawn, a dazed Sheng Wenshi climbed out of bed. He switched on his tablet, logged in on his Xinhai Weipo account and posted a status, “What a boring past two days, does anyone have any good songs to recommend?” out of boredom. He then habitually browsed the “hot” topics.

“Hm? Unexpectedly!? First in the ‘hot’ topic rankings? What is it even? How is it that its score is so much higher than the second-ranked?” A puzzled Sheng Wenshi clicked on the link and realized that all those who contributed to the comments section had given strong praise.

“That good? So Cool video-sharing website?” At once, Sheng Wenshi followed the comments’ recommendations and clicked on the link to the So Cool video-sharing website. As the front page was displayed, he was shocked to the core. “No way? What the heck is this? ThisUnexpectedly! actually took half of the area of the web page!? Is the Chief Editor of So Cool crazy?”
However, there was a reason for everything. Otherwise, even if the website featured it in such a manner, it would at most be just a fish in the pan, dying out soon after.

Upon clicking on the link to theUnexpectedly! video webpage, the numbers displayed gave Sheng Wenshi a huge shock. “543,245 downloads!? 1,654,187 visitor volume!? There wasn’t even such a thing yesterday, and now it got so many downloads overnight?”

As the saying goes, there must be a reason behind every special event. If the reason for its huge popularity was due to the insane featuring, the downloads would highlight the issue. Users weren’t dumb—if the video were bad, no one would buy it.
“Is it really that great?” Seeing that, Sheng Wenshi had already gained some baseline confidence. He then took his time to click on the video link.
First, there was a gentle voice as an opener: “This program is—”
Next was a coarser male voice: “The Prodigal Alliance—” Followed by a young voice: “I want to squander, I want to splurge!”
It was followed by a gentle female voice: “And—”
It was still the previous male voice: “The Tang Medical Enterprise.” Next was a soft-spoken female voice saying, “Don’t stop taking the medication!”
Male dubbing: “Might Beverages.” This time it was the young voice intentionally making it sound coarser, continuing, “Miss Might Beverages for a day, and I feel uneasy all over!”
The gentle female voice concluded: “Sponsored and broadcasted.”

“Ptui—” Sheng Wenshi couldn’t hold it in as he fell onto his bed and started laughing hysterically. He continued watching while laughing and waited till he heard: “My entire life was one without regret, I remember the run by the sunset on that fateful day...” At this time, the mysterious back view of a figure wearing an ancient costume was running very slowly at the side, leaving only a lonely back view. Then a plump male lackey continued, “That was my lost youth, ah”

That enchanting “ah” sound, though being only a single word, was all-encompassing. It encompassed unwillingness, unhappiness, and various other emotions, especially the last note, which could directly strike a chord within one’s soul. Sheng Wenshi heard it once and couldn’t hold it in any longer, rolling onto his bed laughing hysterically. “Ahahahahaha, It’s so funny! This... this is too much, hahaha!”
Luckily, he had a healthy body. Otherwise, he would have laughed himself to death!

“Viral! This show has to get viral!” Sheng Wenshi’s eyes shone brightly. The video wasn’t a long one, but based on his acute senses of the entertainment industry, Sheng Wenshi was sure that the video would get viral!

“The ending should include the producer. This idea is great!” Sheng Wenshi’s eyes were locked onto the screen, as he continued, “Huge effect with just a small production. This video probably took less than 50,000 yuan to produce and yet invited such a wonderful reputation... Incredible!”
Sheng Wenshi was already aware that when this video was spread, the production team would definitely become severely sought after!

One should be aware that, just after one night, there had already been more than 500,000 downloads—and these required payments. This point was enough to indicate the video’s quality. The main actor, with that adorable disposition, made it especially unmatched!
Genius, this is ingenious!

In the entertainment business, this sort of team who can produce this kind of small production with a huge outreach—this was definitely a promising team, definitely a scarce resource in the entertainment business that everyone wanted to connect with. If one connected with them just as they were starting to boom, future negotiations would be easier.

Having thought that, Sheng Wenshi immediately took his cell phone and got ready to call his manager to help contact them. Even though the main business focus of Ku Ge was in music, that did not mean that in the future they wouldn’t produce such short films. Even using it as an advertisement would be good.
“Where is it, where is it?” Sheng Wenshi watched the entire film and finally found it. “Cai Wei Entertainment!? Li Nianwei’s company? Young Master!?”
“No wonder... no wonder...” Sheng Wenshi dropped his cell phone and smiled helplessly. “Genius, an absolute genius!”

If the layman did not have much of an idea about Cai Wei Entertainment, Sheng Wenshi wasn’t one of them, as he was one of the few who knew its internal happenings. He was the first to learn of the incident in which Ding Chengzhi obtained a sponsorship amount of 5,000,000 from Young Master.
Because of that, Ding Chengzhi had been bragging about it since.

“Cai Wei Entertainment, Young Master.” Sheng Wenshi let out a long sigh. “This time there is no other alternative. That Young Master’s weird temperament is well known among our small community. He definitely won’t be interested in that small money from accepting sponsorship or advertisements. It’s a pity to waste such a good advertising opportunity, sigh...”
He dazed for a long while, before decisively downloading the video into his tablet. Then, he kept spamming phone calls to his good friend, Ding Chengzhi.
The moment the line connected, Sheng Wenshi roared, “Old Ding, you’ve got to look at this!”
“What is it? You haven’t fully awoken yet?” Ding Chengzhi’s impatient voice sounded from the phone, as he continued, “Let me sleep for a while more...”
Sheng Wenshi kept shouting, “Let me tell you this. If you don’t hurry up, I guarantee you will regret it for your whole life! Your whole life!”

“What’s the hurry? Can’t you wait for a few minutes?” Ding Chengzhi was about to go back to sleep. In reality, in this period, producing the soundtrack for “The Gale Flash” made him really busy every day. He was genuinely tired.
“Not even for a few seconds!” Sheng Wenshi roared again. “Cai Wei Entertainment has released a new film, made by Young Master!”

He definitely won’t be interested in that small money from accepting sponsorship or advertisements.
It’s a pity to waste such a good advertising opportunity, sigh...”
He dazed for a long while, before decisively downloading the video into his tablet.
Then, he kept spamming phone calls to his good friend, Ding Chengzhi.
The moment the line connected, Sheng Wenshi roared, “Old Ding, you’ve got to look at this!”
“What is it?
You haven’t fully awoken yet?” Ding Chengzhi’s impatient voice sounded from the phone, as he continued, “Let me sleep for a while more...”
Sheng Wenshi kept shouting, “Let me tell you this.
If you don’t hurry up, I guarantee you will regret it for your whole life!
Your whole life!”
“What’s the hurry?
Can’t you wait for a few minutes?” Ding Chengzhi was about to go back to sleep.
In reality, in this period, producing the soundtrack for “The Gale Flash” made him really busy every day.
He was genuinely tired.
“Not even for a few seconds!” Sheng Wenshi roared again.
“Cai Wei Entertainment has released a new film, made by Young Master!”

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - Crazy... Everyone is Crazy...
paragraphs: “Young Master!” Hearing these two words, the half-conscious Ding Chengzhi came to his senses. He grabbed the phone and aggressively asked, “Where is the Young Master? What did the Young Master film? Quick, tell me. Quick!”
“Don’t get worked up!” Sheng Wenshi held the phone almost one meter away from him. “I can get worked up, but you’re not like this normally!”

Ding Chengzhi was affluent in the entertainment business and was well-known. Also, the entire Penghui Films had to listen to him. No one dared to step on him in the entertainment circle, and people recognized him wherever he went. There were more than ten people who had received pointers from him and became famous because he lent music to their movies.
It was certainly rare for a man of such status to appear so frightened.
The song that brought Tai Yajing—receiver of the Music Angel Award, the most influential music award in Asia—to fame was produced by him.
But for a man of such stature to be pale with shock, no one but Young Master Hong Dali could make it happen.

Ding Chengzhi anxiously said, “How can I not get worked up?! What kind of film is Young Master making? By which company? What is the genre? What stars are there in the film? Quick, tell me. I need to think of something else before it’s too late! Oh yes, is Li Nianwei involved?!”

Sheng Wenshi curiously asked, “Erm... Did you misunderstand something? Li Nianwei? Calm down. Old Ding, do you think that the Young Master is making his own shows to take business away from your company?
Hearing what his friend said, Ding Chengzhi sighed in relief. “That isn’t the case?”

He couldn’t help but worry. In actual fact, Ding Chengzhi always had a nagging feeling that as long as the Young Master was willing to invest money to make a movie, the movie would definitely do well.

It would be hard to estimate how much he could earn, but one thing was certain: if Hong Dali were going to do it, there would be no place for Penghui Films in the industry. After all, Hong Dali’s family had his back. It was a known fact that Hong Dali was the precious, sole son of Sangle’s CEO.
Even if Hong Dali were to spend tens of millions to make a film for fun, Ding Chengzhi would not be surprised.
Known to be a generous squanderer, in addition to having the most popular newcomer Li Nianwei on his side...
Ding Chengzhi could not imagine the impact. In any case, this would not be good news for other movie companies.

Sheng Wenshi laughed and said, “No. See how frightened you are. Young Master is producing a low-cost movie, and I don’t think the cost exceeded 50,000. We have no definite way to find out exactly how much Young Master has invested. As you know, Young Master has always squandered generously and freely.”

Ding Chengzhi wiped the cold sweat off his forehead. “That’s not too bad. Low-cost production. Do you know how scared I was? If Young Master intends to make a proper move, I would definitely join him without a second thought. I’m not disloyal, it’s just that Young Master is too powerful. There would be no other choice.”

Sheng Wenshi laughed. “Needless to say, if Young Master intends to invest in the music industry, Ku Ge will go out of business. Thankfully, he’s still ‘ young and playful. He may have good ideas, but his attention span is short. Otherwise, we would all have to sleep in the streets.”

There was no end to talking rubbish. Thus, Ding Chengzhi hurriedly changed the topic. “Don’t worry about sleeping in the streets yet. Tell me, where is the film being produced? Let me take a look. Quick, let me see it so I can think of how to handle it.”
Sheng Wenshi said, “Okay. Enough chatting. I need to report back as well. On the main page of So Cool, you can see the link there. It’s a short 10-minute film calledUnexpectedly!.”
“So Cool...” Ding Chengzhi promptly went to the webpage. “Um, I see it. Such a big recommendation! They must have invested in this...”
As he was speaking, Ding Chengzhi suddenly exclaimed, “Downloaded more than 700,000 times?! One million page views?!” Ding Chengzhi was in disbelief. “Old Cheng, his video was just uploaded, right?”
Sheng Wenshi was even more shocked. “Har? Seven hundred thousand downloads? The last I saw, it was only around 500,000 times!”
Ding Chengzhi slumped onto the bed. “Crazy... Everyone is crazy... I’m going crazy too...”

At the same time, just like them, countless people in the entertainment business were discussing Hong Dali’s film. When Cai Wei Entertainment was just set up, everyone was eagerly waiting to see what kind of blockbuster they would produce. But no one would have thought that their first film would be a low-budget, short film.
Everyone was in a state of shock.
A low-budget film engulfed the entire show business.
Countless people watched it, downloaded it, and discussed it delightedly.

Within a day, most people in the show business who forwarded or commented on Weipo contained the word “Unexpectedly,” and even more people had shared the link with the following comment—”I’m on my knees. I have completely conceded.”
It didn’t matter if they were sincere or pretending, or if they were just joining in on the fun. In any case, Cai Wei Entertainment andUnexpectedly! had become the hottest topic on Weipo.
So Cool Video’s President Wu Youdao1was truly rightful. He sat in his office, leisurely humming and sipping his tea, with a cigarette in his other hand.
His secretary walked into his room and saw him. “President Wu, I remember you quit smoking two years ago? Why are you in such a good mood today? This is not like you.”
Wu Youdao was in high spirits. “Haha, Xiao Wang, come here and sit down. Aiya, the weather is so good today. Haha, haha, um, when one is happy, the mood changes as well. Haha!”
Affected by his high spirits, his secretary got happy as well. “President Wu, shall I send you today’s report on website views?”
As Wu Youdao held up his teacup, a calmness expression was on his face. “Um, yes. The views have increased quite a bit.”
His secretary reported, “Yes. The views have increased by three-fold, and it’s still shooting up.”
Pu!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - Drink Might, Acquire Might
paragraphs: Tianjin, Fei Niao Films.

Director Ning Zhixing banged his hand on the table, slavering as he spoke, “Look at this, look at this. Others only produced a low-budget movie, with at most tens of thousands. A film just more than ten minutes. Look at how popular it is! Ah! We also make movies, but how come there’s such a big gap between us?!”
One of the staff mumbled, “Why don’t you look at the featured rank...”

“Featured rank?” Ning Zhixing moved a few steps forward and splattered saliva all over the staff’s face as he spoke, “That’s ability. Without ability, nobody would care about you. With the kind of script you produce, do you think anyone will feature your production?!”
The staff was stunned and speechless.
Shanghai, Tianhai City, Wind Pursuer Films.

“Difference, this is the difference!” Director Wang Haoqi sighed. “Small production, small indeed! The film we made using five million yuan the last time only earned eight million in the box office. Deducting all the expenses, we only made about a million. But look at this.” Wang Haoqi pointed at the screen of his laptop. “A small production that only cost tens of thousands was downloaded more than a million times! Ten cents per download—that will come up to more than a hundred thousand! How long has it been? How long?”
One of the staff softly replied, “About... about half a day...”

“Half a day! More than a million downloads in half a day, that’s a profit of fifty thousand! And it has just begun!” Wang Haoqi reluctantly said, “With the speed of things, there will be 20 million downloads a month at the least. That’s a profit of one million! An investment of 50,000 yuan in exchange for one million! That aside, think about the profit from advertisements.”
One of the staff replied, “About... about three million...”
“Three million? Not even close! More!” Wang Haoqi said, “From the popularity now, if he were willing to insert an advertisement, at least five million!
“Huge gap! This is really a huge gap!”

WhenUnexpectedly! came out, it kicked up a storm in the film entertainment industry. Almost all the film companies within the country held internal meetings. And there was only one topic up for discussion—Hong Dali’sUnexpectedly!.
But it was clear that the storm thatUnexpectedly! had brought about had just begun.
A man was talking to his girlfriend, who was mad at him. “Rou Rou, don’t be angry, okay? I’m sad when you get mad at me. Besides, staying angry is no good for your skin. Don’t be mad anymore.”
The woman appeared upset and pouted as she said, “How can I not be angry? You cannot even be bothered with me usually.”
The man held the woman’s hand carefully. “I know. How about we watch a movie together? I heard that there’s a very popular movie recently. Shall we go to watch it? Okay?”
The woman was slightly reluctant but agreed. “O... Okay...”
At the internet cafe, he turned on the computer, and the movie promptly started. “Unexpectedly, my principals are gone...”
The upset woman couldn’t hold back any longer and burst out laughing.Pu chi!
Five minutes later, they had their hands intertwined.
The woman said, “If I get kidnapped by the demon king, will you save me?”
The man laughed as he replied, “Yes. But I would definitely bring a better weapon. Better than the shiny toy sword in the show. Hehe.”
The woman said, “Um, the demon king would definitely be stronger. You have to be careful.”
The man said, “No matter how strong the demon king is, I will beat him.”
In the hospital, a man lifted his shirt for the doctor’s examination. “Doctor, take a look at my illness. Will you prescribe more medicine for me? Doctor, have I recovered?”
The doctor smiled as he said, “You have almost recovered. You will not need any more medicine.”
Upon hearing this, the man was upset and reluctant. “How can that be? How can I not need any medicine? Doctor, do you really think I have recovered?”
The doctor was stunned and perplexed by the man’s words. He hesitated and said, “Um, maybe not completely. Perhaps I should give you some medicine?”
Hearing what the doctor said, the man’s face brightened up. “That’s right. I want medicine from Tang Medical Enterprise!”
The old doctor was confused. “Erm... Why must it be Tang Medical Enterprise’s medicine?”
The man shook his head and said, “Tang Medical Enterprise, don’t stop taking the medication! Haven’t you heard of this, doctor? You’re too out of date!”

The old doctor picked up the pen and started writing a bunch of prescriptions, and a few minutes later, the man happily walked out of the consultation room. The old doctor shook his head. “It’s weird. There are actually people who would want to take so much medicine. Don’t stop taking the medication?”

Indeed, all the medicine that the old doctor prescribed was from Tang Medical Enterprise. When the patients took their medicine, they were elated and laughed as they collected their medicine. “Don’t stop taking the medication. This is good!”
Major supermarkets across the country.
A young man asked as he walked into the supermarket, “Boss, Do you have Might? Give me a carton!”
The boss looked vexed. “No... I don’t have any more of it... It’s true.”

The young person was flushed with agitation as he banged on the table. “Damn! You don’t even have Might? Why are you even open? I have been to five supermarkets, but all Might was sold out! I feel uneasy if I don’t drink Might every day. Don’t you know?”

The supermarket’s boss was on the verge of tears. “I don’t wish for this to happen either. I have just called to ask them to send six boxes here, but they were all sold out in half an hour. All of them said the same thing—they feel uneasy if they don’t drink Might every day. They even said that if they don’t drink Might, there’s no reason to work at all. Aside from that, is Might really so delicious?”
The young person rubbed his chin. “What do you know! Damn. Too many people feel the same. I’ll go ask at another supermarket.”
After the young person left.
The boss was perplexed. “Eh, that’s too weird. Is Might really so delicious?”
As he was thinking, another young person walked in. The boss asked, “You’re here. You want two bottles of Fierce Bull?”

The young person looked like he couldn’t care less. “Who still drinks Fierce Bull? Everyone drinks Might these days. Might is the right way to go! I feel uneasy if I don’t drink Might every day! Boss, please don’t tell me you don’t have it here either. I have asked several supermarkets, and they were all sold out. If you don’t have it here, I can only order it directly from the supplier!”
The boss looked depressed. “The problem is, I really don’t have stock. Could it be something else?”
The younger person pouted. “Can the others be compared to Might? Drink Might, acquire Might. This won’t do. I have to quickly ask the other supermarkets. Otherwise, I’ll feel uneasy!”

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - Chui Chui Is My Male Idol!
paragraphs: The whole world went crazy. However, people still underestimated the power of this low-budget, short filmUnexpectedly!.
The short film had tens of millions of views on earth, not to say in this parallel world where the level of entertainment shows was of a much lower standard.
Within just a few days, Unexpectedly! quickly rose to the top five of So Cool’s “Trending” and “No. of Downloads” lists.

After another three days, it became the fourth most downloaded show, then third, and finally, it reached the second position, leaving the other video programmes in the dust—be it other movies, music MVs, or gag clips.
And at this time, the video that held the most downloads belonged to a clip of Li Nianwei’s godly concert.
Everyone became stunned but could only remain helpless.
In reality, these achievements could no longer be attributed to pure luck. In the face of absolute skill and ability, all hard work and effort were rendered useless.

On the fourth day after release, Zhang Cai held a press conference, announcing that this was just the first episode ofUnexpectedly!. There would be a new episode broadcasted every two weeks, with a total of ten episodes. And thus, after the press conference, a new group appeared on the Internet, called the Refresh Party.
Their job every day was to refresh So Cool’s webpage every ten minutes.

All these caused Wu Youdao to have a heart attack, leading to him being admitted to Tianjing Medical University Second Hospital’s Special Care Unit due to the overexcitement he received when So Cool’s traffic surged to an unprecedented level.
However, it did not stop there. The smart ones in the world quickly responded with various actions.

Hui Teng Entertainment held a press conference on the fifth day, announcing that it would shoot a new martial arts TV series. The protagonist would use a long flashy sword as his weapon, and the protagonist’s martial arts would be named “Nine Suns Godly Fist.”
This caused the stock of Hui Teng Entertainment to soar by 20% overnight at the speed of a sports car.

In the face of the miraculousUnexpectedly!, Tianjing Entertainment Channel was naturally unwilling to lag behind, and at the same time learned the lesson from the previous time. This time, they did not dare to broadcast live and did not dare to call Hong Dali again.
They focused their attention on Zhang Cai, one of the heads of Cai Wei Entertainment.
Also, the ratings of Tianjing Entertainment Channel hit a new high, reaching an astonishing 5.7%.
For the past two days, Tianjing Satellite TV’s Director Huang had been pumping his chest.
He was frightened. But at the same time, he felt fortunate that he did not decline Hong Dali’s request to broadcast “I Am a Singer.”
Not considering others, justUnexpectedly!’s popularitymade Hong Dali someone that he could not offend.

Otherwise, as long as he wanted, the ratings of Tianjing Satellite TV would fall entirely. Now that he had a chance, as long as he communicated well with Manager Zhang Cai and included an advertisement for “I Am A Singer” during the broadcast ofUnexpectedly!, the ratings of Beijing Satellite TV would definitely skyrocket, easily breaking through the 5% mark.

So Cool Video’s webpage, under the comments section ofUnexpectedly, Dali Creates Miracles!.
“What the heck! The animation is so cool!”
“Listen to that cry full of emotion!”
“There is no need to say how good this video is, all I hope is to become his disciple!”
“Look at Chui Chui’s petite legs! That’s definitely my type!”
“Chui Chui is my male idol! No one is allowed to snatch him away from me!”

Liu Mingxin, who was standing in front of the window looking at the crowd in the campus, shook his head and smiled. “Hong Dali is a really interesting person to be able to come up with such an interesting video. Even I can’t help but want to see the episodes.”
Thinking up to here, Liu Mingxin could only sigh and feel that destiny was playing a fool out of him.
Otherwise, befriending such an interesting person would definitely not be a bad thing.

“Young Master, So Cool has just given us a call.” Zhang Cai reported with a smile while standing next to Hong Dali. “Currently, Unexpectedly!’s first episode has reached a total of 57 million views on So Cool’s website. The download count has reached an astonishing 22 million. We’re paid five cents for each download. That is to say, with just the download count, our net profit has reached 1.15 million.”
“Oh... that’s not bad.” After adjusting to a more comfortable position on Li Nianwei’s lap, he asked, “Is there anything else to report?”

“There is indeed something else.” Zhang Cai continued, “At present, many people have contacted us to slot in their advertisements. The advertising fees are basically around 300,000 to 400,000. A total of 16 companies have called me. Young Master, do you think we should...”
“Decline all of them.” Hong Dali did not even pause to think. “If there are too many advertisements, it will be irritating for the viewers. I hate advertisements when I watch shows.”

“Okay.” Zhang Cai sighed helplessly and thought in her heart, The potential advertisement earnings of 6.7 million are gone. This young master is really... In any case, he doesn’t lack money. It’s just that these companies are going to be disappointed.

After listening to Zhang Cai’s report, Hong Dali turned to ask Ling Xiaoyi, “Xiaoyi, has the construction for the village on the hill near Fengyuan Lake started? Also, has the cleaning started for the rubbish on Tianjing Mountain?”
These two things were critical to help spend the money needed to satisfy the Prodigal Mission requirements.

“Construction has started for the area near Fengyuan Lake.” Ling Xiaoyi continued, “Cleaning has also started for the Tianjing Mountain. It should soon finish according to Young Master’s requirements.”
“En, okay. I understand. Let me sleep for a while then.” After muttering a few sentences, Hong Dali went to sleep while the people around went to do what they were supposed to do.

However, although Hong Dali seemed to be sleeping on the surface, he was actually thinking about a problem.Why did the system not have any response even after Sister Cai reported thatUnexpectedly! has brought in a net profit of 1.15 million?

Hong Dali would never forget the case that happened when he just transmigrated. He went to the casino in an attempt to lose money but ended up winning instead. After winning, the squandering amount required by the system increased! Am I unable to earn money? Otherwise, the mission will not be completed?
Thinking up to here, Hong Dali hurriedly pulled out the system interface—
“Mission Squandered Value: 9,874,564 yuan.”

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - The System That Prohibits Gambling
paragraphs: Ai? What’s happening? Why did the value not get deducted even when I earned money?
Hong Dali decisively asked the system, “System, when I first transmigrated here, why did my squandering value turn negative even when I won money from the casino?”
System: “...” What the f*ck, it didn’t even bother to reply!

Hong Dali was confused. “Why does this system not answer my question? No, it must be clarified. Otherwise, if I accidentally do something wrong in the future and fail to complete the assigned mission, that will be disastrous.”

Thinking of this, Hong Dali began to analyze. “When I just transmigrated over, the system told me to spend 100,000 in four hours. En, this task was unfamiliar to me when I first came here and was really difficult. My first choice at that time was to spend it in the casino, but winning the gamble caused my squandering value to turn into the negative. Thus, there can only be two possibilities.

“One, the system prohibits gambling. Thinking about it carefully, if I collude with the casino owner or with a few gamblers, the money I win will not be counted, while the money lost will be deducted from the necessary squandering value. This makes it very easy to accomplish the mission. And it could also be said that I can continually spend money without worrying about it depleting since I can win it back. By doing so, I could easily earn attribute points and maybe even fill my attribute points to the brim in one day.

“Two, the system can detect the way I spend money, and gambling is obviously not one of the ways to spend money accepted by the system. The other methods I use to squander basically constitute in freely giving money to a person, such as tipping someone. Such spendings are usually of small amounts, so the system does not increase the amount I need to squander. However, gambling is a different story altogether. Take for example if I were to buy a lottery ticket. With my habit of spending, I would bet with at least tens of thousands. If I were to win a prize of up to a billion... wouldn’t my attribute points be deducted till it reaches zero?”

Thinking up to here, Hong Dali felt chilly. “Luckily, I don’t usually gamble. No, I can’t just let it slide. I must clarify this matter clearly. If not, this would just be like a land mine. If I were to buy a lottery ticket out of boredom someday and win the top prize, even if my attribute points will not be deducted till death, I would still become a vegetable.”

His fears were definitely not unjustifiable. Although the system did not explicitly state what would happen if his attribute points hit zero, any rational person would know that since attribute points were linked to one’s health, if one were to lose all attribute points, one would become disabled or even lose their own life. No one would remain calm at this.
“En, after I wake up later, I will go to the casino to give it a try. I must see if this applies to all types of gambling!” After making the decision, Hong Dali finally drifted to sleep.
An hour later.
“Ah, what a good sleep!” Hong Dali rubbed his eyes before sitting up and having a good stretch. “So boring...”

Seeing that he woke up, Li Nianwei, who had been acting as his pillow, smiled and said, “Young Master, Chu Zhongqin came by just now. However, after seeing that you were asleep, he decided not to disturb your rest and left.”
“Oh, that guy.” Hong Dali muttered. “Shouldn’t he be practicing singing, why is he looking for me?”

Speaking of which, the meeting with Chu Zhongqin happened a few days back. At that time, Chu Zhongqin was acting high and mighty in front of Hong Dali. However, Hong Dali did not say anything to him. He just threw the 400,000 jade bought at the auction and played Fetch with his Samoyed Xiao Xiao, thus getting a loyal follower just like that.
Li Nianwei snorted and said softly, “He asked if Young Master has the time to spare at night, to allow him to treat Young Master to dinner.”

“Dinner? That’s so boring.” Hong Dali twitched his nose. “I have nothing to do in the evening anyway. Ask him if he’s willing to go out for a small gamble with me. I will pay for the losses, and if we win, he can keep the money.”
“Alright, I will ask someone to call for him now.” Li Nianwei answered.
“Sister Nianwei, there’s no need for you to do such a chore.” Hong Dali pointed to one of his lackeys. “You there, go call Chu Zhongqin here. The errand tip will be 5000.”
The lackey thus started to run away happily...

Who was Hong Dali? He was the definition of a gifted prodigal. Could one even lose out when going out with him? After hearing that Hong Dali wanted to go out for a “small gamble,” and that he did not need to bear the losses but got to keep the winnings, Chu Zhongqin felt as if a free pie fell down from the sky. In less than half a minute, Chu Zhongqin, who had been practicing singing in a separate private room at Cai Wei Company, appeared in front of Hong Dali with a humble face before saying with a smile, “Young Master, did you call for me?”
“En,” Hong Dali said. “Let’s go and have a small gamble. It’s really boring here.”
“Alright, no problem!” Chu Zhongqin, who was a respected senior in front of outsiders, decisively opened the door faster than Hong Dali’s lackeys. “Young Master, please.”
“En, not bad!” Hong Dali snapped his fingers and called, “Tip him 10,000!”

Chu Zhongqin: “Thank you, Young Master!” He then thought in his heart, I have really made the right decision this time. In the past, participating in a program only earned me at most 200,000. Furthermore, it’s way more tiring. Just opening the door for young master earned me 10,000. Adding to the fact that I don’t have to bear the losses, how can I ever lose out if I were to follow young master? Playing with the young master can easily earn me thousands—how refreshing is that!

After going down, they met Tang Muxin who was playing badminton with the staff. Hearing that Hong Dali wanted to go out gambling again, she immediately rushed forward and asked, “Dali, what are you planning to do today? Why are you going to gamble again?”
“Ah, nothing much. I’m just going there to play for a while.” Hong Dali continued walking happily while humming a song at the same time. “Upsurge~~ Upsurge~~”
“Che, how big do you intend to gamble today?” Tang Muxin asked. “In my opinion, with your invincible luck, why not try the lottery? You will definitely win the biggest prize!”
After hearing that, Hong Dali felt cold sweat trickling down his forehead. “Absolutely not! Definitely!” After thinking for a while, he asked again, “Oh yeah, are there lottery scratch-tickets here?”

“Scratch-tickets? The one where you scratch the cover and see what you get inside?” Unexpectedly, Tang Muxin even knew of this. “Thinking about it, there really is. It would normally be available in shops near primary and high schools.”
“Let’s go play lottery scratch-tickets then, hehe.” Hong Dali laughed. “This thing seems to be very fun and interesting.”

Chu Zhongqin, who was walking in front, suddenly became awkward and nearly burst into tears—he was, after all, a well-known male singer in the Heavenly State, a respectable senior! Being Young Master’s lackey could still be justifiable, but for him to go to a convenience store outside a primary school to play lottery scratch-tickets? If the paparazzi knew of this, he would no longer have the face to stay in the entertainment industry in the future!
Thinking up to here, Chu Zhongqin rushed to ask, “About that, Young Master, is it alright if I request something?”
“En, say it. What is it?” Hong Dali replied.
“Can I go get a change?” Chu Zhongqin asked. “I’m scared that I will be caught by the paparazzi...”
“Go then.” Hong Dali waved his hands. “Two minutes.”
“Alright!”
Thus, after two minutes, a wrapped dumpling-like Chu Zhongqin was presented in front of Hong Dali. “Young Master, I’m ready!”

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - I Can Only Help You Till Here...
paragraphs: Looking at Chu Zhongqin’s appearance, Hong Dali almost couldn’t breathe. “You... we are going to the streets to have fun, not to Africa to engage in terrorist attacks...”

“I... I know...” Chu Zhongqin was also helpless. “But I’m afraid that if I got caught by reporters, and become surrounded by them, we will be unable to leave then. Furthermore, isn’t it safer this way?”
“En, that’s also true.” Hong Dali snapped his fingers and directed his lackeys. “You guys cooperate too!”
Tang Muxin: “...”

Thus, the three Prayer Angels opened the way, while the Soaring Angel followed behind. The group then went to the nearest supermarket in the west of Four Loops located inside Tianjing West Four Loops Experimental Primary School. When the supermarket owner saw the group of people with their heads fully clothed, he raised his hands decisively. “Big Brother, don’t kill me! I surrender! Take whatever you need from the store!”
Screams flooded the supermarket.
Tang Muxin: “...”
Hong Dali, who had his head fully clothed, stepped forward and slammed the table. “Do you have lottery tickets here?!”
“Yes! Yes, we have them!” The boss urgently took out a paper box and continued, “All our lottery tickets are inside. Big Brother, you can take however much you need!”
“Tip him!” Hong Dali said without a second thought. “5000!”
One of the lackeys following behind stepped forward and took out a stack of cash from his pocket and, after counting properly, pushed the cash into the boss’ hands. “Take it!”
“Ai? Ai?!” The boss was dumbfounded.Are robbers so charitable recently?
Hong Dali did not care about him and took out the lottery tickets from the box. “Quickly, find if we won any prizes!”
The others laughed and started to scratch the lottery tickets. After a short while, one of the lackeys voiced out: “Young Master, I found a winning one. 100!”
“Tip him!” Hong Dali decisively called.

The lackey directly rushed to the boss and pushed the winning lottery ticket into the hands of the boss, taking back a piece of 100 yuan from the boss. “Look, I’m just claiming my prize. I’m not stealing your money!” He then stuffed his winnings into his pocket and continued to scrape.

Hong Dali seemed to be just wasting time, but in fact, he had been secretly observing the system panel, and sure enough, with the lackey’s winning, abeepsound could be heard from the System. The Current Squandering Value dropped from 9,984,594 yuan to 9,984,494 yuan, a decrease of 100 yuan!

His whole back was filled with cold sweat. Hong Dali’s heart started thumping heavily. “As expected. Any other methods of earning money are accepted by the System except gambling. If I were to earn money from any methods related to gambling, such as lottery tickets, I will be in for trouble. Luckily, I used lottery tickets to test it out. If I had gone to gamble and won 5 million in a go, then I would have lost tens of attribute points!”
At this time, Tang Muxin smiled and ran over again. “Boss, I won one worth 300!”
The boss counted three pieces of 100 yuan calmly and handed it to Tang Muxin.
Abeepsound could be heard, and the original 9,984,494 yuan dropped to 9,984,194 yuan!
Hong Dali sighed in relief. Luckily, lottery tickets did not give out large prizes.

Everyone was scratching lottery tickets at the side when the boss suddenly shouted, “I remember! I wondered why your voice sounded so familiar!” He said while rushing to tear off the scarf on Hong Dali’s face. Sure enough, the person behind the scarf was the idol in his heart. He then excitedly hugged Hong Dali’s thighs, screaming, “You’re Chui Chui! You’re my favorite Chui Chui!”
Hong Dali: “...”

The surrounding lackeys dragged the supermarket owner out of the store. Unfortunately, after the customers heard that Chui Chui had appeared, those originally scared and crouching in the corner instantly rushed toward Hong Dali and held onto him without the slightest intention to let go, while screaming loudly: “Chui Chui, my idol! Give me your signature, please!” “Chui Chui, I really like you!” “Oh my god, I actually saw Chui Chui in reality, I’m so happy! Ah!” “Chui Chui, I drink Might beverages every day! Three bottles a day!”

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - I Can See That Your Bones Are Special
paragraphs: On the car.
Hong Dali asked, “Chu Zhongqin wouldn’t have been beaten to death right...”
Tang Muxin replied, “He should... should be fine...”

Hong Dali decisively ordered his manpower. “Call the car in front to go back and see if they can pick him up. Hopefully, he doesn’t get beaten—he is, after all, a big star, and has just saved us now.”
Twenty minutes later.
Chu Zhongqin, who had his clothes torn apart, burst out in tears on the car. He grabbed Hong Dali’s sleeves and began to cry. “Young Master, pity me. My wallet, phone, and ID card are all gone...”
“Tip him!” He had, after all, saved him once, and Hong Dali was not stingy at all. “I will not let your efforts go unrewarded. 1,000,000!”

“Thank you, young master!” After hearing the amount, Chu Zhongqin instantly felt as if his waist no longer hurt, and his legs were no longer sore. His felt as if his whole body was filled with energy. The previous beating was simply too worth it!

Chu Zhongqin was a veteran star in the industry. However, veteran stars and famous stars are different. Although his status in the industry was not low, it did not mean that it was easy for him to earn money—with his age, appearance fee in a show would usually only amount up to a hundred thousand, and sometimes, he would not even get any. In reality, even though he dressed and looked extravagantly, he was, in fact, very poor. Although he was not poor to the point where he just owned a house and a car, he was not in the ranks of the industry’s famous artists.
With the 1 million previously, coupled with the appearance fee for this episode of “I Am a Singer,” Chu Zhongqin’s earnings totaled up to 2 million—a considerably large sum of money.

After parking the car, Hong Dali called his lackeys to take Chu Zhongqin to change to a suit. When he came back into the car, he recovered his fashion style. Of course, his nose and face would remain swollen for a while.

Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “Let’s move out! To the casino!” While speaking, he did not forget to comfort Chu Zhongqin. “When you go up later, act exuberant. Even if your skills don’t make it, act as if you’re the god of gamblers. Don’t make me lose face, the winnings will remain yours!”

“No problem, I will guarantee that the mission will be accomplished!” Following that, Chu Zhongqin flipped his hair and even put on a pair of sunglasses. After seeing this, Hong Dali gave him a thumbs up. “Handsome!” It had to be admitted that after the old guy dressed up, he did look powerful and of high stature.

“Being Young Master’s follower, how can I lose face for Young Master.” Chu Zhongqin, who was defeated by Hong Dali’s assault using money previously, became a humble and loyal follower comparable to Hong Dali’s nine lackeys. “Whatever Young Master asks for, I will definitely do it, hehe.”
In Chu Zhongqin’s eyes, Hong Dali was no different from the God of Wealth in the heavens. To put it simply, one would definitely not lose out following him.
“En, alright!” Hong Dali nodded his head in agreement, before looking out of the window. “We are here, let’s go.”
Debora Casino.
The previous time he was here, Hong Dali was still a newbie that had just transmigrated. This time was definitely going to be different.

The three male lackeys in front opened a path with menacing looks. Wearing a black windbreaker, with a hat on his head, a white scarf around his neck, a cigarette in his mouth and sunglasses on, Chu Zhongqin walked in composedly while glancing around looking like a big boss.

Hong Dali brought Tang Muxin in walking swaggeringly, while each holding a dog in their hand. Hong Dali’s Samoyed Xiao Xiao even had the 400,000 jade in its mouth. In Tang Muxin’s was the Chow Chow Xiao Xiaobai. If one were to see them from afar, one would even think that she was holding a panda. When passing by children saw it, they even wanted to run over to take a photo but were held back by their parents.

Behind were the six female lackeys, led by Ling Xiaoyi, with the rest following her. They were all dressed in black leather jackets, short skirts, and stockings while wearing black high heels. Sounds of people swallowing their saliva could be heard wherever they walked past.
After entering Deborah Casino, a bell boy immediately went forward when he saw Hong Dali and greeted politely. “Young Master Dali, you’re here. Quickly, do head inside!”
“Tip him!” Hong Dali waved his hand. “1000.”

The lackey on the side immediately took out a bunch of banknotes from his pocket and counted ten pieces of 100 yuan bills. “Hold it. Remember, follow whatever Young Master says. If Young Master asks you not to do something, don’t do it. If he asks you to do something, then do it. Do you understand?”
“Yes! Yes!” After receiving the money, the bell boy bowed. “Young Master Dali, are you going to the room from the previous time?”

“Okay!” Being familiar with the place this time around, Hong Dali walked straight towards the poker room. The bell boy in front cleared the path while shouting, “Brothers, Young Master Dali is here! Come out to greet him!”
After hearing the call, all Deborah Casino’s waiters ran out and stood in two rows. When they saw Hong Dali, they shouted in unison: “Greetings, Young Master Dali!”
“Tip them!” Hong Dali once again waved his hand. “500 per person!”

Once again, the male lackey counted the bills and gave each person 500. After following Hong Dali for so long, he had grown better at the job. In the past, he would have needed to rush to the nearest ATM to withdraw money. However, this time around, he had asked for special permission from Ling Xiaoyi to bring along 100,000 wherever he went. He had placed 20,000 on each of his side pockets, 10,000 on each of his back pockets, and held another 20,000 on his hands. Whenever Hong Dali called him to tip someone, he would whip out the bills from his pockets or arms, which made him feel very accomplished.
Entering the same VIP room as the last time, Hong Dali took in a deep breath.
Still the same familiar room, the same smell...

Currently, there were only five people in the room. Excluding the dealer, there were four people playing poker. They were all fresh faces that Hong Dali had never seen before. However, when they saw Hong Dali, three people stood up while smiling at Hong Dali and said, “Aiyo, Young Master Dali is here.”

These three were all in their forties. They were all wearing suits, with one wearing gold glasses, one with a big belly, and one having acne rosacea. Hong Dali, however, was not concerned about them. At this time, his attention was completely attracted by the young man who did not stand up the whole time.

The young man seemed to be only twenty-five or -six years old and was dressed in a set of fitting clothes. Although one couldn’t deduce the brand, it was definitely not cheap. He had a pair of eyebrows shaped like a sword, thin lips, and a red birthmark in the middle of his forehead, which looked like the third eye of Erlang God in mythology.

Everyone else stood up and rushed to greet Hong Dali. This young man, on the other hand, was sitting casually at the table instead. From time to time, he would grab a peanut and throw it into his mouth.

At first glance, this person was definitely not simple. Hong Dali first nodded his head to return greetings to the other three. Then, he smiled while greeting. “This brother here, may I know how to address you? I can see that your bones are special, and there is even a light shining from the sky. You’re definitely not a simple person!”

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - Fight the Landlord
paragraphs: After hearing what Hong Dali said, the youth laughed and said, “Haha, it seems your character is the same as inUnexpectedly!. Your way of speech is really interesting.” The youth then reached out his hands. “I’m Mu Zixiao. This is my first time meeting you, but I hope that you can take care of me.”
Hong Dali twitched his nose before reaching out his hands for a handshake. He then smiled and said, “Nice to meet you. Are you here to play cards?”
“En.” Mu Zixiao shrugged his shoulders. “Let’s play two rounds?”
Hong Dali glanced around before shaking his head. “Poker is too boring. Let’s switch to something more exciting!”
“Oh?” Mu Zixiao laughed and asked, “What do you want to play then?”
“Let’s play something simple!” Hong Dali sucked in a deep breath. “Let’s play Fight the Landlord!”
After hearing this, everyone’s jaws dropped.
Tang Muxin hugged her tummy and laughed, while the cigarette in Chu Zhongqin’s mouth dropped to the ground.
Coming to such a high profiled place with high standards, no matter how one looked at it, playing Fight the Landlord seemed out of place.

However, what they did not know was that Hong Dali wanted this effect—Fight the Landlord was a very fast-paced game. Three Ones, Straight Flush, Bomb, and one would have won. This way, it was much faster and easier to verify whether the system deducted his Squandering Value when gambling.

The others, however, were unaware of what Hong Dali was thinking. Mu Zixiao stared in bewilderment and even forgot to put the peanut he was holding into his mouth. “Did I hear wrongly? You want to play Fight the Landlord?” Still seeking verification, looking left and right, he asked again, “At this place?”
“Yeah, Fight the Landlord is much more fun to play than Poker. What about it, are you in?” Hong Dali nodded his head. “Let’s bet with 10,000 chips per card, okay?”
“Alright, whatever you say!”

Disregarding others, as the only son of Mu Feng, the president of Weihai Network, who was comparable to Hong Dali’s family, Mu Zixiao was naturally aware of the happenings of the elites in the capital.
That included Hong Dali’s character, the publicly known legend prodigal of Tianjing.

Mu Zixiao was very clever. Although he had no contact with Hong Dali until now, there was a saying that one should know the enemy and know oneself, and then one could fight a hundred battles with no danger of defeat. Before he came, he knew at least one thing through inquisition—Hong Dali’s luck was heaven-defying. Therefore, Mu Zixiao concluded that no matter what happened, he definitely did not want to be in conflict with Hong Dali, even if his family’s business was in a great competition with Hong Dali family’s Sangle.

After all, when faced with a powerful foe, one would still be able to know his strengths and the extent of his abilities, and from there, craft out a plan to deal with him, such as Turkey Software’s Liu Mingxin. However, when it came to a person such as Hong Dali, it was no exaggeration to say that there was no limit to his abilities because one would never know when his luck would come to his aid, resulting in a devastating defeat.

Perhaps one would have crafted out a lot of plans to deal with him, and each of which was very detailed, with many backup plans. However, in the end, one would helplessly find that the other party did not even put your plans in his eyes. It was very much possible that due to bad diarrhea, he managed to avoid an assassination attempt; or it was also very much possible that he had nothing to do, went to buy stocks and accidentally, the value of the stocks doubled in just a few days.

Thus, from the time he came to Tianjing, Mu Zixiao had pretty much spent all his time in the casino, finding out information on Hong Dali. And the final conclusion he got was that all kind of strengths and abilities were unable to deal with Hong Dali’s undefeatable luck—last time, there was a god of gamblers that went out all out with Hong Dali, but still lost a great amount of money. The reason was that the god of gamblers thought that it was a sure-win situation when he found out he had three Kings, only to find out that Hong Dali had three Aces...
Since the purpose was to find out Hong Dali’s true abilities, Mu Zixiao really went all out today. “Who else wants to play?”

At this time, the three who stood up to greet Hong Dali looked at each other. Finally, the man wearing gold glasses came forward. “I have played Fight the Landlord a few times. I’m in.” He was being modest. In reality, since he liked to gamble, he would frequently play Fight the Landlord when bored.
Hong Dali pushed Chu Zhongqin forward. “God of gamblers, go!”
“Him?” Mu Zisu stood stunned for a while. “You’re not playing?”

“Ah, when I was surrounded by fans just now, he helped me to solve the problem. Thus, I told him that if he won today, he would get to keep all of it. If he lost, I would pay for him. So there’s not much of a problem, it’s the same.” Hong Dali said with a grin.
“Oh, it’s fine then.” Mu Zixiao shrugged his shoulders indifferently. “Hehe, I didn’t pay attention just now. Mr. Chu Zhongqin is also here. Hello.”
“Hello, hello.” Chu Zhongqin puffed on his cigar once again and said, “Let’s get started.”
And thus, the first round of Fight the Landlord began.
