chapters.title: Chapter 120 - Easts Mingxin, Wests Zixiao, Souths Yifeng, Norths Dali
paragraphs: “Four Twos with two Kings!”
Everyone’s eyeballs dropped when Hong Dali threw the cards on the table.

Chu Zhongqin almost cried when he saw the six cards lying on the table. That was actually two bombs. Adding on to the previous two bombs, each person had to pay him 480,000! However, after Hong Dali threw them together, it became 120,000 per person...

While he was crying without tears, the man with golden glasses and Mu Zixiao looked at each other and immediately pushed out the chips. “This is 120,000. Please keep it well, Young Master Dali!” Now that the money had been given, it was too late even if one were to regret!
Tang Muxin angrily reached her hands toward Hong Dali’s face and pinched him. “Are you stupid? How could you waste such good cards!”
“Aiaiai, lighter! Lighter!” Hong Dali voiced. “I just wanted to end the game faster...”
“You’re angering me to death! We’re not playing this anymore!” Tang Muxin pouted. “Is there even anyone that play cards like you?”

Her words made Hong Dali happy. What she said was precisely Hong Dali’s intention. If they were to continue winning like that, not only would the others start to be angry over their loss, his Great Prodigal System might have even deduct millions out of his Squandered Value—Hong Dali was not stupid, the one sitting opposite him was a rich family’s young master just like him, and losing one or two million was something that didn’t matter much. However, this was not the case for himself. If he were to be unable to complete the mission, the consequences might be disastrous!

At present, it seemed that the Great Prodigal System did not encourage gambling—it was almost impossible to lose with his enormous luck. Furthermore, after winning, the System would deduct the amount he had squandered till the point where his health attribute dropped to zero, resulting in him dropping dead. It was possible for him to lose. If he played small like what he was doing now, losing several million was still acceptable. However, if he were to gamble big and lose tens of millions in one go, his family might get angry at him and choose not to give him more money, causing him to land in trouble.
Alright, thou finally understood. Even if thou were to be beaten to death, thou will still not go to the casino! Not just the casino, but anything related to gambling, thou shall not touch!
While Hong Dali was immersed in his thoughts, Mu Zixiao was trembling with fear after what he had experienced.

Before he came, he expected Hong’s luck to be very high, but he did not expect it to reach this level. He silently thought: No, I must stay away from him from now on. Fortunately, I was not impulsive and maintained my neutral stand. My relationship with him can neither be considered good nor bad. It was fine that the one surnamed Zhao made me test waters, but how could he make me face such a monster! How can I even compete with him? We played a total of five rounds of Fight the Landlord, but I didn’t win even a single time!
After thinking about it, Mu Zixiao felt a bit traumatized.

Sure enough, in the face of Hong Dali’s undefeatable luck, all strengths and abilities were useless. Mu Zixiao was recognized as an outstanding talent among the younger generation. The phrase East’s Mingxin, West’s Zixiao was used to describe himself and Liu Mingxin of the Liu family. There was also a young man named Liang Yifeng in the south, who was also very influential and popular, with rumors surrounding himself being heard every day. Today, he could be in Heavenly State, only to find out that he spent a night with a female star in Europa the next. He was the most recognized playboy, flying around the world to chase after girls.

Now that Hong Dali had appeared, they could really call themselves East’s Mingxin, West’s Zixiao, South’s Yifeng, North’s Dali. The four of them could even sit down together to play Mahjong. However, if they were to do so, the winner would definitely be Hong Dali. This was something Mu Zixiao was sure of.

But even though he was thinking so in his heart, Mu Zixiao was actually feeling very conflicted.Then what relationship should I have with this guy? Kill him directly now by stabbing him to death? With my strength, I’m not afraid of those lackeys, but if I were to do so, our families would definitely treat each other as arch enemies from now on. The most troublesome thing is that I might ultimately still fail to kill him. Treat him as a friend? The Hong, Liu, and Mu families have too many overlapping businesses. The world of business is like a battlefield, it would definitely not be easy to become friends. Treat him as a stranger and pretend not to know him? But this guy’s luck is really shocking.

After thinking about it, Mu Zixiao finally decided to continue observing for a while.But this Hong Dali definitely is a prodigal. Playing like that with such good cards just now, it seems that the art of squandering has become ingrained in his bones. Thinking about it, with Hong Dali’s behavior, the Hong family will most likely fall in his hands. En, this should be true. I heard that in a charity auction held two days ago, Hong Dali bought a lot of random things. He should have never thought about starting a proper business to make money. Thinking about it like that, he doesn’t seem to be much of a competitor.

The world of business was like a battlefield, it had always been the survival of the fittest—especially among these three families. With one family’s expansion of business, the other two would definitely shrink. Thus, avoiding being hostile to each other was very difficult.

It was lucky that Mu Zixiao and Liu Mingxin had the same mindset—only when one who knows his enemies well can one win every battle. When one has not completely figured out his opponent, one should not act immediately, or it would alert the enemy, and the ending would definitely not be good.
Let’s decide after further observation.Thinking up to here, Mu Zixiao decisively thought.
“Ah, I’m tired.” After confirming the rules of the System, Hong Dali would naturally not stay in the casino. “Time to go home to sleep. Tomorrow’s the weekend, let’s think of where to play tomorrow!”
After hearing Hong Dali said he no longer wanted to play, Mu Zixiao and the man with golden glasses sighed in relief—gambling when one knew that they would definitely lose was boring.

When he was just about to leave, Ling Xiaoyi’s phone suddenly rang. After picking up the phone and hearing the other side, she passed it to Hong Dali. “Young Master, it’s the production crew ofThe Gale Flash.”

“Oh? The production crew ofThe Gale Flash?” Hong Dali touched his chin. “Speaking of which, I had forgotten about this movie after sponsoring it...” Taking over the phone, he said, “Hello, who wants to talk to me?”
A familiar voice could be heard over the phone. “Is this Young Master Dali? I’m Ding Chengzhi.”
“Ding Chengzhi?” Hong Dali’s mind was filled with question marks. “Have I met you before?”
“Uh...” The other party choked for a while. “I’m the person that asked if you could allow Miss Li Nianwei’sLightning Pursuitto be our movie’s theme song during her concert. Do you remember?”

“Concert? Talked to me?” Hong Dali finally remembered. “Ah, I remember, I remember. You were the comrade who got beaten the previous time, right? Oh, comrade, you have worked hard. Have you recovered after getting beaten last time? Does it still hurt?”

Hearing what Hong Dali said, Ding Chengzhi felt depressed.Out of all things, why did he need to mention this to pour salt over my wounds? However, he did not dare refute. “Yes, yes, yes, that’s me. Hehe, it’s really an honor to be remembered by Young Master Dali.”
“Why did you call me?” Hong Dali clearly understood that Ding Chengzhi would not call for no apparent reason, and thus, directly asked, “Do you still lack money?”

Ding Chengzhi once again choked for a while before hurriedly replying, “Ah, no, no, no. The money you gave us the previous time is sufficient. I just wanted to ask if you had the time tomorrow to come to give us your view on the plot of the movie since it’s the weekend tomorrow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - Going Against The Heavens!
paragraphs: Give my view of the plot of the movie? The plot forThe Gale Flash?
That’s good, we still don’t have anything to do over the weekend! Hong Dali smiled and immediately agreed. “Alright, it’s a deal. Where will we meet? If it’s too far away, then forget about it.”

After hearing Hong Dali agree, Ding Chengzhi was obviously in a good mood. He smiled and said, “Speaking of which, this was all thanks to Young Master. After signing the contract last time, we had already begun to change the plot. However, we were unable to find a good filming spot yesterday, and thus, wanted to ask Young Master for your opinion. However, you were in class, so we decided not to bother you.”
Speaking up to here, Ding Chengzhi smiled again and continued, “Speaking of which, Young Master Dali certainly does have great foresight!”
“Uh, what are you talking about?” Hong Dali asked curiously. “How has it got to do with me having a great foresight?”

“It’s like this.” Ding Chengzhi said with a smile. “We were originally frustrated about the shooting location as there were no clean places in the country where the mountains and rivers are not polluted. If we were to clean it temporarily, it would be too much trouble and a waste of time. If we don’t clean a place, we will have to rely on 3D animation, which is not a small expense. As a result, when I called Ms. Xiaoyi yesterday, Ms. Xiaoyi said that there is a sizeable plot of land that has already been cleaned in the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain. Furthermore, it’s the property of Young Master Dali. Thus, we went there to shoot the movie.”

After reporting his current work progress, Ding Chengzhi did not forget to say, “Ai, we only found out when we reached there that the place was so perfect. It perfectly suits the atmosphere of our scene in the movie! Young Master Dali, did you know, with this location, I dare say that we have saved at least half a million in production costs!”

“...” Hong Dali twitched his nose. When he bought the area initially, he did not have any plans for it. He merely found it an eyesore for it to be littered with rubbish, and thus, ordered for it to be cleaned. Unexpectedly, such an action even brought about such use. But in any case, Hong Dali finally understood. “You mean that you’re now near the periphery of Tianjing Mountain? Okay then. You can all go to Ye Lai Xiang’s hotel to rest for the night for free. I will go to the shooting scene tomorrow to look at the progress, hehe.”
With Hong Dali’s agreement, Ding Chengzhi was satisfied and happy.
It was a pleasure to work with Young Master Dali. Not only did one not need to worry about the shooting location, but the lodging and meals were also well taken care of too.

Was there even such a nice boss? Only such a boss could be considered impressive. One didn’t need to worry about anything related to money when working with him. If there were any difficulties, he would use money to settle it no matter how hard it was, even if it was a god blocking the way.
“Sure, that’s good.” Ding Chengzhi happily agreed. “We will have to trouble Young Master Dali then, hehe.”
“Speak less nonsense. If there’s nothing else, I will go back to sleep first.”
After playing for the whole of today, Hong Dali was indeed tired. Thus, he immediately hung up.
After hanging up though, there was a strange silence around him.
Tang Muxin was the first to react. She said, “Dali, you had long planned to use the area to film, right?”

“What do you mean by planned for it?” Hong Dali’s face was full of question marks. “I just bought it because the area seemed nice. Anyway, it was just to squander! Why do I need to plan and calculate when I buy something?” In the end, Hong Dali did not forget to add, “You’re doubting my character, that’s really bad!”

Pei Pei Pei! Tang Muxin didn’t bother arguing about such things. She pulled Hong Dali’s hand and said, “I don’t care whether you planned for it or not. Dali, do you understand? If we look at it in the short term, it does indeed seem to have taken a lot of money to purchase and clean the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain. However, if we were to construct a film base or something related and charge those that want to film there, and then build a horse farm, we would earn back lots of money. When Mu Zixiao first heard the news, he almost laughed till he couldn’t breathe.

It was justifiable if Hong Dali had bought land suitable for the development of real estate, but the plot of land including Fengyuan Lake had been idle for so many years because there was no development value. The development area was a bit small, and no one would want to pay if it were to be turned into a park. Instead, Hong Dali bought the land for the purpose of walking the dogs.

The outer ring of Tianjing Mountain was even more not suited for development. The wild mountain forest was barely a good place to enjoy its greenery, and the most important thing in the place was that the country was paying attention to greening and afforestation these few days. Even if the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain was bought, there was not much of an area to build houses. If one wanted to cut the trees to build a villa, one needed to go to the Forestry Bureau to apply for a felling certificate. It was definitely not an easy process.
It was not an exaggeration to say that if the other plots of land were to be bought, they could be put to some use. However, these two plots were purely meant for people with money to squander.
However, after hearing the phone call and Tang Muxin’s analysis, Mu Zixiao immediately felt coldness from his toes to his head.
Because he thought ofUnexpectedly!.

Ignoring others, in the first episode ofUnexpectedly!, it riled up many to create wuxia films. What was the most important aspect of filming wuxia films? The scenery must be perfect, like that of the past. When one sees the background of the film, one must be able to link it to the landscape filled with mountains, greeneries, and water of the past.

Nowadays, with the high-paced economic development, it was not easy to find such a place in the whole country. Perhaps there were such places in the remote areas in the south, but it was too far from the urban area; thus, transportation of equipment would be quite troublesome. On top of that, some of the places were inaccessible by cars.

What about the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain? It was a six- or seven-minute drive, and the roads were wide and straight, with no chance of a jam. After filming in the day, the crew could even go to Ye Lai Xiang to have supper and bathe! And Ye Lai Xiang was also Hong Dali’s property!

The most impressive part was that in the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain, there was a small unpolluted lake as there were no manufacturing factories in the area. The water in the small lake could be described as natural mineral water!
This was going against the heavens!
At this moment, the look in Mu Zixiao’s eyes when he looked at Hong Dali had turned from admiring to terrified.
That was too scary!
If these were to turn reality, Hong Dali’s great luck and foresight could be described as going against the heavens!

The more he analyzed, the more Mu Zixiao became afraid. And the more he became afraid, the more he wanted to clearly understand what was happening. Thus, he carefully asked, “Dali, since I have nothing to do tomorrow, do you mind if I follow you all to the film site? I’m interested in films and movies too.”
“Oh, if it’s like that...” Hong Dali twitched his nose. “Alright, since I feel that your bones are special, and your talent is good, why not be one of the actors?”
Mu Zixiao: “...”

“Okay, let’s go,” While walking out, Hong Dali muttered to Tang Muxin, “Didn’t I say before, we will turn Fengyuan Lake into Marshes of Mount Liang. As to the outer ring of Tianjing Mountain... I have not thought about it yet!”
Mu Zixiao: “...”

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - This World Is Really Mystical!
paragraphs: The next day, a Saturday morning.
To sleep to his content, and to count money till his hands ached—this was the life Hong Dali hoped for.

However, it was a pity that he had already agreed to go to the filming site. While Hong Dali was lazing around on the bed, hoping to continue sleeping, his mobile phone started ringing, causing a big commotion and making him unable to keep sleeping. In the end, he threw the mobile phone away in anger. However, it was useless as the phone continued to ring!

It was known that you get what you pay for. The old limited edition platinum mobile phone that the old butler had prepared for him was worth 168,000 yuan. The cover was hard and sturdy—it could even be used as a brick to knock people or even used to block bullets with no pressure when faced with an attack. Thus, although the phone was thrown, the result was that the wall was left with a faint black mark. The phone then continued to ring...
“Ahhhhh!” Hong Dali cried out in annoyance. It was the weekend, yet he was unable to sleep until he was satisfied.
“Who is it! Why can’t he let me sleep a while more! It’s just 8:30!” Hong Dali got out of bed and grabbed the phone, roaring into it, “What do you want! Why can’t you wait till later to say!”
“Hong Dali!”
“Oh...” Alright, anyways, he had already slept till 8:30. Hong Dali rubbed his eyes. “Why are you in such a hurry? Isn’t it just a visit to the filming site?”
“Did you forget what we had discussed about my family’s problem last time?” Tang Muxin whispered. “My father has agreed, and we can start today. I was just waiting for your orders!”
What was the matter about Tang Muxin’s family at the last time? Ooh, I remember.

Hong Dali said feebly, “Chenhui Building’s 10th floor should have been settled by Sister Cai. You can take the people there directly. After you’re done with that, you can call me again. For now, I will go back to sleep first...”
Chenhui Building, 10th floor.

“Xinxin, can this method really work?” Tang Muxin’s father, Tang Ruisi, looked at the workers moving all kinds of equipment and asked. “This is our last chance. If it doesn’t pan out... Aii, anyway, there is no other way.”
Tang Muxin smiled and said, “Don’t worry. Although Hong Dali is a prodigal, he is not stupid, and his luck is very good. I think that trusting him will not hurt us at all.”
Listening to her daughter, Tang Ruisi thought for a moment and suddenly said, “Xinxin, I found that you and Dali have become closer recently. About our plan last time...”

“Aiya, don’t talk about this, let’s talk about it later!” Listening to his father bring up his original plan, Tang Muxin face had a rare blush, before quickly shifting the topic. “Dad, the environment here is very good, and we’re troubling someone else. You must be very careful.”
“I know.” Tang Ruisi sighed. “Well, you should go do what you need to do. Didn’t you need to go to the film site? I will oversee the stuff here.”

“Well, then...” Tang Muxin thought about it and carefully reminded him. “Dad, go back in a while alright. And don’t be discovered. Sister Cai will arrange the stuff here properly. Those chosen by Dali are very capable.”
“Alright, I will leave after a while.”

After handling the things here, Tang Muxin went downstairs to find Li Nianwei to play badminton with for a while. Then, she took out her phone hesitantly and silently thought, I don’t know if this big lazy worm has gotten up... En, anyways, it’s already at half past nine, he should have gotten up. Actually... nevermind. I will call him again at ten. He’s in poor health, I should let him sleep more.

As she was thinking of this, her mobile phone suddenly rang. Tang Muxin looked at it and saw that it was actually from Hong Dali. She felt sweet in her heart and silently thought, At least he cares about me.She then answered decisively, only to listen to Hong Dali say, “Xinxin, are you In Chenhui? Go downstairs now. Have you eaten in the morning? I’m hungry!”

“Eat...” Tang Muxin was going to say that she had already eaten, but after thinking about it, since he had helped her family so much, she should just accompany him to eat again. She immediately replied, “I only drank a glass of milk. After hearing that you’re hungry, I too feel slightly hungry. I will go downstairs now then.”

When he got downstairs, entered the car, and was about to go. Mu Zixiao rushed out from the side. “Young Master Dali, I have been waiting for you for a long time. Can you bring me along? I also want to go to the site to see.”
Talking about it, he was at least on the same level as Hong Dali, a genuine nouveau riche. If he wanted to find and meet superstars, he could simply do so with just a sentence.

However, since he saw Hong Dali, he felt that he was sitting in the well, looking at the sky. It was not that his family background was not strong enough, but he had never seen such a lucky person. If one did not befriend such a person, it would certainly be a loss. Thus, he did not care about his identity anymore and even became like a homeless stray dog.
“Oh, get on then.” Hong Dali opened his car door. “Let’s go together, but we are eating breakfast first.”
“Alright!” Mu Zixiao immediately hopped onto the car.

The three people took a group of lackeys together to go to the best old shop of the Four Loops to have breakfast. Hong Dali and Tang Muxin sat in the center, while Mu Zixiao looked for a small table on the side and served himself. Three male lackeys stood with their arms crossed and looked at the surroundings, and six female lackeys were responsible for delivering tea. Hong Dali certainly looked exuberant, causing the boss to have shivering legs when delivering the food to their table.
On the dining table, Tang Muxin smiled and watched Hong Dali gorging at the food, saying, “Why are you eating in such a hurry? Slow down and eat slowly, don’t choke on the food.”
Hearing Tang Muxin’s question, Mu Zixiao’s ears stood up, waiting for Hong Dali’s answer.
“I’m in a hurry to squander.” Unexpectedly, Hong Dali said so.
Tang Muxin: “...”Alright, next time I will not ask such a stupid question again...
Mu Zixiao: “...”It seems that squandering is already ingrained in his bones.

After eating breakfast, they went straight to the site. However, as the car just made its way out into the main road, the traffic light turned red. An old man who was riding a battery car did not stop in time and, with a loudBang, he slammed the rearview mirror of Hong Dali’s Soaring Angel.

At the sight of the old man, Hong Dali became interested. It was actually the old man from last time. “Old man, is it a natural law for your battery car to crash into my car’s rearview mirror? Why did you crash into it today again?”
“You recognize this old man?” Mu Zixiao asked curiously.
“Ah, he hit my rearview mirror the last time and did so again today.” Hong Dali said with an indifferent expression.
Mu Zixiao: “This world is certainly mystical...”

The last time the old man hit his mirror, Hong Dali did not call him to pay for it. However, after hitting it another time, the old man was too much embarrassed to run. He scratched his nearly bald head and smiled. “I’m sorry. I was in a hurry, in a hurry.”
“What are you in a hurry for?” This time around, Hong Dali became curious. “You’re an old man past your 60-years-old, right? Have you retired?”
“Who said I am 60 plus?” The old man said with pride, “This old man here is 77 this year.”
Hearing that the old man say he was 77-years-old, Tang Muxin became curious. “Old man, you are already 77? You don’t look it though. You look a little bit over 60 only.”
Mu Zixiao face was filled with shock. “You look younger the older you grow?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - “Wash, Cut, Blow” Geezer Wang
paragraphs: It was no wonder that Tang Muxin and Mu Zixiao were curious. The old man dared to even drift and speed while riding a battery car, his face full of oil and a few wrinkles—except for his hair, beard, and eyebrows being white, his body thin and short, he did not look like a frail old man at all. No one would doubt that he could live for another twenty or thirty years if they saw him.

“I’m okay.” The old man hurriedly said. “This young master, this old man here knows that I can’t afford your car, and I still have to rush to work. About this, what can I do...” Up to here, he was also a little scared. The rearview mirror cost tens of thousands. If he were to be really made to pay for it, he couldn’t afford it. He could only hope that this rich family’s young master did not care about such small things. But the possibility was not very big, or it could be said to be minuscule...

“Don’t be in a hurry to leave.” Expectedly, Hong Dali did not allow him to leave. “We can ignore the last time you knocked into us. However, this time, you ought to do something about it. I don’t need your money, I just want you to answer some questions.”
Don’t need your money!
Hearing this phrase, the old man’s eyes instantly lit up. “Sure, sure, sure. Do ask!”
Tang Muxin was the first to ask, “Old man, how did you maintain your looks so well? How can you look so young when you are already over 70?”

It was no wonder that people said that males and females had different ways of thought. Hong Dali and Mu Zixiao were thinking that this old man was definitely not ordinary, and his identity was quite mysterious. On the other hand, the first thing Tang Muxin wanted to know was how the old man maintained his looks...

“The secret to a healthy life lies in exercising.” Hearing this question, the old man said with a smile. “When I have nothing to do, I will go to the park to exercise and practice some boxing. I usually eat on time every day and have one or two small cups of alcohol every day. With a happy mindset, I will remain young.”
“If it’s like that, I will start exercising every day from now on.” Tang Muxin’s eyes were filled with stars. “By doing so, I can remain young forever.”

Originally, Tang Muxin rarely ran in the morning, but with the old man being a living example in front of her eyes, she couldn’t help but be tempted. After all, beauty was something every woman desired. Who didn’t want to look young?
Instead of admiring the old man’s looks like Tang Muxin, Hong Dali was curious about the old man’s job. He thus asked, “Old man, what do you do for a living? Also, what’s your name?”

“I’m surnamed Wang,” replied the old man. “Young Master, you can call me Geezer Wang. As to what I do for a living...” He dryly laughed. “It’s just a small job. Not so far in front, there is a salon. I help the old people there wash, cut, and blow their hair.”
“Wash, Cut, Blow” Geezer Wang. Hong Dali smiled and asked, “What form of boxing do you practice? Is it powerful?”

“It’s for leisure,” “Wash, Cut, Blow” Geezer Wang continued, “I don’t know much, just Taijiquan, Xingyiquan, Tongbeiquan, Shaolinquan, Wudangquan, Xingyiquan, Heyangquan, Drunken boxing, Big Scorpion boxing, Small Scorpion, etc... I roughly know how to do all of them.”
After hearing this, Mu Zixiao’s eyeballs nearly popped out. Hong Dali’s luck was definitely going against the heavens!
An old man who knocked his rearview mirror twice turned out to be a martial arts master!
Out of all the martial arts that the old man said, he himself had barely practiced Xingyiquan and Bajiquan. He had not even heard of the others!
“Geezer Wang, are you speaking the truth?” Mu Zixiao wanted to confirm it, or he might not be able to sleep well tonight. “Why not let us compare moves?”
Hearing him say that, Hong Dali and Tang Muxin’s eyes both lit up. Hong Dali: “Wow, Old Mu, you actually know martial arts too?”
Mu Zixiao depressingly said, “Don’t call me Old Mu. I feel that you’re calling me Old Mother [1. Mu in Chinese has the same pronunciation as mother]. Call me Old Xiao...”
“Alright, Old Xiao.” Hong Dali nodded his head.

At this moment, Geezer Wang started to panic. “Aiyo, this young master here. This old man really has an urgent matter. If I were to be late and delay the others, I will get my wages deducted. On top of that, I don’t dare to act against you...”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said, “Geezer Wang, why not follow me in the future. A salary of 5000 a month, including food and lodging. How about it?”
Tang Muxin who was at the side, asked hurriedly, “Dali, why are you hiring him before you confirming his abilities? What if he’s bluffing?”
“No worries.” Hong Dali smiled and said, “If he’s lying, Old Xiao will definitely beat him till his teeth drop to the floor.”

Mu Zixiao nodded his head. “Geezer Wang, how about it? Young Master Dali has already said—one month, 5000. This salary is not considered small, right?” He really wanted to confirm whether the old man was a martial arts master.
“Really, 5000 a month? Including lodging and food?” Hearing this, Geezer Wang’s eyes lit up. “I did not study much, you are not lying to me, right?”
“As long as what you said is true, I will definitely give you 5000 a month!” Hong Dali confirmed. “How about it? Do you dare? If you do, get on the car!”

“I’m doing it!” Geezer Wang took the battery car away. “If I were to earn 5000 a month, I don’t need this crappy battery car anymore. The brakes are not even good...” As he talked and was about to get on the car, he thought about it again and was slightly embarrassed. “About that, young master, I’m afraid that my clothes will dirty your car...”
“There is no need for such nonsense.” Hong Dali opened the car door. “Get on!”

“Alright!” Hearing that he could make a monthly salary of 5,000 with this young master, Geezer Wang became bold. “Then I shall not stand on ceremony.” He got on the car and couldn’t stop sighing. “Aiya, this car is really good. This old man here has lived for a lifetime, but the most expensive car I have ever sat on was a Putian that cost more than 100,000. However, after comparing it to the Young Master’s car here, ze ze ze!”
“What about the comparison?” Hong Dali smiled and asked. “Is the difference that big?”

“Big! Of course, it’s big!” Geezer Wang continued, “Look at your car. It’s so spacious, and it even allows me to stretch my legs! It also comes with a mini fridge. Also, look at this leather seat, aiya, it’s such a good car! Good car! After going back, I can show off to the other old men!”
There was a saying that everyone liked hearing praises. Tang Muxin smiled and said, “Geezer Wang, your skill must definitely be good, right?”
“Of course!” Geezer Wang continued, “My ‘Wash, Cut, Blow’ skills are definitely the best! In just five minutes, I can fix the entire haircut...”
“Geezer Wang!” Mu Zixiao, who stood at the side, couldn’t help but say, “She’s asking about your martial arts skills, not your ‘Wash, Cut, Blow’ skills!”

“About that,” Geezer Wang said. “I have practiced it for my whole life. It should be good enough. In my early days, others even called me Soaring Eagle Wang Daoming—En, that’s about 40 or 50 years ago. Even if I were to say it, you wouldn’t understand.”
Hong Dali did not know if Soaring Eagle really existed, but he at least found out that the old man was called Wang Daoming...

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - The 18 Palm Attacks to Defeat Dragons?
paragraphs: As the car arrived at the boundary, everyone alighted.

Mu Zixiao stood facing “Wash, Cut, Blow” Master Wang. Mu Zixiao posed and said, “Old man, I’m really giving all I have and won’t hold back. It’s not too late to surrender. Don’t land yourself in the hospital due to my beating.”
Master Wang casually relaxed his arms and legs and took a pipe from his pocket. He smoked as he said, “Don’t worry. Can I really show all that I got? You will not take revenge?”
“You must be kidding. I would not do something like that.” Right after Mu Zixiao spoke, he loudly shouted, “Watch out!”
His shout was earth-shaking. Even Hong Dali, who was standing at the side, could feel the ground move. He then saw that Mu Zixiao had his fist out. His punch was quick, lethal, and accurate. Then...

Then he saw Master Wang, who was as skinny as a monkey, flying up the sky using Mu Zixiao’s fist, and then squatting on Mu Zixiao’s shoulder smoking.Huff puff...He took two deep breaths and laughed. “Young man, you’re a little too slow.”
Everyone’s jaw dropped to the ground.
As Hong Dali’s dedicated driver, Wang Mingyu was also trained in martial arts. Watching Master Wang flaunt his moves, he could not help but praise him. “Great! This is a great master!”
Tang Muxin whispered, “Uncle Wang, can you beat him?”
Wang Mingyu decisively shook his head. “I’m no match for him.”
Tang Muxin let out a long sigh. Hong Dali’s luck was unbelievably good. Who would have thought that this old man was so skilled? Even driver-cum-bodyguard Wang Mingyu was no match for him.

There was a saying that once an expert showed his skills, everyone would be able to tell if it was real or fake. Continuing the fight was pointless. Mu Zixiao was utterly convinced. “Master, you really are a master! I’m convinced. Completely convinced!” There was no way for Mu Zixiao to deny. If Master Wang had shown his full potential, he could easily slap him a few times. But he did not. And Mu Zixiao had no reason to continue the fight.
In any case, It was obvious to everyone present who had the winning hand.

Master Wang jumped off Mu Zixiao’s shoulders with ease, laughing as he walked towards Hong Dali. He ruffled his hair, slightly embarrassed. “Young Master Dali, do you think I have what it takes? Am I eligible to take on this job which offers 5000 a month?” The 5000 yuan had been on his mind this whole time.

Without beating around the bush, Hong Dali raised salary by ten times. “Fifty thousand a month.” His eyes sparkled. “You shall be my lackeys’ martial arts teacher from now on, Geezer Wang. What do you think?”
Mu Zixiao suddenly got anxious. He rushed toward Geezer Wang and hugged his leg. “Master! You’re my Master! I will offer you 100,000 a month! Please teach me your skills!”

Geezer Wang shook him off his leg without replying. “Young man, there should be an order for everything, right? I have already agreed to Young Master Dali. We have to keep our promises. Young Master Dali, are you serious in giving me 50,000 a month?”
Hong Dali laughed as he said, “As real as 24K pure gold! What’s your decision?”
Geezer Wang agreed at an instant. “I’ll do it!”
Mu Zixiao’s face was covered with tears.
Who would have thought that an old man who sped and knocked off someone’s rearview mirror would be a martial arts expert? He had lagged one step behind.
Hong Dali felt bad for Mu Zixiao and said, “Old Xiao, do you like martial arts this much? You are not bad yourself, how long have you been training?”

Mu Zixiao sat on the floor and sighed. “Ten years. I thought my skills were good, and I was confident to go against five or six amateurs. Who would have thought? Even if I think I’m the best, there is always someone better.” He started to get worked up as he spoke. “Geezer Wang, why would you go around knocking off people’s rearview mirrors for no reason? If you’re short of money, you can always look for me. With your skills, it would be no problem paying you 100,000 or more.”

Geezer Wang took out his cigarette bag and hit Mu Zixiao on his head with aPAKsound. “Why would you say that, brat?” Mu Zixiao immediately regretted what he said, but there was no way to avoid it. He could only listen to Geezer Wang. “In this time and era, learning martial arts should only be for strengthening the body. Why would it matter if you’re highly skilled or less skilled? You can’t feed off it! You can’t possibly go rob someone with your skills, and neither can you earn any money off it. Besides, why did you learn martial arts in the first place? Is it used to beat people you dislike?”
Mu Zixiao’s face revealed his hurt expression. “That... that’s not it... I use it to protect myself...”

Geezer Wang snorted. “Aren’t you embarrassed to say that? I felt your aura when I got in the car. The feeling of you wanting to pick a fight with someone from training too much. Young man, in the olden days, people trained to fight evil and help the poor. Now, in the ‘rule of law’ society, you’re wrong if you think that learning martial arts is to show your ability.” He turned to look at Hong Dali. “Young Master Dali, let me ask you a question. If I teach you all my skills, would you be willing to learn them?”
Hearing Geezer Wang, everyone around looked with envy. It might be an exaggeration, but one would become a modern day hero by learning all his skills.
Hong Dali decisively said without a second thought, “I’m not learning these things. It’s my wish to be a prodigal son. Fighting and killing do not suit me.”
Everyone around sighed. Mu Zixiao was even more depressed.
What was given to Hong Dali so easily was something he could not get. This was the vast difference between them.

Geezer Wang smiled as he shook his head. “I knew it. That’s why I’m willing to follow you. Of course, the salary is one of the factors. Hehe.” He took another two puffs on his cigarette as he spoke. “Having said that, I have come to understand that martial arts can be used to both cultivate values and preserve health. But it’s absolutely no good to use it as a weapon.”

As he spoke, Geezer Wang walked to a nearby tree. He drew a half circle with his left hand and gave a hard push. The tree broke into two in an instant with aKe chisound. He said, “I could use more strength. But other than someone with Young Master Dali’s personality, there’s no way I could impart my skills to anyone else. If they took one wrong step along the way, they could kill others without blinking...” He revealed sadness knowing there would be nobody to impart his skills to.

It was no wonder he was so depressed. In modern society, it was inevitable for people to squabble with each other. The young people were so rash and reckless, the arguing would easily lead to fights. Who could bear it?
As he was feeling lonely, Hong Dali was stunned and said, “Damn, 18 Palm Attacks to Defeat Dragons?! Are you Hong Qigong?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - Hardcore Fan
paragraphs: Hong Dali’s words gave everyone a shock. “What is 18 Palm Attacks to Defeat Dragons? And who is Hong Qigong?”

Geezer Wang quickly explained, “Old fellow, my name is Wang Daoming, not Hong Qigong.” He rubbed his chin and continued to speak, “But in actual fact, there really isn’t a name for this move. When my Master imparted this skill to me, he called it ‘Heavy Hand.’ There were only eight moves in all. If this move were used on a person, all his bones would break for sure. It’s a powerful move. However, I don’t use it much. But Young Master, 18 Palm Attacks sounds powerful. Too bad the number of moves doesn’t match up. How about we call it ‘Defeating Dragons Attack’? Doesn’t that sound good?”
As he said that, Mu Zixiao decisively pounced on him and hugged his leg again. “Master! Please, take me as your disciple!”
The crowd thought to themselves, “No matter what, he’s also a young master from an influent family similar to Young Master. He can really throw away his pride for the sake of learning martial arts.”

Geezer Wang shook his head promptly. “No! I don’t impart my skills so easily. Unless it’s Young Master Dali who wants to learn. You have too much of a temper. I have no wish to teach you in fear that you will accidentally kill someone. I cannot bear that kind of responsibility.”

Mu Zixiao rushed toward Hong Dali, put his hand around his shoulders, and started to suck up to him. “No! That will definitely not happen! Although we’re not real brothers, we are closer than real brothers! It would be no difference to impart your skills to him or to me!” He winked at Dali after he spoke. “Dali, isn’t that so?”
Hong Dali sniffed and said, “Oh. Anyway, I don’t care. Why don’t you just teach him, Geezer Wang? I can’t learn it anyway. It would be a pity to let the skills be lost.”

To be able to endure years of practice is actually one of the simplest terms. It’s tough on normal people. But I can tell you have talent and a good body. This term should be easy for you.”
Hearing what he said, Hong Dali rubbed his nose. He had previously casually commented that Mu Zixiao was very talented and had good bone structure. He didn’t think that would be true.
Tang Muxin tugged on Hong Dali secretly, whispering, “Dali, hadn’t you already noticed that Mu Zixiao was suitable to practice martial arts. I remember you said that when you first met him.”
Hong Dali reluctantly shrugged his shoulders. “I was just saying it for fun...”
Tang Muxin: “...”
Mu Zixiao could be heard saying, “No problem! That’s no problem for me! I love practicing martial arts from a young age. I can train in the coldest winter and hottest summer!”
Geezer Wang bore an expert style. “En, you can call me Master then.”
Hearing the word “Master” from Geezer Wang, Mu Zixiao kneeled down in an instant and kowtowed trice. “Disciple Mu Zixiao pays respect to Master!”
Geezer Wang smiled and helped Mu Zixiao up. “Get up. In the future, you’re not to misuse your skills after you learn them from me. Did you hear me? Don’t cause any trouble!”
Mu Zixiao took out a card from his pocket and presented it. “Yes! I understand! This is a small token of appreciation. Please accept it if you don’t mind!”

A token of appreciation from his disciple should be accepted. Geezer Wang accepted it graciously and softly asked, “How much is in there?” At that moment, his glance was wretched and felt the packet with his fingers...
Mu Zixiao softly replied, “One million. Master, use this first. The password is 888888. If it’s not enough, I will give you more later!”

Geezer Wang was taken aback.Cough cough! Since he had decided to follow Hong Dali, he would have to be more open-minded. He made sure not to make a fool of himself and nodded. “En, I’ll accept it then.”
Now that everything was settled, Hong Dali laughed heartily and walked forward, aggressively patting Mu Zixiao’s shoulder. “Old Xiao, we belong to one family now!”

To be able to gain a highly skilled master, Mu Zixiao was elated. “That, that, haha!” No matter how he looked at Hong Dali, he seemed pleasing to his eyes. He was not just lucky, whoever followed him was lucky as well! Master Wang’s skills were definitely not a small matter!
Mu Zixiao was happy, but driver Old Wang watched this scene with sweat on his back.

Young Master Dali did not even know the man’s agenda but had so easily acquired a loyal follower whose background was almost equal to his own family. Seeing his obsession with martial arts, and that he was learning martial arts from Geezer Wang, it was rather beneficial to him. At least, he was aware of Mu Zixiao’s character. Since Mu Zixiao appeared before Hong Dali, the Hong Family had done a few checks. Mu Zixiao was sinister but did not bother about small matters. But one thing he was sure of was that he had never turned back on his own words.

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - Prepare Some Rapid Action Heart Tonic...
paragraphs: As Hong Dali’s dedicated driver, Wang Mingyu naturally had to report such an important matter to his superior. While the others were busy, he quickly stepped aside and pulled out his phone to make the call.
The call was quickly connected, and Hong Weiguo’s low voice was heard. He said, “Old Wang, what happened?”

Wang Mingyu glanced at the Hong Dali laughing. He gulped and said, “Old Master, I think Young Master Dali has done something incredible. Do you still remember the old man who knocked off our rearview mirror some time ago?”

Since the man had damaged the rearview mirror of one of his family cars, Hong Weiguo naturally conducted a check on the man to make sure that he was not a threat. “Old man? The one named Wang Daming? He seems like an ordinary hairdresser. The report did mention that he practices martial arts every morning. What about him?”
Wang Mingyu muttered, “That old man knocked off our rearview mirror again today...”
Hong Weiguo wondered. “What is this old man up to? Dali did not demand compensation for the last accident, and he knocked off the mirror again?”
Wang Mingyu said, “Old Master, money is not the issue now. The important thing is, it turns out the old man is skilled in martial arts!”
Hong Weiguo was obviously taken aback.Cough cough cough! He asked, “Really? That old man is skilled in martial arts? Isn’t he in his 60s?”
Wang Mingyu said, “Not sixty. His actual age is 73. Also, his skills...” Wang Mingyu felt defeated. “Let’s just say that if I were to fight him, I would not make it past ten exchanges.”

After a long pause, Hong Weiguo’s shocked response came through the phone. “You mean to say this old fellow who knocked off Dali’s rearview mirror looks twenty years younger than his actual age, and you are no match for him?!” It was no wonder Hong Weiguo was shocked. Wang Mingyu had been working for him for years, taking care of Hong Dali’s safety. His ability was obviously of a certain standard.
It was not an exaggeration to say that Wang Mingyu was more than capable of fighting four or five armed attackers.
And he actually said that he might not be able to withstand ten exchanges with the old man?!

Wang Mingyu had no choice but to admit it. “It’s true. All the powers that may be will kneel down in front of Young Master Dali’s unbeatable luck. One of those kneeling is Mu Zixiao, the young master of the Mu Family.”
Hong Weiguo slowly said, “En, Mu Zixiao. He’s a character, that one. He’s in the same league as Liu Mingxin. What about him?”

Wang Mingyu impatiently said, “Mu Zixiao is a martial arts maniac, and Geezer Wang took him in as a disciple. Hong Dali took Geezer Wang in as a subordinate. In this case, Mu Zixiao is the disciple of one of Young Master Dali’s men. This makes his place even lower in the hierarchy. Geezer Wang specifically said that Mu Zixiao should follow Young Master Dali and make sure to protect Young Master Dali from any danger. He’s effectively Young Master Dali’s new bodyguard now.” Wang Mingyu emphasized. “By Young Master Dali’s standards, Mu Zixiao is considered one of his lackeys.”

Hong Weiguo felt overwhelmed by the amount of information given to him. “Oh my god... An old hairdresser who keeps strangely knocking into rearview mirrors is also a martial arts master. The young master of the Mu Family, who came to Tianjing for some unknown reason became one of Dali’s lackeys. Mingyu, please prepare some rapid action heart tonic tonight. At this rate, I’m afraid I might get a heart attack.”
After a moment of silence, Wang Mingyu nodded vigorously. “Okay.”
Just as Wang Mingyu ended his phone call, Hong Dali waved him over. “Uncle Wang, are you done with your phone call? We have to get ready to leave.”
Wang Mingyu kept his phone and hurriedly walked back. “Young Master, are we going to meet the production team now?”
Hong Dali laughed and snapped his fingers. “Yes. Let’s go and see how the filming of the movie is getting along.”
Mu Family’s young master, Mu Zixiao, humbly move to clear the way. “Dali, please!” Followed by. “Master, please.”
Hong Dali swaggered into the car with Tang Muxin. It was a good thing the Soaring Angel was spacious. Geezer Wang and Mu Zixiao, as well as the nine lackeys, all got on and set off.
It was a short distance away from the production team’s location. Within minutes, Hong Dali could see Ding Chengzhi standing beside the road.
As Dali opened the door and alighted, he said, “Friend! You’ve been busy!”

Seeing his God of Fortune alighting from the car, Ding Chengzhi ran over. “Aiyo, Young Master Dali, you are finally here. I was afraid you wouldn’t make it today. Did you have a good sleep last night? This way please, the production team is just ahead. It’s break time now.”
Hong Dali was very satisfied with his attitude. “Tip him! 5000.”
One of the lackeys took out a stack of money from the bag and counted. “This is from the Young Master!”
Ding Chengzhi grinned widely. “Thank you, Young Master! It’s rare to meet such a generous boss!”
The group set off. As they walked, Ding Chengzhi told Hong Dali about the plot of the movie.
Although he was the music director, he was one of the core members of the production team. He was therefore very familiar with the entire movie.

The movie they were filming was originally calledWind Pursuer. It had since been renamed toThe Gale Flash. Depicting a man who became a great kungfu master, the storyline was bland. It was about a youth who had his family members murdered and later learned some skills from a master, then going after his enemies for revenge. Hong Dali almost slept listening to it.

The main character in the story was named Long Xiangtian. Hong Dali almost choked when he heard the name. He didn’t want to mention it during Li Nianwei’s concert, but as he heard it now, he found the movie unbelievably tacky.
Long Xiangtian was not that much different from Long Aotian.
Hong Dali decisively said, “Change the name of the lead character. If you don’t change it, I’ll leave now!”
He was the real God of Fortune. Ding Chengzhi decisively replied, “Lead character’s name? No problem! What does Young Master have in mind? ”
Hong Dali replied, “Wait, let me take a look at the script after we get there.”

“Okay!” A little further on, they saw the set just on the outer circle of Tianjing Mountain. The set was not very big, probably about a few hundred square meters. There were tracks, cameras, various lighting, and audio equipment. There were even various actors dressed in period clothing standing at the side.
Ding Chengzhi said, “We’re here.”
Hong Dali looked at the actors and asked, “Wasn’t this a sci-fi movie? Why are they all in period clothing?”

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - This Plot Is for People to See?
paragraphs: “Sci-fi movie?” After listening to Hong Dali’s words, Ding Chengzhi said strangely, “Our film has always been a martial arts film. Didn’t you see the promo clip that we gave you?”

“I thought it was a transmigration-type drama. Who thought you would name an ancient martial arts film‘Wind Pursuer’!” Hong Dali frantically said, “I thought it was some kind of special person who can control the wind! That’s why I said I wanted to change the name to‘The Gale Flash’!”
“This... what should I do?” Ding Chengzhi was also depressed. “Then what should we name it?”
“Where is your director?” Hong angrily said, “Ask him to see me.”

They were eating and living off Young Master; therefore, they had to do whatever he asked. Ding Chengzhi shouted to a bearded man whose clothing had a lot of pockets. “Director! Young Master Dali is here and has something to say!” After saying so, he hurriedly introduced. “This is our director, Lin Hao, Director Lin.”

“AHHH—” Upon hearing that Hong Dali had arrived, Lin Hao, who was lecturing an actor, ran over. When he saw Hong Dali, he immediately grabbed Hong Dali hands and kept shaking them. “Oh, Young Master, I was really dying to see you! I have heard your name long ago, and I have finally seen you in person today. This is an honor, an honor indeed!”
“...” Hong Dali: “My hand has gone numb...”

“Oh, sorry, sorry.” Lin Hao hurriedly let go of his hand, embarrassed. “I’m too excited, too excited, hehe.” He shouted towards the filming scene, “Young Master is here. Everyone, take a break. You and you, bring over some stools and the umbrella over!”

Mu Zixiao remembered his master’s words and rushed out and pulled out the sunshade directly. He ran back to Hong Dali’s side and stood like an iron pillar, his attitude was full of solicitously and sincerity. The nine lackeys at the side saw this and took in deep breaths. He was fighting with them for their job!

By this time, some actors who moved over a few stools. After Hong Dali pulled Tang Muxin with him to sit down, Lin Hao actually took out a bunch of snacks from his pocket and smilingly said, “Young Master, these snacks were brought back from all over as per my request. Please taste it.” Hong Dali was an authentic God of Wealth—he could easily throw out millions of yuan with just a word. As a director, Lin Hao naturally understood what to do.
“Reward!” Hong Dali said. “5000!”
The lackey walked forth and again—PAPAPA—counted out the money. “Young Master’s reward!”
“Thank you, Young Master!” Lin Hao smiled till his eyes folded and kept the money, then obsequiously asked, “What commands do Young Master have for me?”
“Well, nothing much, just that this movie is not in line with its name.” Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “This way, shoot a scene. I will see if there is anything that can be changed.”

“OK!” Lin Hao took the script and introduced today’s plot. “We’re filming the outdoor scene today. The protagonist escaped, fainted in this forest, and halfway along the way, he will be rescued by a female hero. So then it would make sense for them to fall in love.”
“What an old fashioned plot...” Hong Dali twitched his lips and muttered, “No wonder the box office couldn’t go up...”
Since it was the God of Wealth who spoke, the whole crew naturally did not dare to neglect, so they started shooting.

This was a naturally grown forest, silent and quiet, and there were occasional screams of beasts around. And from time to time, there were roars of wild wolves, causing the atmosphere to appear empty yet dangerous.

As the camera moved slowly on the track, shooting the surrounding environment, a guy whose forehead was covered with sweat held a whiteboard, which was to make the light more inefficient during refraction so that the pictures would not produce chromatic aberration.

After a while, the protagonist, who was wearing ancient times costume, stumbled out into the picture, panting heavily. With his clothes stained with blood, he looked very discomposed as he ran and covered a part of his body with his hands. That must be the place in the plot where he was injured.

The actor was quite handsome, but his handsome face was carefully dressed in make-up. Combined with his messy hair, he looked depressed and down. This was obviously to please the female audience—after all, women were all very sentimental and easy to raise the mind to protect the weak.

At this time, Director Lin Hao whispered, “His name is Shen Guanghe. Before that, in some TV dramas, he acted as the younger brother of the heroines, or the protagonist’s trusted friend, and so on. I think he has the face, which is quite suitable for this film. So, I asked him to be the protagonist.”

“I see. He’s acceptable.” Hong Dali cocked his legs and sat on the stool. Touching his chin, he said, “His looks are OK.” Saying so, Hong Dali turned his head and looked Mu Zixiao who was standing holding the sunshade. “Old Xiao, I think you’re much more handsome than this kid.”
Mu Zixiao smiled and said, “Not really, not really.”

Lin Hao also carefully looked at Mu Zixiao and nodded. “He is indeed a lot more handsome than Shen Guanghe, but he does not match the character of the protagonist. A pity, a pity.” Saying so, he shook his head, not forgetting to pick one of the snacks on the table.
At this time, Shen Guanghe ran a few more steps, and then fell to the ground and rolled into a ball.
A braided man at the side shouted, “OK. Bao Feng, you’re up next. Go!”
“...” Hong Dali went silent. The female lead was called Bao Feng?

Sure enough, a woman with a heroic spirit ran from a distance, saw a man on the ground, and suddenly yelled, “Ah!” Then, she rushed forward to help him, not forgetting to shout, “What happened to you? Wake up, wake up!”
She shook him for a while, then Shen Guanghe slowly opened his eyes and weakly said, “Thank... thank you, miss...” and then passed out.
Lin Hao shouted, “Okay, that’s it! Stop!”
“...” Hong was stunned. In the end, he turned to look at Lin Hao. “This is what you filmed for 15 million?”
“Ah?” After listening to Hong’s words, Lin Hao wiped the cold sweat on his head and carefully asked, “Not... not OK?”

“It’s not only not OK!” Hong Dali angrily rapped the table. “Do you thinking you’re fooling some children? Is this story for people to see? Is this something that you suddenly thought of and decided to start filming just like that!?”

Lin Hao was a well-known big director. After listening to Hong Dali’s words, he was quite dissatisfied. He thought in his mind, If you don’t have any money, do you think that you can be better than me in filming?
Of course, he thought so in his heart, but couldn’t say it out loud. Lin Hao carefully asked, “Then, according to Young Master, how should we change the plot?”

Hong Dali said, “The man ran here. It’s OK to faint, but did the woman drop out of the sky? She happened to meet the protagonist just like that? The man has to at least struggle for a while, meet a little fox and the like, follow it and find a cave, and then in there, find a statue of a fairy, leave the cave, and just happen to see the fairy take a bath in the lake or something, right!?

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - Kowtow a Thousand Times
paragraphs: Hong Dali said these words quickly, his saliva was really splattering all over, squirting on Lin Hao’s head and face.

However, Lin Hao did not care about this at all, wiping his face like he was washing it. With a pair of pea-like eyes shining brightly, he fiercely clapped his hands and said, “Yeah! Why did I not think of such a tortuous plot!?” This time, he was really impressed by Hong Dali. “Young Master is awesome! Young Master, why don’t you take a look and see if there are any other things that you would like to change?” At this time, his expression was extremely humble, only thinking of kneeling down and praying to him. He kept shouting in his mind, This is indeed the Young Master who could film something likeUnexpectedly! He is special indeed!

At the side, Tang Muxin grinned and shook Hong Dali’s elbow. “Dali, you’re so awesome to think of something like this! Hehe, went into the cave and met the statue of a fairy, causing admiration to appear in his heart, then went out and saw the fairy showering and was discovered. The two then became a quarrelsome but loving couple—this is indeed much better than the original plot!”

Hong Dali said, “This is what a movie should be like, plus one more thing. There is a praying mat in front of the statue of the fairy. The male lead has to kowtow a thousand times. Then, there is a secret manual of a divine art in the praying mat, called ‘Nine Suns Divine Art’!”

After saying this, Hong Dali smiled and said in his heart, This is the plot in Jin Yong’sDemigods and Semi-Devilsfrom my previous life. I can’t recite the book, and the plot can’t be remembered clearly, but remembering a few classic scenarios and changing them a bit is still no problem!

With such a small plot modification, the quality of the whole movie immediately improved. Now, Lin Hao asked to excuse himself to go arrange for the staff to change the script. However, he had only stretched out one leg when he thought of something. “That... Young Master, can the statue be made of stone? Or shall we just use 3D? Otherwise, if you use jade, this... the cost is a bit too high. You see, such a statue, if we use a real one, it will cost at least 300,000 or so, enough to buy a few cars...”

Hong Dali almost wanted to kick him away. How would the stone be able to reflect the quality of the film? To reflect the grade of the film? To reflect the beauty of the characters? The most important thing was, how could he squander then!? He violently slapped the table and said, “Use the real one! You definitely have to use the real one! The type that has all sorts of colors! Get someone to sculpt it for better viewing! Exquisite looking! I will reimburse you for the money spent on the statue!”

“Yes... Yes...” Young Master was really a master. He couldn’t afford to offend him. Anyway, since he would be reimbursed, then he should just do according to what Hong Dali said. Lin Hao immediately ran off to explain the changes to the story to the actors, but the story couldn’t be taken right away. It would take a few days to build the statue, and this was because only a small part of the face of the statue would be shown when filming. Therefore, it didn’t need to be sculpted too carefully. Another trouble was how to get the fox or bunny—they weren’t easily trained. They had to think of a safe way to solve it. Otherwise, the shooting would have exposed scenes.

After finishing the arrangement, Lin Hao ran back and, pouring a cup of tea, he said, “Young Master, your idea is really good. YourUnexpectedly! had the ‘Nine Suns Divine Fist’ in it—the ‘Nine Suns Divine Art’ that you just mentioned, is it the inner manual of this ‘Nine Suns Divine Fist’? Oh, this way, this film will be a big hit!” As he said this, his thumbs were high up. “Brillant, it’s really brilliant! It’s rare for you to come here, why not you watch another scene?”
“Well...” Hong Dali thought about it. Suddenly, his eyes lit up. “Is it a fighting scene? I love watching fighting scenes!”

“Of course! It will be a fighting scene! I will ask Shen Guanghe to change clothes now!” Now that he was convinced of Hong Dali’s talent, he had to make use of this opportunity to ask as many questions as possible. He directly shouted, “Little Shen, change clothes and prepare for the next shoot! Young Master Dali said that he would like to watch the fighting scene!”

“OK!” Shen Guang, who was already full of sweat, was joyful and acknowledged. Like a gust of wind, he ran off to do his make-up. It was no wonder that he was so excited. The viewing rate of this film was guaranteed to shoot all the way up after Young Master Dali’s change in the plot. Therefore, the benefits he would receive would increase greatly too. If he didn’t behave diligently now, then what time would be more appropriate?

Lin Hao began to tell Hong Dali about the story of this fighting scene. “In this fighting scene, the enemy has caught up and then meets the male lead and starts fighting. After fighting for a while, the female lead also joins the battle.”
It was just a fighting scene, simple and direct—there was nothing much to explain. Lin Hao explained in just a few sentences, and Hong Dali already understood most of it.

When Shen Guanghe had changed into a slightly clean set of clothes, the filming resumed. The design was still the same as the original, but there was no blood. From this point of view, this crew was still very meticulous. After all, in this deep forest, it would be weird if he managed to change to a new set of clothes. Hong Dali gave high praise for that and rewarded each person 1,000 yuan!

The male protagonist came out and practiced martial arts in the woods—that is, the “Nine Suns Divine Art” which was added in by Hong Dali. At this time, the big villain appeared—it was a minor character that looked as perverted as one could get. Very ugly-looking, he held a long blade in his hand as he ran all the way to catch up. Hong Dali mentally collapsed on the spot and slammed the table. “Are you in lack of actors? At least get someone who’s able to be looked at. Even if he’s not some super handsome dude, but the protagonist shouldn’t be someone so ugly looking, OK?”
“Ah?” Lin Hao was surprised. “Why should we get a handsome actor to act as the villain?”
At this time, the fight scene had already started—you punch me I kick you, you cut a with the blade I smash you with the pole...
Hong’s eyes almost burst out. “This is the fighting scene?”

Lin Hao was puzzled and said, “Yes, this is slow motion. When it gets faster, add some light and shadow effects, and bury a bomb around them. When the final effect comes out, it’s booming! It’s very imposing!” As if to prove his words, he especially took out his mobile phone and found a production of a fighting scene for Hong Hong to see. “Young Master, look at this. How about this?”

Hong Dali took a look—you don’t say, it really seemed a bit interesting. But just as Lin Hao was feeling proud, Mu Zixiao, who was beside them, said, “This can also be called Kungfu? Isn’t this all done by computer special effects?”

“Why can’t this be called Kungfu?” Lin Hao was not happy. “This scene was very famous in the whole of the filming industry. At that time, it received high praise, and we even obtained the Best Special Effect Movie Of The Year Award!”
Hong Dali sighed helplessly. “This is really...”

Then, he jumped up fiercely and scared everyone. He said, “You, Director Lin, you help to hold the sunshade! Old Xiao, you and Geezer Wang go and do a practice fight! Make it look good, don’t let others look down on us!”
Mu Zixiao: “OK!”
Geezer Wang: “Sure, I shall display my skills then!”

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - Hong Dali, the Great Conner
paragraphs: Thus, the two stood in the middle of the field, surrounded by a large group of people wanting to see what the legendary proper fighting scene was like.
Soon, the two started to fight.

Once they started, the people around immediately understood what was called an expert. This time, the two were purely performing. Don’t look at how Geezer Wang wasn’t huge in size and was as thin as a monkey. He was very flexible, his whole body fluttering around the Mu Zixiao. As for Mu Zixiao, his style was straightforward and more manly. He also knew that Geezer Wang, his new master, was very nimble, so he was not afraid of hurting him. His fists were ferocious like a tiger. If one didn’t know that they were performing, they would really think that he was practicing the real “Nine Suns Divine Fist”!

After several more exchanges, finally, Mu Zixiao smashed his fist against the old man’s palm, and it was if a wave of energy erupted from the collision. A few sharp-eyed ones could even see the leaves being blown away.

After they were done, the two men returned to Hong Dali’s side, and Mu Zixiao took over the sunshade and held it. Geezer Wang picked up a drink and drank it, his face wrinkled but not red, and not panting at all.
The crew was stunned. Even when the two finished, the crew still had not recovered from their amazement.
“Tip the two of them!” Hong Dali felt great. “Fifty thousand per person!” The lackey—PAPAPA—counted five stacks of money for each of them and then retreated.

Hong Dali pointed at everyone present and said, “Do you see that? Thatis called kungfu. This is our country’s kungfu!” As he said that, he was secretly feeling excited inside his heart. This old man was really powerful! It was worth it for the rearview mirror to be hit!

Hong Dali: “Look at yourselves now, what was it that you guys just showed me? Is it enough just for the special effects to be good? What meaning is there in that? If you want to make a movie, you have to film real kungfu! The real one!”
“Yes, yes, Young Master is right.” Director Lin Hao was completely convinced this time. “Then, according to Young Master...”

“Retake, retake!” Hong Dali directed. “Let Old Xiao replace the villain.” He explained his own theory as beautiful sounded as he could. Anyway, he had the money, they had to follow his orders on how to shoot the film. “The villain is the popular role, you see? In a film, the good guys generally do not clearly display their character, it’s the villains who give a memorable impression!” As he said so, he didn’t forget to secretly say to Mu Zixiao, “Old Xiao, I’m giving you this opportunity to showcase your abilities. I will ask Geezer Wang to act with you. How much you can learn through this opportunity is up to you!”
Mu Zixiao immediately rejoiced. “Thank you, brother. I will definitely return this favor in the future!”

Hong Dali instructed Old Wang, “Geezer Wang, you shall stay with them here these next two days. You have a wide range of kungfu at your disposal. You need to teach them how to perform the fighting scenes. Don’t let them make this film into something like a country bumpkin, their fighting scenes almost made me fall asleep.”
Geezer Wang: “OK, I shall do as what Young Master says!”

Then, Hong Dali began to arrange the plot. “When you’re making a movie, the plot can’t be so straightforward—it has to be tortuous, do you understand? Twists and turns!” He took a sip of the drink and then arranged the plot as if he were just messing around. “Wasn’t the man practicing his kungfu in this forest? At this time, ask the female lead... oh, who is that? The woman, what was her name?”
The girl who previously rescued the protagonist walked up. Looking at Hong Dali, she still felt a bit shy. “I’m here. My name is Bao Feng.”

Hong Dali arranged. “Well, you, first fight with that guy—the sparring kind, not the kind where you kill each other. After all, according to the story I laid out, you took a shower and was seen by him. Plus, the male lead looks not bad, and his character is also quite good. You then seemed to like him a little. You understand what I mean?”

“Ah?” It was just for the film, not the real thing. Bao Feng was a little embarrassed at first, but it quickly turned to relief. “Well, ok, I got it. You mean to pretend to fight with him in order to help him practice his kungfu, right?”

“Correct.” Hong Dali nodded and said, “Then, after you have finished practicing, you have to eat, right? You’re not only good at martial arts but also good at cooking. Have you heard of the beggar’s chicken before?”
“I have.” Bao Feng nodded.

Hong Dali continued, “This time, you cook the beggar’s chicken for the male lead to eat, and then, a martial arts master who was wandering around the world—ah, Geezer Wang—smelled the scent of the beggar’s chicken. Geezer Wang?”
Geezer Wang: “Young Master, I’m here.”
Hong Dali pointed to a big tree not far away, saying, “Are you able to climb up that tree?”
“That one?” Old Wang looked at it. “Should be no problem.”

“Up!” Hong Dali loudly ordered, and instantly, he saw the old man climb the tree like a monkey. Hong Dali’s eyebrows went up as he smiled and said, “Geezer Wang, you are really something. I shall reward you later!”

“It’s simple.” Hong Dali directly said, “The male lead is especially talented, he was able to cultivate and create the ‘Nine Suns Dragon Taming Palm!”

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - I’m Here to Get Hit?
paragraphs: Nine Suns Dragon Taming Palm!

Once he said that, everyone became astonished. Lin Hao expressed that his kneecaps were already given to Hong Dali from kneeling to him in awe. “Young Master is indeed ingenious, your brain is really extraordinary. I’m really impressed!”
Hong Dali proudly said, “This is what you call a movie, a plot! Look at your own plot.”

“Yes, yes, Young Master’s critique of me is correct!” Lin Hao was full of tears. He was, after all, one of the top-notch directors in the country, but he was reprimanded by this Young Master who looked the age to be his grandson. What’s more, he couldn’t deny him—his plot was truly much better than his own!
At this time, Mu Zixiao anxiously asked, “Dali, what about me? When do I come out?”

“Right now!” Hong Dali slammed the table, just as if he were a storyteller. “The male lead’s martial art has made some progress, what does he need now? Of course, he needs a villain for him to defeat!” Hong Dali cheekily laughed and said, “Therefore, the extremely handsome Old Xiao—the villain—will then make an entrance!”
“I will appear just to get beat up?” Mu Zixiao’s tears and mucus almost flowed out. “Can I have another job?”

“NO!” Hong Dali evilly said, “At this moment, you, who was always very arrogant, will jump out and receive a good beat up. Then, you will return home and diligently train yourself and master the super powerful martial art technique, ‘Divine Sunflower Art,’ and prepare for revenge!”

“OK! I will do it!” Mu Zixiao slapped his leg, then looked at Geezer Wang who was on the tree. “Master! At that time, you must teach me some special moves! Whether your disciple beat someone or gets beat up will all depend on you...”

By now, Hong Dali had finished with this part of the scene. Director Lin Hao’s eyes lit up as he listened. “Genius, genius indeed! This is what the plot should be like! Young Master, I’m totally impressed with you now! Why not you change the rest of the plot as well?”
“That shall do for today.” Hong Dali rubbed his stomach. “I’m hungry. I shall be going off to get some food now, you guys can continue first.”

“This... alright.” Lin Hao definitely did not wish for Hong Dali to leave, but he couldn’t do anything because Hong Dali was a Big Young Master of a prestigious family. Also, he had heard that Hong Dali was very fragile since young. He didn’t dare to force Hong Dali and could only send him off. “Then, take your time and mind your steps. And don’t get a cold, the air in this May period is really cold!”

“I know, I will come over tomorrow if there’s nothing much to do.” Hong Dali stood up and gave a long yawn. “Ah, Geezer Wang and Old Xiao, the two of you shall stay here and film the movie. I’m going to get some food first, then change places to play in the afternoon.”
Mu Zixiao gratefully said, “Then, I wish you a safe voyage! If you need anything, just call me. I will arrive immediately!”
“I got it, remember to go soft on your fist later.” Hong Dali waved goodbye. “Don’t injure that male lead.”
“My master will be here, don’t worry!” Mu Zixiao sent him off.

Now that Hong Dali had spoken, the nine lackeys opened the path for him. Hong Dali brought Tang Muxin with him up the car, and she continued to ask him for the rest of the story. “Dali, what happens next? Can you please tell me? I’m really curious!” At this moment, she was really like a little girl who was acting coquettishly towards her boyfriend.
But a story plot wasn’t something that came just because you want it to. Hong Dali helplessly shrugged and said, “I haven’t thought of the rest of the plot yet...”

“Then... fine...” Tang Muxin also knew that some things couldn’t be forced. Since Hong Dali said that he hadn’t thought of it, then he must be telling the truth. Anyway, today was the weekend. Tang Muxin tapped her lips and said, “Dali, shouldn’t we think about ‘I Am a Singer’ now? According to the time, there are only three days left before the show starts, right?”

Previously, when planning “I Am a Singer,” Hong Dali feared that there would be too many people if it were on the weekend. Therefore, he decided for the show to be aired on every Tuesday, starting at 8:00 PM. If it were on the weekend, just because of Caiwei Entertainment’s reputation, countless people would be willing to travel long distances to watch the show. Hong Dali had already seen online that a “Goddess Alliance” who claimed to have over a million members said that Li Nianwei would appear onstage as a guest. Just this news alone would cause countless people to willingly come. Hong Dali didn’t want so many people to come to the extent that one couldn’t even enter the venue due to the crowd.
Fake news was really harmful...

“By right, they should be ready by now.” Hong Dali thought for a while and then shook his head. “But I keep having the feeling that something seems to be missing.” As he says so, he muttered, “Xinxin, think of it. This ‘I Am a Singer’ have several stages, we can’t let the viewership rating be too terrible to look at. We should think of something to attract audiences. Otherwise, our reputation will be destroyed—I still think that I’m not squandering enough!”
“Still not enough!?” Tang Muxin’s eyes opened wide. “You have already thrown 5 million in, is that not enough for you!?”

“That is, of course, not enough.” Hong Dali said so matter of factly. “This ‘I Am a Singer’ has ten stages, and every two stages one singer will change. In total, there will be at least ten plus singers participating. If the show is too small scale, the first few stages are not interesting enough, and no one watches the later stages, wouldn’t that be embarrassing?”

Tang Muxin casually calculated—if there were ten stages, it seemed that only 500 or 600 thousand were used for each stage. Even if it were because some stuff would require money every time, the budget still seemed quite low...
Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “But, which aspect can still allow me to squander... Forget it, let’s not think about this anymore. Let’s go and eat first, our stomachs are more important!”
North of Tianjing City, outskirts, Forest Medical Enterprise.
A dusky private room.
A person sitting on a chair spoke in a deep voice, “How is it at the Tang Medical Enterprise?”

A person standing opposite him respectfully said, “Everything is going well so far, just that Tang Ruisi went out this afternoon. He seems to have gone to Chenhui Building, but I’m not sure what it was for. I was afraid to expose myself, so I didn’t dare to follow him there.”

“Chenhui Building?” The seated person thought for a while and said, “That place is the domain of Hong Dali, the prodigal from the Hong Family. You were right in not following him there. If you were exposed, it would not be good. Tang Ruisi’s daughter is walking very close to Hong Dali recently. I reckon that he went there not for something to do with work, don’t concern yourself with him. Just pay attention to Tang Ruisi’s laboratory. Hmph, he thinks he can overcome me just by developing a new medicine to prevent the formation of blood clot—it isn’t so easy.”
“Currently, everything is normal at the laboratory.” The person standing smiled and said, “Tang Ruisi totally never guessed that it was me.”

“Of course, he never guessed that it was you. You have followed him for ten plus years, it would be weird if he guessed that you are the traitor.” The person seating laughed and said, “Speaking of which, he’s really silly, wasting so much effort to develop this new medicine—he really has nothing better to do. If it were not because of this, I wouldn’t have the opportunity to beat him down. I wonder what is wrong with him. It’s much better to just sell his medicines—the reward is high, and there are no risks involved.”
“This...” The person standing hesitated before slowly saying, “I heard that it was to develop something to benefit the human society. Whatever it is, his reason is for some noble cause.”

“Ridiculous!” The persons seated disdainfully said, “In this society, earning money is the right thing to do! What use is there for nobleness?” After saying so, he got impatient and waved his hand. “OK, I don’t care about this other stuff. Once his new medicine has been developed, bring it to me first instance, do you hear?”
“I got it.”

The person standing went out, leaving only the seated person inside. He lit a cigarette and violently sucked in, laughing cheekily. “Nobleness? Rubbish! Isn’t it just doing all the work for me, brouhaha!”
