chapters.title: Chapter 131 - Can Only Squander Money, but Not Earn It!
paragraphs: Xinhai Weipo, which had the most number of online users in the country.

Penghui Films Lin Hao: “I’m very sorry to inform all of the audiences that because of some special reason, The Gale Flashwill be going under a remake. At the same time, the name of the film is still in discussion. We predict that the time of release will be delayed and hope that all of the film lovers will forgive us.”

After this message was released online, Lin Hao secretly laughed to himself.Hehe, now that I said this, those film lovers will definitely be curious. Then, I shall just post a few of the new scenes. That will definitely blow off their minds, won’t it?

Indeed, after his message was posted for less than ten minutes, many film lovers saw it, and some of them scolded him, while others curiously asked for the reason. Whatever the case, this topic had been hyped up. The number of people forwarding the message and discussing it increased crazily. Just an hour or so later, there were already 300,000 plus forwards, and it was still on the rise.
Spectator one: “Director Lin, what was the reason for the delay? My girlfriend and I were waiting just for this film.”
Spectator two: “Director Lin, you have to hold yourself to your words. What do you mean now by bouncing on your check?”
Spectator three: “Everyone, relax, I believe that Director Lin will definitely give us an answer. Just wait for it.”
Spectator four to Spectator N: “Everyone, don’t fret, we believe that Director Lin will give us a reason!”

As for Lin Hao, he was seated on his chair, eating snacks and looking at the replies on Weipo. Seeing that this topic had already entered the ranks of Weipo’s list of hottest topics, he had already held them in suspense for long enough. Now, it was time to throw in the bomb. “Everyone, don’t fret. The reason for the delay was because of the guide from a mystery man. Spectator one: “Mystery man? Who? He can actually guide you?”
Spectator two: “Exactly. Director Lin, you’re already one of the most famous big directors in the country, who would dare to say he can teach you?”

Spectator four: “The producer fromUnexpectedly! actually had such big means. I’m his most devoted follower now!”
Spectator five: “This is my kneecap for a year. Director Lin, please keep it!”

The secretary: “Sir, the number of bookmarks for these books are rising faster and faster. They have already exceeded the 80,000 mark.”

The secretary: “We already used 700,000, the result was obvious. What should we do next?”

Zhang Wenyang said, “What’s not nice about this? Once their net worth increases, other authors will be willing to come over to our website. The more authors there are, the more readers there are. Oh right, release another news saying that our Zhong Dian website has twenty God-level nouveau riche. As long as they like what the authors write, that author will become the next Great God!”

The secretary: “All... alright...” He paused before asking again, “Oh right. Director, there’s another matter. Now, there are quite a number of companies that want to post their advertisements on our website. And the price isn’t low, either. Director Yang was asking whether we should accept them?”
“Reject them!” Zhang Wenyang decided without a second thought. “Reject all of them. Young Master has carefully instructed me before that we’re only allowed to spend money but not earn it!”
“All... alright...”
Turkey Bookstore, big conference room.

“Director Zheng, these few days Young Master Mingcheng seem to be down on his spirits, shouldn’t we think of something to boost our performance to help him cheer up?” A man wearing glasses asked. “These few days, quite a number of companies wanted to put their advertisements on Zhong Dian website but were rejected. Now, they have all come over to us, should we accept them?”

Director Zheng, who had a Mediterranean hairstyle, said, “Those fools, they even push away money. Haha, accept them, why shouldn’t we? Accept all of them! Have you counted how much these advertisements will earn us?”
Now that Director Zheng had spoken, the rest all nodded in agreement.
The cost of advertisements wasn’t small. The money was already sent to their doorsteps, yet they still pushed them away... their brains must have really been sandwiched by the door before.

The man with glasses said, “Currently, there are about 20 plus companies. They saw that the literary network is doing very well now. Therefore, the prices they offered are all quite high. Some are paying two cents per click, while others pay three cents per click. There are even those offering five cents per click.”
Hearing this amount, Director Zheng’s eyes lit up. He laughed and said, “This is great! How much IP do we have currently?”
The man with glasses said, “The daily IP is about 1,200,000.”

“OK, 1,200,000.” Director Zheng smiled and said, “Even if the probability is one to every hundred, in one day there will be 12,000 clicks. Even if it’s fewer, there will be around 10,000 clicks. Those advertisements with fewer clicks will have around 200, and those with more will be around 500 clicks. There are about 20 or so companies. Taking a round number, let’s just say 20 companies. One day will be at least 5,000 yuan, one month that will be 150,000, one year 1,800,000. This is acceptable, definitely acceptable!” Having calculated these numbers, Director Zheng immediately decided: “Accept all of them! Then, inform Young Master Mingcheng, let him be happy too!”
An advertisement fee of 150,000 per month wasn’t a small number.
The man with glasses recorded down his instructions and said, “Then, I shall go and inform the technical branch to add in the advertisements now.”
One hour later.

A reader was reading a novel, but just as he went to the next page—PAPAPA—popped out three new windows. He was instantly alarmed. “What the heck, has my computer gotten some virus or something!? Why are there so many advertisements?”
He hurriedly closed the windows and started checking for the virus. After a long while, the reader said, “There isn’t any virus, but how come there are so many advertisements?”
When he opened Turkey Bookstore again, another three advertisements popped up. “What the heck, what is this? Why are there so many advertisements? This can’t do, I need to ask around.”
Inside the readers’ group.
Reader one: “Hey, do your computers have advertisements popping up when you open the webpage? How come I get three every time? Also, the main page is also full of advertisements!”
Reader two: “What the heck, you too? I thought my computer had gotten a virus or something. I just cleaned the virus, but it was still the same.”
Reader three: “Damn it, how are we supposed to read our novels now? There are even more advertisements than novels now, damn it!”

Reader four: “Forget it, there are so many online sites available, why must we stick to this one. I heard that there are five Great Gods over at Zhong Dian website, each of them earning a million yuan a year. Their novels are awesome and fabulous. I shall go and take a look!”
Reader five: “I have seen their books, they’re really quite well written. I shall just read novels over there from now on.”
Two hours later.
Zhong Dian website, Director’s office.

The secretary: “Director Yang, our website had quite a number of new individual IPs coming in today. There’s about 10 to 20 thousand of them, and it’s still increasing. Added to the increase in IPs from before, we have about 30 to 40 increase in IPs every day for this period.”
Director Yang: “Have you checked the reason behind the sudden increase?”

The secretary gulped down his saliva and said, “The technical branch secretly asked a few of those new accounts, and after careful asking... it was because they couldn’t stand the advertisements in Turkey Bookstore, coupled with the fact that they liked the books from the five Great Gods that Young Master liked. So, they came over. Quite a number of them have already charged up their account and gave rewards, and the rest is also preparing to read the legal VIP chapters.”
Director Yang rested his whole body on the sofa. “I’m convinced of Young Master’s tactics now, I’m really convinced. Even this kind of tactic also works...”

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - Holographic Projection Technology
paragraphs: Chenhui Building, level nine. Hong Dali’s head was resting upon Li Nianwei’s thigh as he flipped his body to the other side in a daze. Without opening his eyes, he asked, “Sister Nianwei, what time is it now?”
Li Nianwei gently tidied his messy hair, smiled and said, “It’s already past 2:00 PM. Are you getting up now?”

Hong Dali got up stretched. “Oh, it’s already past two? Well, I shall get up then. Sigh, I’m really bored, I can’t think of any ideas to squander right now. I can’t risk spoiling the reputation of ‘I Am a Singer,’ and I’m also too lazy to go out.”

Li Nianwei gently said, “Young Master, you don’t have to be too concerned over this. The setting for the stage is already on a very grand scale now. The lighting and whatnots are already in the testing stage. If not, you can add some lighting on the stage floor too?”
“Let me think about it. Yup...” As he said so, he lay down again, changed sides and said, “Let me sleep a while more.”

Just as he was half awake and half dreaming, aDUsound came from under his shirt. In a daze, Hong Dali stretched out his hand to feel the item. “Hm, what’ this? I’m pressing upon my cell phone?” But when he touched the item, he immediately came fully awake. “Damn! How did I press against this thing!?”
He took out the item and placed it upon his palm. After confirming what it was, he was totally depressed—he had pressed onto the transmitter that Lin Chuyin gave to him last time.

“Oh no, I’m dead. This time, I have totally screwed up!” Hong Dali instantly stood up and walked around in panic. “This is for emergencies and could save my life, how did I accidentally pressed against it? What should I say to Chuyin when she comes? I pressed upon it when I was sleeping? She will kill me!”
Just as he was panicking, Tang Muxin, who was playing badminton with Zhang Cai by the side, saw him and curiously asked, “Dali, you have gotten up? Why are you going around in circles?”

Hong Dali nervously said, “Xinxin, hurry, help me think of an idea! I accidentally pressed the transmitter that Chuyin gave to me! The transmitter! The one that she claimed she will appear before me in ten minutes after pressing it!”

“What!” Tang Muxin was so shocked that she dropped her racket. She rushed up to Hong Dali and anxiously said, “Then, we must quickly think of something. Chuyin has always stayed true to her words—if she said ten minutes, then she will definitely reach in ten minutes. Furthermore, her house isn’t far from here. We must quickly think of an excuse. If she knew that you pressed it because you were sleeping, she would definitely be angry!”
“She will be angry? Isn’t she deprived of any emotions?” Hong Dali asked in surprise.
Tang Muxin nervously said, “She will consider those that wasted her time to be her enemies and will attack them! Whatever the case, we must think of an excuse. But, what excuse can we use?”

“Don’t fret, calm down. Actually, she’s quite a nice person.” Instead, Hong Dali wasn’t as nervous as she was. He scratched his head, thought for a while, and said, “Previously, I lent her the Virtual Reality Projection technology—she seemed quite happy with it. Why not, yup, why not we just ask her what she did with it?”
Tang Muxin nervously said, “How could she be concerned with such a boring question. Let’s think of something together!”

The two of them pondered for a long while. Seeing that it was almost ten minutes, at the last few moments, Hong Dali suddenly had an idea flash past his mind. He violently clapped and said, “I have thought of something! I came up with an ingenious idea!”
Just at this moment, a cold and clear voice sounded from behind them. “I’m here.”

Hong Dali and the others turned around and saw a girl with blue hair tied into two ponytails that hung down all the way to her bottom. Her figure was slim, and her chest slightly flat. She wore a trumpet sleeve styled shirt, a miniskirt, black stockings, and a pair of leather shoes. Her eyes were big and bright, and her face extremely pretty. She was the Blood Consort, Lin Chuyin.

Seeing that the Blood Consort bad arrived, everyone’s heart started racing. After all, facing this super dangerous technological geek, no one would know when she would suddenly flare up. But Hong Dali grinningly ran up to her, as if he didn’t have any concerns. As he ran, he said, “You’re finally here, I was getting nervous that you wouldn’t come!”
Lin Chuyin’s face was expressionless as she blandly asked, “What did you ask me here for?”

When Hong Dali stood in front of her, he carefully asked, “I have a great idea regarding the Virtual Reality Projection technology that I lent you. I didn’t have your contact number, so I could only ask of you to come here personally. Do you want to hear me out?”
“I approve.” Lin Chuyin nodded.

Hong Dali squatted down and used his finger to draw on the floor. “Simply speaking, this is the case. For example, me. If I wear the suit, I will be able to see myself on the desktop, is that right? My plan is to we use lighting to create a projection. In that case, would the image we see be similar to real humans, and have the lighting effect?”
When Hong Dali finished his sentence, everyone around was stunned.
Tang Muxin exclaimed in surprise, “Dali, how did you come up with this idea? This idea is fabulous!”
Hong Dali smiled and said, “That’s for sure. As a professional prodigal, how could I do without some sort of creativity, hehe.”

Lin Chuyin spoke too. “Oh, I have already been researching on that. Currently, I can only create single color projections. As for multi-colors, that’s still in the research process. The degree of progress now is 46%, it will soon be completed finished.”
When she finished speaking, everyone was astonished.

Previously, they didn’t think much of this technology that Hong Dali bought, thinking that he did it solely for the purpose of squandering. But now, hearing this, in the hands of people like Lin Chuyin, the things that it could do...
They couldn’t even imagine, it was out of their imagination!

She was indeed a technological geek, her ability in this area was very strong. It was not a wonder that no one dared to offend her in the whole Tianjing City. Even that Big Young Master Liu Mingxin also avoided her. This kind of talent wasn’t on the level of just business and economics anymore, but whole nations.
Hong Dali couldn’t be bothered with what level she was on. He was frantic. “You have already developed that!? It has only been a few days! Does this piece of technology have a name?”
Lin Chuyin cocked her head and asked, “A name? It’s fine just to be able to use it, why would it need a name?”

Hong Dali was depressed. After a long while, he squatted down and drew circles on the floor. “Fine, this is indeed proving the saying that there is always a mountain higher... I can only kneel to her now... That is, after all, a new piece of technology. You have to at least name it to show how high class it is, right?”
Lin Chuyin said, “Oh. You can name it, I don’t have any objections.”
Naming a new piece of technology, what kind of honor that would be!

Tang Muxin’s breathing got heavier as she grabbed Hong Dali’s sleeve and softly said, “Dali, Sister Blood Consort asked you to name it. Then, you should name it. You have to think carefully. Hong Dali’s head was resting upon Li Nianwei’s thigh as he flipped his body to the other side in a daze.
Without opening his eyes, he asked, “Sister Nianwei, what time is it now?”
Li Nianwei gently tidied his messy hair, smiled and said, “It’s already past 2:00 PM.
Are you getting up now?”
Hong Dali got up stretched.
“Oh, it’s already past two?
Well, I shall get up then.
Sigh, I’m really bored, I can’t think of any ideas to squander right now.

In a daze, Hong Dali stretched out his hand to feel the item.
“Hm, what’ this?
I’m pressing upon my cell phone?” But when he touched the item, he immediately came fully awake.
“Damn!

He took out the item and placed it upon his palm.
After confirming what it was, he was totally depressed—he had pressed onto the transmitter that Lin Chuyin gave to him last time.
“Oh no, I’m dead.
This time, I have totally screwed up!” Hong Dali instantly stood up and walked around in panic.
“This is for emergencies and could save my life, how did I accidentally pressed against it?
What should I say to Chuyin when she comes?
I pressed upon it when I was sleeping?
She will kill me!”
Just as he was panicking, Tang Muxin, who was playing badminton with Zhang Cai by the side, saw him and curiously asked, “Dali, you have gotten up?
Why are you going around in circles?”
Hong Dali nervously said, “Xinxin, hurry, help me think of an idea!
I accidentally pressed the transmitter that Chuyin gave to me!
The transmitter!
The one that she claimed she will appear before me in ten minutes after pressing it!”
“What!” Tang Muxin was so shocked that she dropped her racket.
She rushed up to Hong Dali and anxiously said, “Then, we must quickly think of something.
Chuyin has always stayed true to her words—if she said ten minutes, then she will definitely reach in ten minutes.
Furthermore, her house isn’t far from here.
We must quickly think of an excuse.
If she knew that you pressed it because you were sleeping, she would definitely be angry!”
“She will be angry?
Isn’t she deprived of any emotions?” Hong Dali asked in surprise.
Tang Muxin nervously said, “She will consider those that wasted her time to be her enemies and will attack them!
Whatever the case, we must think of an excuse.
But, what excuse can we use?”

Actually, she’s quite a nice person.” Instead, Hong Dali wasn’t as nervous as she was.

Tang Muxin nervously said, “How could she be concerned with such a boring question.
Let’s think of something together!”

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - Villains Collude Together
paragraphs: As Hong Dali and his gang rushed down the stairs, Lin Chuyin had already boarded her super-sports car, the engine giving off a low roar, and the exhaust spurting out sparks. Just once one look at it would cause people to back off.

But as the saying goes, curiosity killed the cat. Now that there was an opportunity to view her creations, Hong Dali and his gang couldn’t be concerned over their safety anymore. It was unlikely for them to be attacked by Lin Chuyin unless they attacked her first. Everyone boarded their car and followed behind her, creating quite a majestic scene. Lin Chuyin’s super-sports car was at the front, followed by three Prayer Angels and one Soaring Angel.

The commoners who were unaware of what was going on all pointed at them, saying, “Quick, look. Are they filming a sci-fi movie? We better stay out of their way, in case we get caught on camera. Otherwise, they will have to reshoot. That will be a lot of money wasted!”
Lin Chuyin’s laboratory was located at the boundary of the west and the north of the Second Loop. It was one of the rare locations where the population wasn’t too densely populated.

Her laboratory was located in the basement of a two-story, single building that came with a garden. As everyone took the stairs down, the environment got darker and creepy. Hong Dali and his gang all felt their body going numb as if they were walking into a horror scene only seen in horror movies.
As for Lin Chuyin, she didn’t feel any sense of discomfort. She brought everyone to a metal door and pressed her thumb against a detector, causing the door to slowly open.
Once they got inside, Hong Dali and the rest scanned through the room and were totally dazzled by what they saw.

The laboratory wasn’t very big, occupying a space of only 100 square meters or so. All kinds of machinery and devices were randomly scattered around the room. Sockets, electric cables, generators, steel plates, computers, pincers, spanners, and so son. Basically, almost anything related to science and technology could be found here. Other than those, there was a single bed that was considerably clean in the corner of the room. There was also a washing cubicle at the back of the room. Other than these, there was nothing else.
Hong Dali was astonished. His eyes opened wide and asked, “Chuyin, is this your, your laboratory?”
Lin Chuyin brought them further in, kicking the spanners and stuff to the side. “Is there a problem? This place is very good, I like it a lot.”
Hong Dali almost went into a frantic tizzy. “But isn’t this room too messy!? At least get a bigger room and a few assistants and stuff!”
Lin Chuyin felt weird and asked, “Why would I need those? I’m fine by myself.”

Disregarding those strange and funny inventions, Hong Dali tempted her as if he were a demon in disguise. “With a bigger house, you can develop bigger machinery such as Gundam and such, wouldn’t that feel great? In such a small place like this, you could only make small objects, right? If you’re afraid that that will be too troublesome, why don’t we do this? I will be in charge of the money, and you the technology. You can invent whatever you like, and if I have any good ideas, I will also tell you. What do you think?”
Tang Muxin, who was at the side, was amazed. Wasn’t that akin to abducting and selling her off? Abducting a technological geek with an intelligence quotient of 180!
Lin Chuyin cocked her head and asked, “What benefits are there? Is it really a good idea?”

“It’s a very good idea! Definitely a very good idea!” Hong Dali started walking around the room in circles, excitedly gesturing with his hands and continuing to corrupt her mind with his demonic voice. “Think about it, an enormous laboratory! All types of machinery and equipment that you need will be there! With just a word from you, any material that you need will be brought to you as fast as possible! You don’t have to worry about those at all! All you need to do is to unleash your potential and earn back all the wasted time! As for me, I’m a professional prodigal. I will be responsible for sponsoring you! How does that sound?”
Lin Chuyin thought for a while and said, “Hm, that does sound like a good idea. OK.”
Hong Dali was so excited that he jumped on his feet. “Hahaha! That’s the way to go! So, we will be partners from now all, right?”
Lin Chuyin expressed curiosity about this phrase. “What do partners mean? Is there a specific meaning?”

Hong Dali had to admit, this question was really difficult to answer straight away. He thought for a while before explaining, “There’s a phrase in our country that says the Wolf and Bei1will collude together, have you heard of it?”

Lin Chuyin was akin to a Chinese dictionary. “I have heard of it. The Wolf and Bei set out together to hunt other animals. The Wolf uses its forelegs while the Bei uses its back legs. They can run fast together and also climb high. It means to collude together and do something evil.”
Hong Dali snapped his fingers. “Correct! This is the meaning!”
Everyone instantly collapsed.
They really had an eye-opener today. This was the first time they heard someone using this phrase to describe himself...
But they had to admit, Lin Chuyin actually was convinced by him. Her tone wasn’t as cold as before. “Hm, OK. Then, next time if I need something, I will ask from you directly.”
For a genius without a single emotional cell, being able to say something like this was already something that she had never done before.

Hong Dali grinned and replied, “No problem! Rest assured, I bought quite a few mountains in the outer area of Tianjing Mountain. I will specially allocate one for you. I will find one that’s large in size, and dig a hole and make a laboratory for you! Then, we shall use those type ‘Open Sesame’2doors—the type that’s sound controlled. When we say ‘Open Sesame,’ the door will open by itself!” The more he said, the more excited he was. “Then, once we enter, all types of high-end machinery will be there, a large group of technical assistants in white robes will assist you. Whatever you need, someone will bring it to you directly! If you’re afraid that your secrets might leak out, we can just use robots instead—but maybe robots might be a bit difficult to get...”
The current Hong Dali was like a salesperson, even a Stoneman could be persuaded by him...

Indeed, Lin Chuyin’s brain circuit seemed different from an ordinary person’s. She didn’t consider the fact that Hong Dali was luring her to bond herself to him, she only felt that such a laboratory did indeed sound like a good idea. Thus, she directly agreed. “OK.”
Thus, in the history of mankind, the first case of abducting a highly intelligent technological talent appeared.

Speaking of which, it was really due to Hong Dali’s good luck. The country treated Lin Chuyin as a treasure and only thought of how to attract her to join their state-owned research base. As for Hong Dali, the only thing that he thought of was how fast he could spend money with Lin Chuyin on his side. The outset was different, causing the effect to be different as well. Therefore, Hong Dali succeeded just like that...
As for Tang Muxin, Li Nianwei and the rest, other than sighing, all they could do was just to be totally impressed with Hong Dali—it looks like squandering was really a skill!
Now that everything had been decided, Hong Dali grinned and asked, “Chuyin, that technology that you successfully created, let us take a look. I suddenly had a fabulous idea!”

“OK.” Now that the two were colluding together like the Wolf and Bei, Lin Chuyin was considerably more open to Hong Dali’s suggestions. She instantly walked to a corner of the laboratory and pulled a set of lighting equipment from a pile of items.
“Pull” was really the word to use. This set of equipment that was very valuable in the ordinary person’s eye was just part of a pile of rubbish-like pieces...

As she set up the equipment, she explained the concept behind it to them. “Everyone has two eyes, and each eye’s viewpoint is about 80 degrees. But combined together, the total perspective is only 120 degrees. Meaning to say that there are about 40 degrees that overlap. Therefore, the left and right eyes are actually seeing different things. According to this theory, combined with some special light source treatment, this Holographic Projection Technology was created.”

When speaking about science and technology, her vocabulary obviously increased. They could even hear a tone of “regret” in her voice. “It’s a pity that I have yet to get my hands on the colored projection lighting equipment. Thus, this technology can only consider half completed.”

“It’s fine even if it’s only half completed. As for that equipment, I will ask Xiaoyi to get it for you.” Currently speaking, Hong Dali had both the manpower and money, such stuff wasn’t any difficulty for him. “Quick, let us see the effects. Ahhh, I’m really looking forward to it!”
Soon after, Lin Chuyin finished with her preparations. Moving to one side, she turned off the light.
Instantly, the whole laboratory went dark—they couldn’t see their own fingers if they stretched out their hand.

When Lin Chuyin turned on the switch for the Holographic Projection Technology, very quickly, a few blurry light rays appeared. From the surrounding darkness, first, a few sparks of light appeared, as if they were stars in the sky, but in their hands’ reach.
Hong Dali and the rest were astonished, and Tang Muxin even curiously stretched out her hand, trying to touch those cute little stars.
Of course, she couldn’t touch it.

The stars lit up for a while, then, the sound of flowing water sounded. A piece of light blue watery-like light appeared around them, slowly flowing. After a while, there actually appeared a few small bluefish inside, happily swimming around.
Tang Muxin exclaimed, “So beautiful!”

Li Nianwei was so surprised that she covered her mouth. She was of the gentle and composed type, but seeing such a scene still caused her to be so stunned that she couldn’t control herself. Out of instinct, she stretched her hand, trying to touch this picture in front of her.
Unsurprisingly, her hand passed through the images.
It was something expected, yet at the same time, it also seemed a bit eerie and weird.

The whole process lasted for about five minutes. Then, Lin Chuyin turned on the light for the laboratory and switched off the Holographic Projection Technology. Then, she said towards Hong Dali, “This is how much I have completed so far. If you need it, just take it.”

“Seriously!?” This was a big surprise. Hong Dali was certain that if this set of equipment appeared on stage, it would cause a big commotion! Thinking of this, Hong Dali was so excited that he almost jumped up. “You’re indeed my good partner, hahaha! This is good, this is good! But Chuyin, If I take away this set of equipment, how are you going to continue developing it?”
Lin Chuyin indifferently said, “I can just make another set. It’s very simple.”

She didn’t consider the fact that Hong Dali was luring her to bond herself to him, she only felt that such a laboratory did indeed sound like a good idea.
Thus, she directly agreed.
“OK.”
Thus, in the history of mankind, the first case of abducting a highly intelligent technological talent appeared.
Speaking of which, it was really due to Hong Dali’s good luck.
The country treated Lin Chuyin as a treasure and only thought of how to attract her to join their state-owned research base.
As for Hong Dali, the only thing that he thought of was how fast he could spend money with Lin Chuyin on his side.
The outset was different, causing the effect to be different as well.
Therefore, Hong Dali succeeded just like that...
As for Tang Muxin, Li Nianwei and the rest, other than sighing, all they could do was just to be totally impressed with Hong Dali—it looks like squandering was really a skill!
Now that everything had been decided, Hong Dali grinned and asked, “Chuyin, that technology that you successfully created, let us take a look.
I suddenly had a fabulous idea!”
“OK.” Now that the two were colluding together like the Wolf and Bei, Lin Chuyin was considerably more open to Hong Dali’s suggestions.
She instantly walked to a corner of the laboratory and pulled a set of lighting equipment from a pile of items.
“Pull” was really the word to use.
This set of equipment that was very valuable in the ordinary person’s eye was just part of a pile of rubbish-like pieces...
As she set up the equipment, she explained the concept behind it to them.
“Everyone has two eyes, and each eye’s viewpoint is about 80 degrees.
But combined together, the total perspective is only 120 degrees.
Meaning to say that there are about 40 degrees that overlap.
Therefore, the left and right eyes are actually seeing different things.
According to this theory, combined with some special light source treatment, this Holographic Projection Technology was created.”
When speaking about science and technology, her vocabulary obviously increased.
They could even hear a tone of “regret” in her voice.
“It’s a pity that I have yet to get my hands on the colored projection lighting equipment.
Thus, this technology can only consider half completed.”
“It’s fine even if it’s only half completed.
As for that equipment, I will ask Xiaoyi to get it for you.” Currently speaking, Hong Dali had both the manpower and money, such stuff wasn’t any difficulty for him.
“Quick, let us see the effects.
Ahhh, I’m really looking forward to it!”
Soon after, Lin Chuyin finished with her preparations.
Moving to one side, she turned off the light.
Instantly, the whole laboratory went dark—they couldn’t see their own fingers if they stretched out their hand.
When Lin Chuyin turned on the switch for the Holographic Projection Technology, very quickly, a few blurry light rays appeared.
From the surrounding darkness, first, a few sparks of light appeared, as if they were stars in the sky, but in their hands’ reach.
Hong Dali and the rest were astonished, and Tang Muxin even curiously stretched out her hand, trying to touch those cute little stars.
Of course, she couldn’t touch it.
The stars lit up for a while, then, the sound of flowing water sounded.
A piece of light blue watery-like light appeared around them, slowly flowing.
After a while, there actually appeared a few small bluefish inside, happily swimming around.
Tang Muxin exclaimed, “So beautiful!”
Li Nianwei was so surprised that she covered her mouth.
She was of the gentle and composed type, but seeing such a scene still caused her to be so stunned that she couldn’t control herself.
Out of instinct, she stretched her hand, trying to touch this picture in front of her.
Unsurprisingly, her hand passed through the images.
It was something expected, yet at the same time, it also seemed a bit eerie and weird.
The whole process lasted for about five minutes.
Then, Lin Chuyin turned on the light for the laboratory and switched off the Holographic Projection Technology.
Then, she said towards Hong Dali, “This is how much I have completed so far.
If you need it, just take it.”
“Seriously!?” This was a big surprise.
Hong Dali was certain that if this set of equipment appeared on stage, it would cause a big commotion!
Thinking of this, Hong Dali was so excited that he almost jumped up.
“You’re indeed my good partner, hahaha!
This is good, this is good!
But Chuyin, If I take away this set of equipment, how are you going to continue developing it?”
Lin Chuyin indifferently said, “I can just make another set.
It’s very simple.”

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - When Dali Produces Something, It Must Be The Best!
paragraphs: “En...” Hong Dali had no doubts about Lin Chuyin’s abilities. He touched his chin and said, “Chuyin, the reason why I wanted to find you today was that I have figured out a brilliant idea.”
“Please do say.” Lin Chuyin responded.

“Think about it. Currently, this can only produce animals, right?” Hong Dali laughed and said, “Remember the Virtual Reality Projection Technology? We can find someone who can dance to put on that dress before recording all of her actions on the computer, and then show it using this technology. What do you think about it? Isn’t it very good?”
After Hong Dali said his piece, the others became shocked.
By doing so, he was intending to move the characters from the virtual world to reality!

Tang Muxin’s pair of eyes shone like the stars. She desperately shook Hong Dali’s and said, “Dali, you’re really capable to be able to think of such a plan! I think this plan is really good. By following the action of the person in reality, and editing the character’s outlook on the computer, before using Sister Blood Consort’s technology to release it, wow! Doesn’t that mean we can even produce a movie?!”
Hong Dali smiled and answered, “Of course. Although producing a movie is unrealistic, using it for a concert is definitely not a problem!”
Li Nianwei nodded her head and said, “En, I only need to find someone to make some songs, and it will be ready. I’m really looking forward to it now.”

Zhang Cai, who was standing by the side, secretly sighed, Sure enough, Young Master’s ideas are always unpredictable. Any idea he comes up with has an unparalleled commercial value. Holographic Projection Technology with Virtual Reality Projection Technology. The effect that can be produced is really unimaginable. When he first bought the Virtual Reality Projection Technology, I thought that the money was wasted. However, looking at it now, it can bring back in many folds in return. Ai, the only regret is that the Young Master doesn’t seem to care very much about making money. Otherwise...After thinking about it, she shook her head again.However, if the Young Master wants to make money, he would not be the Young Master we know anymore. Maybe it’s because of this that the Young Master could gather so many talents. Ignoring the other factors, if it weren’t because Hong Dali was so generous, it would not have been so easy to recruit management talents like Xiaoyi.
In the end, Zhang Cai could only shake her head helplessly.Looking at it, this seems to be destiny. Now, I’m really looking forward to the Young Master’s future performance, hehe.
For a time, everyone’s mood was different. At this time, Lin Chuyin thought about it and said, “Oh, maybe this is a good way. Then I will study this from now on then.”

Hearing her consent, Hong Dali smiled sneakily and said mysteriously, “Chuyin, I have already figured out the character. Why don’t we use your looks for the character? How about it? En, I have also helped you think about the name, the character shall be called Hatsune Miku!”
Hatsune Miku, this brother here has finally helped you make your glorious entry into this world!
Brother did it! You can also let the green onions rise in price1! When the time is ripe, I will find a cute girl to sing this song! Wahahahaha!
While Hong Dali was happy until he wanted to jump, Lin Chuyin seemed to think that the idea was not bad. She thought about it and suddenly asked, “So, will she laugh? Will she... cry?”
This caused Hong Dali to feel a tug in his heart and finally nodded. “Yes! Certainly!”
“Alright.” Lin Chuyin answered, “That’s settled then.”

After everything had been finalized, Hong Dali originally planned to look at Lin Chuyin’s other inventions, but when he thought that they were already co-partners and would have a lot of collaboration in the future, there was no point to be in such a hurry. Today, he still had more important things to do. “En, Chuyin, you see, is there a way to contact you? I can’t always come over when I want to look for you, right? Do you have a phone or something?”
“Oh, I do have something similar.” Lin Chuyin went to the pile of gadgets that seemed like a pile of rubbish and searched for something. “Wait for a moment.”

Hong Dali and the others looked on with cold sweat. Sure enough, hermits could not be judged by common sense. Such important inventions were piled up in the same way as garbage. If one wanted to use them, they had to find them from the pile. She should have at least separated them by categories...

Fortunately, Lin Chuyin found something like a small watch and handed it to Hong Dali. She said, “Communication watch, you can talk to me by pressing the button and the recording function. The signal transmission is not interfered by any magnetic field. ”
The first two uses were simple. However, the last function was the most powerful.

Hong Dali knew that many devices interfered with a mobile phone signal—for example, the jammer used in the college entrance examination room. When the device was powered on, the mobile phone immediately lost its signal. If one were to have this watch, he would be much more powerful. The key thing is that it could act as a magic weapon to save your life!

“This is good, this is good!” Hong Dali took the watch without the slightest hesitation. “With this, I will tell you all good ideas I can think of them, hehe. Oh yes, can I come here often to see this place? I also like to make these inventions.” If he were to come often, he would receive no small gains every time!
“Oh, alright.” Lin Chuyin did not reject such an idea. “However, before you come, make sure you inform me first. If not, the Automatic Defence System might hurt you.”
“Auto... Automatic Defence System?!” Hearing this term, Hong Dali and the others involuntarily looked around the place. There was even such a thing?

“It’s like this.” Chuyin casually picked up a wrench and threw it at the door. At this time, Hong Dali saw a blue electric light instantly smash the wrench, giving off a teeth-wrenching, high pitched sound!
“...” Everyone almost kneeled on the ground. It seems that the security level of this place was not much lower than that of the National Security Bureau!
“I use the defense system made by Tesla high-voltage coils to detect illegal invading creatures.” Lin Chuyin said, “So, you have to tell me before you come. Otherwise, it will be dangerous.”

“Al... Alright!” This was a matter of life and death, Hong Dali did not dare to be careless. “Understood, then I will inform you beforehand if I intend to come. I will trouble you to pick me up then.”
“Alright.” Lin Chuyin nodded her head.

When everything was settled, Hong Dali called his lackeys to pick up the set of holographic projection equipment, not forgetting to ask, “This thing can be charged, right? Can the scene inside be adjusted?”
“You can adjust it yourself,” Lin Chuyin said. “I have set up a lot of animation programs, you can try.”

“Oh, then I will try the operation method.” Hong Dali opened the device excitedly. It had to be said that this set of holographic projection device designed and manufactured by Lin Chuyin was quite simple—turn on the power, turn on the device, select the animation, and display the projection. Then you can turn it off when you don’t need it... even a fool would know how to operate it.

“OK, no problem.” Hong Dali rejoiced, smiled and said, “I will go back and start the construction of the laboratory. If it’s fast, it should be done in a month or so.” Building a large laboratory in the mountain could be settled with money. It should not be a hassle if a large sum were used—if it was really impossible, he could make a small cave and construct a high-tech building outside of it.

“Okay, then I will get started. The defense system at the door has been temporarily closed. You can go out.” After saying this, Lin Chuyin did not care about Hong Dali and others. She turned around and sat in front of the computer.
“Alright, we will leave first then!”

Out of Lin Chuyin’s laboratory, while the others were wiping their cold sweat, Hong Dali started to issue out orders. “Xiaoyi, immediately contact the patent office and apply a patent for the Holographic Projection Technology. Let the name under the patent be Lin Chuyin. Quickly, go. And don’t fail.”
“Alright, Young Master.” Xiaoyi then brought along two male lackeys before immediately leaving.

“Dali, you’re capable!” After listening to Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin suddenly praised him. “At least you can consider things better than me—I didn’t think of this. It seems you’re actually smart, hehe.”
“I’m a prodigal, not a fool!” Hong Dali jumped up. “Why do you always take me as a fool, it hurts my self-esteem, alright?”
Li Nianwei grinned. “In fact, the Young Master is really very kind. Otherwise, if it were others, he would not be able to have so many good friends.”
“Hehe, Sister Nianwei knows me the best.” Hong Dali said as he went into Li Nianwei’s arms. “Sister Nianwei, please comfort me!”
“Big pervert!” Tang Muxin viciously pulled Hong Dali’s ears. “Don’t take advantage of Sister Nianwei!”
“I did not!”
The bunch laughed and talked while leaving Lin Chuyin’s laboratory.
Inside the laboratory.
Lin Chuyin looked at the monitoring screen on the side, listening to their conversation and muttering, “Is this a friend, a partner, or are we colluding?”
Her eyes brightened and touched her chest. “My heartbeat is a little faster than usual, and it seems to feel very comfortable. Is this the feeling of being in cahoots?
“En, at least he’s considerate to help me apply for a patent. I had forgotten about that...
“Oh, Hatsune Miku, according to my looks. Maybe, I should let my hair grow longer.
“En, she can cry and laugh? How will she look like then?
“Then, will she have feelings?
“Maybe.”

“Ah, hahaha! This time I have another product!” Hong Dali laughed, “Holographic Projection Technology, with a big stage that will cost millions—it will definitely be very popular this time! En, I want this kind of effect. When Dali produces something, it must be the best!”

“Oh, I know you’re amazing, look at your proud face!” Tang Muxin also laughed at the side. “But to say that with this technology, ‘I Am a Singer’ will definitely be able to rise in popularity once again. It’s estimated that it’ll be not much worse than Sister Nianwei’s concert?”

Li Nianwei looked at Hong Dali with eyes full of the undisguised favor, just like how a sister looked at her younger brother. She said softly, “Young Master’s ideas are always brilliant, I believe it will not be bad.”
“Good!” Hong Dali excitedly opened his hands. “I’m the king of the world! I’m the biggest prodigal in the world! ‘I Am a Singer,’ I’m coming! Come on, this time, let’s have a good time, hahaha!”

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - Familys Rules
paragraphs: Tianjing City, North Fifth Loop Road North Bridge, Tian’ao Forest.

The location was excellent, and the environment was deep and serene. The main road passed through the North Fourth Ring Road intersection and led directly to the center of Tianjing City. The shaded trees along the road made people feel relaxed and happy. The wide roads and the scant amount of vehicles proved that the traffic conditions were pretty good.
The main road—with a width of 20 meters—was, in reality, built by the Hong Family.

This road stretched all the way to the north and was surrounded by lush forests that seemed to stretch thousands of miles, causing the scenery to be particularly charming. At the end of the road, in the most central location of the Tian’ao Forest, there was a giant manor.
Hong family, Hong family’s family estate.

The four major mansions of Tianjing City included the “Liu family’s manor” of Liu Yihui’s Liu family, the “Pyramid” of the financial tycoon Jiang family, the “Underground Kingdom” of the oil tycoon’s Sun family, and the last one was the Hong family’s “Forest Capital.”

This whole piece of Tian’ao Forest belonged to the private territory of the Hong family. Since Hong’s Manor dared to call itself the “Forest Capital,” the scale of its territory was naturally very large. The entire manor had a building area of approximately 200,000 square meters, with nearly 100 buildings including four swimming pools, tennis courts, bowling rooms, cinemas, music theaters, underground wine kilns, and many more.

In fact, these things were not worth mentioning when compared to the luxury homes of Tianjing City. However, the large area of forests and lakes untouched by humans and the small hot spring were a rarity—one could even occasionally witness bears coming out to hunt for food.

In this manor, there were even three helipads, with three special helicopters stationed on it for members of the Hong family to use in case of an emergency gathering. With such a large scale, it was natural to understand why the sons of the Hong family sacrificed whatever they could just for the first few places in the family meeting—but the family members with excellent qualifications would never be embarrassed in the family. With just a request, they would even be able to receive up to 50 million worth of startup funds.
In the largest central conference room in the “Forest Capital” of Hong’s Manor.

The conference room was very spacious, measuring about 500 square meters, and the number of people inside was not few. The three old people sitting at the top were indifferent. They consisted of two men and one woman and were the three most respected elders in the Hong family.

The one in the center had two-inch white eyebrows, and his jaws held about one inch of white whiskers. Although his face had a lot of wrinkles, his face appeared bright and lively, with a pair of eyes that were not as turbid as an ordinary old man’s, still shining brightly. He was dressed in a black tunic suit with a gold cane in his hand. Sitting there, he did not appear angry but still seemed to exert his might over the others. He was the father of several brothers including Hong Weiguo’s father, the contemporary elder of the Hong family, Hong Tu!

The man on Hong Tu’s left was dressed in a dark red Tang costume with a black round cap on his head, looking like an old family’s birthday star on TV. His pair of eyes always seemed like they were squinting. In his hand, he held a pair of blood-colored fitness balls, turning it around here and there. He had a kind smile on his face, and he picked up his teacup occasionally to taste the Longjing Tea. This old man was naturally of another branch, but was of the same generation and held the same authority as Hong Tu. He was another elder of the family.

The third person was a grandmother with silver hair, hunchbacked, and holding a faucet cane carved from rosewood. She looked like the old lady from The Generals of the Yang family1. She was worthy of being named as the heroine and was the only woman of Hong Tu and Hong Wei’s generation, named as Hong Ying elder.

At this time, under the left-hand side of the three elders, three people were sitting there. One of them was handsome and was dressed in a tieless silver-gray suit. He was Hong Anbao’s father, Hong Weiguo’s fourth brother, Hong Jianye.
As for the other two, if Hong Dali had come, he would be surprised to see that it was actually Hong Anbao and Hong Ancheng who he had seen before!
On the other side was where some elders who had the right to speak and were not weak in the family were seated. Beside them were the younger generations who excelled in the family.
“I don’t know the meaning of father and the two elders...” Hong Jianye courteously asked the three elders.
Although Hong Tu was his father, Hong Jianye naturally didn’t dare to show any rudeness as he was an elder of the family.

“Jianye, you just said that in the past two weeks, Dali has already reached the age of 18, and according to the family rules, the family inspection team should be sent to evaluate his business talent. Is that correct?” Hong Tu faintly glanced at Hong Jianye and said indifferently.
“Yes.” Hong Jianye nodded.

“According to the family rules,” Hongtu said slowly. “family members who are 18 or older will have to have their first commercial talent assessment to carry out the initial asset allocation. However, the situation is special for this child. You should know that, right?”

“Yes, I know.” Hong Jianye said. “But the family rules cannot be abolished. Otherwise, I would not have come here in advance. Once the precedent is set, who will follow the rules set by the ancestors of the Hong family? This son here is bold but faithful, and is not doing so for selfish reasons.”
After he said this, the other family elders also nodded, and the young people in the surroundings couldn’t help but sneer. Obviously, they were greatly jealous of Hong Dali’s prestigious background.

“Ai, this child was born in a good family, but his body condition is very special. Now that he is about 18, the family meeting should be held. The location was excellent, and the environment was deep and serene.

The main road—with a width of 20 meters—was, in reality, built by the Hong Family.

At the end of the road, in the most central location of the Tian’ao Forest, there was a giant manor.
Hong family, Hong family’s family estate.

The four major mansions of Tianjing City included the “Liu family’s manor” of Liu Yihui’s Liu family, the “Pyramid” of the financial tycoon Jiang family, the “Underground Kingdom” of the oil tycoon’s Sun family, and the last one was the Hong family’s “Forest Capital.”
This whole piece of Tian’ao Forest belonged to the private territory of the Hong family.
Since Hong’s Manor dared to call itself the “Forest Capital,” the scale of its territory was naturally very large.

The entire manor had a building area of approximately 200,000 square meters, with nearly 100 buildings including four swimming pools, tennis courts, bowling rooms, cinemas, music theaters, underground wine kilns, and many more.
In fact, these things were not worth mentioning when compared to the luxury homes of Tianjing City.
However, the large area of forests and lakes untouched by humans and the small hot spring were a rarity—one could even occasionally witness bears coming out to hunt for food.
In this manor, there were even three helipads, with three special helicopters stationed on it for members of the Hong family to use in case of an emergency gathering.

With just a request, they would even be able to receive up to 50 million worth of startup funds.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - He Is My Son
paragraphs: When the voice came out, everyone turned and looked at the direction of the gate.
To enter the place without any notification at this time, there could be no other person except this generation’s business talent, Hong Weiguo.

Seeing Hong Weiguo arrive, many people began to whisper again: “It’s the fifth uncle who came, and he usually pampers Hong Dali. There will be a good show this time around.” “Although he does pamper Hong Dali, when faced with the family rules, even if it is the fifth uncle, he can’t just change it, right?” “It’s hard to say, the fifth uncle is not a normal person, maybe there will be a turning point.”

“Hehe, Weiguo, you have come.” Upon seeing Hong Weiguo, Hong Jianye’s eyes flashed coldly, then he smiled and said, “Speaking of which, Hong Dali’s 18th birthday is coming soon. The family rules can’t be changed. I also had to play a black face for the development of the family. You can’t blame me for that, Weiguo.”

Although he was clearly aware of his fourth brother Hong Jianye’s plan, this was Hong’s Manor, after all. It was not a good place to tear down the pretense and engage in a fight. Hong Weiguo just nodded faintly and said, “I know.” He then turned to look at Hong Tu and said, “Father, Dali’s body was weak in the past. It was rare that he managed to recover. It was because of physical reasons that he had never been exposed to commercial matters before. He had just become good in health. To accept the talent investigation immediately, isn’t this too cruel?”
Hong Tu nodded. “Yes, I have considered this reason before, just...”
Although Hong Tu did not continue, Hong Weiguo naturally understood what he was trying to say.

Sure enough, Hong Jianye said with a smile, “Weiguo, have you forgotten, our third brother is worse than Dali in terms of abilities and intelligence. Because of this, due to the family rules, he could only become a peripheral member and enjoy the rest of his life normally. This fact is well known to all in the Hong family. Although you pamper nephew Dali, you can’t just break the family rules like that, right?”

Hong Weiguo’s cold glare flashed, but it quickly converged back. What Hong Jianye said, he naturally understood. In their generation, his big brother and second brother had second-class talents and could barely earn a small percentage of profits every year. The third brother was the saddest. With the lack of natural IQ, he could only be considered not stupid, and now the family had chosen a place to give him a pension to grow old. The fourth brother Hong Jianye still had some skills; otherwise, he would not have dared to directly barge into the Hong’s Manor. With precedents in place, Hong Weiguo couldn’t object, and thus, coldly said, “Speaking of which, are you so sure that Dali can’t pass the inspection?”
“This is not something whether I’m sure of,” Hong Jianye said with a smile. “I just want to uphold the family rules. I’m not doing this because of my own selfishness.”

“Haha, good!” After listening to Hong Jianye’s words, Hong Weiguo couldn’t help but twitch a few times. His huge palm shook slightly, but suddenly he laughed and said, “Since you have said this, then I will not say any more nonsense!” Hong Weiguo stood on the spot, looked around with disdain, before smiling and said, “Hehe, the big Hong family in my eyes, is not as important as my Dali! If you want to inspect, sure! But I have a word for you, don’t regret it when it’s too late!”
After this sentence was finished, Hong Weiguo turned and left, never looking back!
“Hold it!”

Seeing that Hong Weiguo was leaving, one of the three elders, Hong Ying, who had been silently sitting around, said: “Weiguo, are you really sure about this? Do you want to be the enemy of the whole family?!” With her loud shout, everyone in the entire conference room was shocked. Suddenly, everyone realized the meaning of Hong Weiguo’s words just now.
He was actually saying that if Hong Dali did not pass his inspection, he, Hong Weiguo, the most outstanding genius of the current generation Hong family, would leave the Hong family!
If it were true, then things would become really troublesome.

Hong Weiguo was a genius, a business genius. Even if he were to leave the Hong family, he could enter any family he wanted, and this would cause enormous trouble for the Hong family—trouble that no one could deal with. It could even be said that even if Hong Dali squandered ten times or even a hundred times and lost all the money, the money he wasted was far less than the damage caused by Hong Weiguo’s decision to leave the family!
Even his fourth brother, Hong Jianye, could no longer smile when he heard this.

If Hong Weiguo were sentenced out of the Hong family, not to mention his own companies, even Hong Jianye businesses’ would inevitably be destroyed. There was absolutely no doubt about this. At this time, Hong Jianye discovered that he was still too weak and did not even have the chance to compete with Hong Weiguo.

“I have already said. In my eyes, the mighty Hong family is not even as important as my family’s Dali’s hair!” Hong Weiguo slowly turned and stared at Hong Ying, and said with a deep voice, “In any case, Dali is my son, my only son. Whether he is a dragon or a worm, he is still my son. His body is filled with the blood of me, Hong Weiguo. Hehe, what if I’m the most outstanding talent in this generation’s Hong family. If I can’t even protect my son, even if I have earned 100 billion or trillion, what is the point?!”
After saying that, the whole conference room was filled with pin drop silence.

Everyone felt his determination from Hong Weiguo’s words. Today, there were only two choices. First, the inspection continued, and if Hong Dali did not pass, Hong Weiguo would be sentenced out of Hong family. Second, cancel the inspection and break the family rules.
Certainly, both choices were not good.

At this moment, everyone in the big conference room had set their sights on Hong Jianye, the initiator. Of course, their glares were not so friendly. If Hong Weiguo were to be forced out of the Hong family, the consequences were not something anyone could afford to handle.

Hong Jianye’s face was full of cold sweat. He really didn’t expect Hong Weiguo to reach this step and even dare to say this! Up till here, he could only continue to act tough. Otherwise, he would have no place in the Hong family. Hong Jianye desperately calmed his mind, but his guts were no longer enough. “Weiguo, this is also because of family rules, you cannot blame me.”
“Why would I blame you,” Hong Weiguo laughed and said, “I understand what you’re thinking.”

“Enough!” Seeing the atmosphere getting stiffer, Hong Tu suddenly patted the chair and said with a deep voice, “Weiguo, you’re my son. The most valued and the best son at that. Dali is also a child that I really like since he was young. I shall act on my own this time. The family’s inspection will be delayed!”

When he said this, the whole meeting room was first filled with a short silence, then rebuttals started to be heard all over: “Great elder, how can you ignore the family rules?!” “Yes, yes, once you have set a precedent, how can the later generations handle such cases?” “If we don’t follow the rules, there will be chaos!” “What can you do? Can you really watch Weiguo leave?”

“Everyone, shut up!” The second elder, Hong Wei, who had been smiling all the time, suddenly shouted. “This kind of thing, it’s still not yours to discuss! Let’s listen to what big brother has to say!” He was usually easy going, but currently, he was full of anger. Everyone who knew him knew that he didn’t get angry easily. Once he got angry, it would be like thunder. Everyone shut up instantly.

When the meeting room was completely quiet, Hong Tu slowly said, “Weiguo, Dali’s body has been bad all along. Now that there are signs of improvement, this is a good thing. I will not make it difficult for him, the inspection team will not be sent out for now. But I have a condition.”

“Well, father, what are the conditions.” Hearing that there was a chance for things to be turned around, Hong Weiguo’s heart, which almost jumped out, returned to its original place and hurriedly said, “If you allow it, I’m willing to help him earn his share!”
“Oh, I’m not so heartless.” Hong Tu coughed twice and slowly said, “I heard that the child spent a lot of money during this time and did a lot of things?”
“Yes.” Hong Weiguo nodded. “It seems that because of this, his body is better.”

“En, there is no need for an inspection. He used to dislike business for physical reasons. I do not blame him for that.” Hong Tu paused and said, “Thus, I will not test his business talent. This time, I will make an exception and test him in another way.”
“in another way?” Hong Weiguo asked confused. “How so?”

“According to the rules of our Hong family, the family’s children will receive a total of 10 million for investment after their 18th birthday.” Hong Tu slowly said. “Then, according to the investment, after one year, the total profit is calculated, right?”
“En, that’s true.” Hong Weiguo nodded his head.
“But Dali has not been exposed to business before. Thus, it can’t be done this way. Otherwise, it will be unfair.” Hong Tu said. “After all, he doesn’t know how to do business, isn’t this right?”
“Yes, that’s right.” Hong Weiguo continued to nod his head.

Hong Tu then continued, “Thus, I came up with a new idea. I heard that you recently gave him around 20 million worth of pocket money. He then took the pocket money and made a lot of things. And even went to the entertainment business, right?”
Listening to what Hong Tu said, the young children around him felt all kinds of envy and hatred.
They usually had a hundred thousand or eighty thousand worth of pocket money. Hong Dali, on the other hand, had his pocket money calculated according to tens of millions of yuan.
“Yes.” Hong Weiguo nodded his head.

“Then, the method of Hong Dali’s inspection is to calculate if he made a profit or lost money from the things he bought and invested in during the next family meeting.” Hong Tu smiled. “Gadgets have the benefits of gadgets. At least, Dali doesn’t gamble and take drugs, and it even seems that he has collected a few talents. Thus, we will use 20 million as the bar. As long as at the next family meeting, those gadgets and playthings he had invested in brought back returns, he will have passed the inspection. How about that? During this period, we, the few old guys, will never intervene, and let him freely play. Of course,” Hong Tu raised his gold cane and pointed to Hong Weiguo. “you’re not allowed to intervene.”
Upon hearing this condition, Hong Weiguo finally settled his mind. “Good! I promise! I do at least believe in Dali’s foresight!”
Hong Tu laughed. “Well, you can go then. And remember to bring Dali along to see me during the June 16th family meeting.”
“Alright, father. I understand.” After his father a smile, Hong Weiguo turned and left in big strides.
