I’m not doing this because of my own selfishness.”
“Haha, good!” After listening to Hong Jianye’s words, Hong Weiguo couldn’t help but twitch a few times.

His huge palm shook slightly, but suddenly he laughed and said, “Since you have said this, then I will not say any more nonsense!” Hong Weiguo stood on the spot, looked around with disdain, before smiling and said, “Hehe, the big Hong family in my eyes, is not as important as my Dali!
If you want to inspect, sure!
But I have a word for you, don’t regret it when it’s too late!”
After this sentence was finished, Hong Weiguo turned and left, never looking back!
“Hold it!”
Seeing that Hong Weiguo was leaving, one of the three elders, Hong Ying, who had been silently sitting around, said: “Weiguo, are you really sure about this?
Do you want to be the enemy of the whole family?!” With her loud shout, everyone in the entire conference room was shocked.
Suddenly, everyone realized the meaning of Hong Weiguo’s words just now.
He was actually saying that if Hong Dali did not pass his inspection, he, Hong Weiguo, the most outstanding genius of the current generation Hong family, would leave the Hong family!
If it were true, then things would become really troublesome.
Hong Weiguo was a genius, a business genius.
Even if he were to leave the Hong family, he could enter any family he wanted, and this would cause enormous trouble for the Hong family—trouble that no one could deal with.

It could even be said that even if Hong Dali squandered ten times or even a hundred times and lost all the money, the money he wasted was far less than the damage caused by Hong Weiguo’s decision to leave the family!
Even his fourth brother, Hong Jianye, could no longer smile when he heard this.
If Hong Weiguo were sentenced out of the Hong family, not to mention his own companies, even Hong Jianye businesses’ would inevitably be destroyed.
There was absolutely no doubt about this.
At this time, Hong Jianye discovered that he was still too weak and did not even have the chance to compete with Hong Weiguo.
“I have already said.

In my eyes, the mighty Hong family is not even as important as my family’s Dali’s hair!” Hong Weiguo slowly turned and stared at Hong Ying, and said with a deep voice, “In any case, Dali is my son, my only son.
Whether he is a dragon or a worm, he is still my son.
His body is filled with the blood of me, Hong Weiguo.
Hehe, what if I’m the most outstanding talent in this generation’s Hong family.
If I can’t even protect my son, even if I have earned 100 billion or trillion, what is the point?!”
After saying that, the whole conference room was filled with pin drop silence.
Everyone felt his determination from Hong Weiguo’s words.
Today, there were only two choices.
First, the inspection continued, and if Hong Dali did not pass, Hong Weiguo would be sentenced out of Hong family.
Second, cancel the inspection and break the family rules.
Certainly, both choices were not good.
At this moment, everyone in the big conference room had set their sights on Hong Jianye, the initiator.
Of course, their glares were not so friendly.
If Hong Weiguo were to be forced out of the Hong family, the consequences were not something anyone could afford to handle.
Hong Jianye’s face was full of cold sweat.
He really didn’t expect Hong Weiguo to reach this step and even dare to say this!
Up till here, he could only continue to act tough.
Otherwise, he would have no place in the Hong family.
Hong Jianye desperately calmed his mind, but his guts were no longer enough.
“Weiguo, this is also because of family rules, you cannot blame me.”
“Why would I blame you,” Hong Weiguo laughed and said, “I understand what you’re thinking.”
“Enough!” Seeing the atmosphere getting stiffer, Hong Tu suddenly patted the chair and said with a deep voice, “Weiguo, you’re my son.
The most valued and the best son at that.
Dali is also a child that I really like since he was young.
I shall act on my own this time.
The family’s inspection will be delayed!”

When he said this, the whole meeting room was first filled with a short silence, then rebuttals started to be heard all over: “Great elder, how can you ignore the family rules?!” “Yes, yes, once you have set a precedent, how can the later generations handle such cases?” “If we don’t follow the rules, there will be chaos!” “What can you do?
Can you really watch Weiguo leave?”
“Everyone, shut up!” The second elder, Hong Wei, who had been smiling all the time, suddenly shouted.
“This kind of thing, it’s still not yours to discuss!
Let’s listen to what big brother has to say!” He was usually easy going, but currently, he was full of anger.
Everyone who knew him knew that he didn’t get angry easily.
Once he got angry, it would be like thunder.
Everyone shut up instantly.
When the meeting room was completely quiet, Hong Tu slowly said, “Weiguo, Dali’s body has been bad all along.
Now that there are signs of improvement, this is a good thing.
I will not make it difficult for him, the inspection team will not be sent out for now.
But I have a condition.”

“Well, father, what are the conditions.” Hearing that there was a chance for things to be turned around, Hong Weiguo’s heart, which almost jumped out, returned to its original place and hurriedly said, “If you allow it, I’m willing to help him earn his share!”
“Oh, I’m not so heartless.” Hong Tu coughed twice and slowly said, “I heard that the child spent a lot of money during this time and did a lot of things?”
“Yes.” Hong Weiguo nodded.
“It seems that because of this, his body is better.”
“En, there is no need for an inspection.
He used to dislike business for physical reasons.
I do not blame him for that.” Hong Tu paused and said, “Thus, I will not test his business talent.
This time, I will make an exception and test him in another way.”
“in another way?” Hong Weiguo asked confused.
“How so?”
“According to the rules of our Hong family, the family’s children will receive a total of 10 million for investment after their 18th birthday.” Hong Tu slowly said.
“Then, according to the investment, after one year, the total profit is calculated, right?”
“En, that’s true.” Hong Weiguo nodded his head.
“But Dali has not been exposed to business before.
Thus, it can’t be done this way.
Otherwise, it will be unfair.” Hong Tu said.
“After all, he doesn’t know how to do business, isn’t this right?”
“Yes, that’s right.” Hong Weiguo continued to nod his head.
Hong Tu then continued, “Thus, I came up with a new idea.
I heard that you recently gave him around 20 million worth of pocket money.
He then took the pocket money and made a lot of things.
And even went to the entertainment business, right?”
Listening to what Hong Tu said, the young children around him felt all kinds of envy and hatred.
They usually had a hundred thousand or eighty thousand worth of pocket money.
Hong Dali, on the other hand, had his pocket money calculated according to tens of millions of yuan.
“Yes.” Hong Weiguo nodded his head.
“Then, the method of Hong Dali’s inspection is to calculate if he made a profit or lost money from the things he bought and invested in during the next family meeting.” Hong Tu smiled.
“Gadgets have the benefits of gadgets.
At least, Dali doesn’t gamble and take drugs, and it even seems that he has collected a few talents.
Thus, we will use 20 million as the bar.
As long as at the next family meeting, those gadgets and playthings he had invested in brought back returns, he will have passed the inspection.
How about that?
During this period, we, the few old guys, will never intervene, and let him freely play.
Of course,” Hong Tu raised his gold cane and pointed to Hong Weiguo.
“you’re not allowed to intervene.”
Upon hearing this condition, Hong Weiguo finally settled his mind.
“Good!
I promise!
I do at least believe in Dali’s foresight!”
Hong Tu laughed.
“Well, you can go then.
And remember to bring Dali along to see me during the June 16th family meeting.”
“Alright, father.
I understand.” After his father a smile, Hong Weiguo turned and left in big strides.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - Domineering Statement
paragraphs: It was only after exiting the Hong family manor that Hong Weiguo let out a long breath. “I finally managed to lower the conditions, it was certainly not easy.”

He took a few breaths, and after his emotions had calmed down, he took out his mobile phone and called Lan Ruoxi. He said “Dear, it’s settled. These guys have become so jealous of Dali that they no longer even care about covering up their intentions.”
“I’m waiting for you at home, come back soon.” Lan Ruoxi said on the other side of the phone. “Don’t worry about your work today, Dali’s matters are more important.”
“I know, I will be back soon.” Hong Weiguo said before hanging up the phone.
Hongwu Villa, Hong Weiguo’s villa.
“Dear, wait for me in the study room.” After Hong Weiguo entered the house, he threw his clothes on the sofa and then went straight to the third-floor study.
In the study room.

After Hong Weiguo drank two cups of tea to moisten his throat, he said, “As expected, after the bunch of people knew that Dali’s health has been improving, they have started to act. Fortunately, I got there in time. Otherwise, it would be hard on Dali if the decision had gone through.”

“En, fortunately, we have been paying attention to that side and were able to find out when Hong Jianye entered the mansion.” Lan Ruoxi smiled bitterly. “With our big business empire, they will certainly be jealous and remember us. Before, Dali was weak and frail, and thus, they looked forward to the time when he would die so they could take over the business. Now that he’s getting better, they immediately demanded an inspection to push him out of the core circle of the family. For the sake of money, this bunch of people is willing to do anything.”

“Yeah,” Hong Weiguo said helplessly. “We both know that Dali’s foresight is certainly not bad. But the things that he has been doing are unable to be assessed by the inspection team. If the team were to evaluate him, he would definitely fail. Fortunately, I managed to fight for a chance. My father has changed the rules this time. With the two million that I gave Dali as pocket money acting as the base sum, he will be deemed to have passed if he made a profit from the things he had invested on. At the very least, the several hotels and Ye Lai Xiang’s profit should be enough to cover up the cost.”
“En, I’m in a good mood now.” Lan Ruoxi smiled. “Dear, you have worked hard.”
“As his father, all this hard work is nothing for Dali’s sake.”
Hong Dali naturally did not know of the commotion that had happened in his family.

At this time, he was making the final preparations for “I Am a Singer.” “Everyone! In our show, we don’t do useless things, everything depends on our abilities! We will make it more mysterious and let the audience look forward to it, do you all understand?”
“Understood!” The people below hollered.
“Sister Cai, I shall trouble you to act as the host,” Hong Dian smiled. “It might be a little bit tiring, hehe.”

“You’re too polite Young Master.” As a manager, Zhang Cai’s outlook was not bad. She was also very eloquent and acted in a steady manner. Thus, she was naturally suited to be the host. “Speaking of which, I have also hosted two programs before. There should be no problem.”
“En.” Hong Dali then asked, “The singers are all here, right? Are they ready?”

“They’re all ready,” Zhang Cai said. “The rehearsal is also almost done. Mr. Chu Zhongqin also said that Young Master can be at ease. He’s currently in a good state and will definitely not disappoint Young Master.”
“Ok, then!” Hong Dali looked at the time and waved his hand. “Then, let’s set out!”
The next two days, the hype for the “I Am a Singer” began.

This hype that had shocked the whole of Heavenly State was, in fact, all caused by a mere sentence from Hong Dali: “When Dali produces something, it must be the best! If it’s not up to standards, Dali will throw in all the money needed to ensure it’s the best.”

Any reputable company would all say that the product they were going to produce was going to be the best. However, in reality, consumers would not believe their claims. What had, in fact, attracted the attention of the viewers was the second sentence.”
“If it’s not up to standards, Dali will throw in all the money needed to ensure it’s the best!”
How domineering was that!

Originally, as long as the fact that Li Nianwei’s concert andUnexpectedly! were both done by Hong Dali was mentioned, “I Am a Singer” would have already caught a large number of people’s attention. However, now that he said something like this, the issue instantly became the top story in the news.

Who was behind the Caiwei Entertainment? Hong Dali! Who was Hong Dali? He could be said to be the number one prodigal in the world! On top of that, the way he squandered was also very peculiar. Perhaps no one would have cared if Hong Dali was the type of prodigal who squandered his money through gambling and finding chicks.
However, it was completely different now.

Although he was recognized as a prodigal by the world, there was also a consensus in people’s minds that Hong Dali’s money had always been spent on practical things! This time, since he dared to voice out such a domineering declaration, then one thing was completely certain—”I Am a Singer” would definitely leave people feeling shocked!

Even if the singers were all replaced by unnamed newcomers or karaoke singers, it would still be worth it to go to the live show. Since the show was organized by Hong Dali, it was without a doubt that the stage would be astounding and that the atmosphere would be lively.

Therefore, even though “I Am a Singer” had not been broadcasted yet, Caiwei Entertainment had already hyped up all sectors of society, causing everyone to discuss the show fervently and make “I Am a Singer” known to everyone.
It was without an exaggeration to say that even if one didn’t want to watch the show, one would have heard about it.

However, in just one day, from the beginning of the advertising to 8:00 PM on Sunday evening, people’s expectations had far exceeded the original expectations. Ling Xiaoyi reported to Hong Dali with her forehead filled with cold sweat: “Young Master, at present, the tickets for “I Am a Singer” have been sold out, and according to statistics, the number of people who want to watch is still increasing. It has far exceeded the number of seats. If this continues, I’m afraid that the immense number of the audience will cause a stampede...”
With his head resting on Li Nianwei’s thigh, Hong Dali said, “How many tickets have you sold? Is it so exaggerated?”

“The entire stadium, including the field inside, sold a total of 55,000 tickets. The VIP seats and the regular seats add up to an average of about 60 yuan for one ticket.” Ling Xiaoyi continued, “Which also means, we have already earned more than three million solely from ticket sales.”

“What!” Tang Muxin’s surprised chin almost fell to the ground. She quickly calculated. “If the first episode earns us three million, then the ten-episode program would earn us a total of 30 million. Even if the cost of 15 million is deducted, we will still earn a net profit of 15 million!” Counting up to here, she began to pull Hong Dali’s arm and shook it vigorously. “Dali, can you organize more of such programs in the future? No one would dare say that you’re a prodigal then!”

Hong Dali said, “Squandering is a skill. Y’all wouldn’t understand...” He then immediately told Ling Xiaoyi, “If we throw in the three million we have just earned, would there be sufficient seats at the live show? Set up ten screens outside the stadium, I want all the people around the stadium to see the live broadcast!”
At the end of his sentence, he did not forget to add, “When Dali produces something, it must be the best! How can the venue be too small?!”
And thus, the preparations continued until it was Tuesday, the day when “I Am a Singer” officially started.

As Ku Ge Music Company’s Senior Music Producer, Sheng Wenshi followed the unit’s colleagues and drove from the company building to the West Fourth Loop Stadium. At this time, it was just six o’clock, a full two hours from the beginning of “I Am a Singer.” Normally, this time was definitely enough for them to make sufficient preparations with ease, but he had underestimated people’s expectations for this program—even his car couldn’t get into the one-kilometer circumference of the West Fourth Loop Stadium. There were much more people who came earlier than him.
This could be seen from the parking spaces where even dogs couldn’t squeeze their way through the crowded road.

While he was preparing to park, a professional wearing security uniform came over and knocked on the window. After Sheng Wenshi pulled the window down, the security guard said respectfully, “Sir, please do not drive further in. Many people are already standing on the roof of their car to wait for the show. Unless your car has wings, you will definitely not be able to enter.”

After listening to this, Sheng Wenshi was filled with sweat and looked around at his surroundings in horror. He asked anxiously, “How many people have come? There is still around two kilometers before we reach the stadium, right?”

“According to the latest news I received,” the security guard said helplessly, “there are at least 120,000 people in the two kilometers circumference of the stadium. And,” the security guard also wiped the cold sweat on his head. “the number is still increasing rapidly. It’s estimated that it’s likely to break through the 200,000 mark at 8:00 PM...”

“My God...” Sheng Wenshi looked at his colleagues and said in a hurry, “We have all bought VIP tickets. You can’t possibly tell us that we can’t enter, right? It’s a small matter for the money to be wasted, but our company’s program can’t be delayed. Oh, yes,” Sheng Wenshi hurriedly took out the VIP tickets and name cards he brought. “I’m Ku Ge’s Senior Music Producer, Sheng Wenshi. This is the ticket I bought and my ID. Security comrades, please take a look.”

After receiving the tickets and documents handed by Sheng Wenshi, the security guard looked carefully and, after verifying that there was no problem, he immediately said, “Then, gentlemen, please park the car and come with me. It’s impossible for the car to enter, but fortunately for you, the boss has specially prepared twenty helicopters...”

“Two... twenty helicopters...” Sheng Wenshi and his colleagues punched their chest area near their hearts. “Oh, my poor heart... I have to take a helicopter to enter the stadium to watch a concert. This level is too high. I’m afraid I can’t stand it...”

The row of people reversed back all the way, and after they retreated for three hundred meters, they finally found a parking space. Sheng Wenshi quickly turned in. Without caring about others, sneaked in and stuffed his car into the slot. The big battle of parking, great success!

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - Young Master’s Capabilities
paragraphs: “Please come with me.” After Sheng Wenshi and his entourage got off the bus, the security guard quickly took the lead. “There is a primary school in front of us. The playground there is a temporary airport stop for our helicopters. When you get there, you can all get into the stadium.”
After making turns here and there, even though it was just a few hundred meters away, they had walked for ten minutes. What awaited them was an unforgettable scene...

At this time, about 5,000 square meters of the elementary school playground, many people were standing together. At least four or five thousand people were visually observed. Then, a huge iron cage was tied under a helicopter, with several steel pipes installed in the cage.

After the helicopter flew back, the iron cage was released and fell to the ground. More than a dozen people then went in and grabbed the welded steel pipes inside the cage. The helicopter propellershwed, and after a sudden turn, the iron cage was pulled straight to the sky, and then flew to the direction of the stadium... After about two minutes, the helicopter flew back...
Sheng Wenshi and others were full of cold sweat. It seemed that this helicopter was not so comfortable to sit in...

Because the number of helicopters was sufficient, the flight was short, and there was enough space in the cages—the group of people, including Sheng Wenshi, finally entered the iron cage at around 7:40 PM.

After entering the cage, Sheng Wenshi and others clung to the steel pipe inside the cage and stood in a horse stance. A security guard took the intercom and said, “Liftoff!” Then, the helicopter swayed and rose...

The previous times he took a plane, Sheng Wenshi didn’t feel anything wrong at all. However, this time, he finally understood how it felt when his feet were suspended from the ground, in the air—he was immediately filled with cold sweat. But in just a short while, he was completely attracted by other scenes.
In the air, Sheng Wenshi finally saw how many people came to watch “I Am a Singer” and how spectacular the scene was.

Around the West Fourth Loop Stadium, there were twelve huge screens on the outer wall of the stadium, broadcasting live what was happening through the satellite. At this time, in the two-kilometer circumference of the West Fourth Loop Stadium, it was no exaggeration to say that it had been completely filled. Except for the main road in front of the stadium, which was completely isolated by the security belt and the security guard, there was nowhere else where a car could come in from, and it was estimated that even flies couldn’t fly in!

The rooftops of the skyscrapers around were all filled with spotlights controlled by a central computer that shone around the crowd. At this time, although the skylight was dim, the entire West Fourth Loop still seemed bright due to the strong spotlights lighting up the whole place. If one had to compare, the scene was just like shining a dozen flashlights on a large number of ants on the ground.

In the sky, the sound of the propeller whistling could be heard. The West Fourth Loop Stadium had more than 20 helicopters flying in the sky. Whenever a helicopter passed by, Sheng Wenshi would produce drops of cold sweat.
At this time, Sheng Wenshi was already full of admiration towards Hong Dali—not considering the quality of the show, just the atmosphere and scene alone would be worth the ticket price.
I have really made the right decision to come today.Sheng Wenshi thought.If I did not come, I would regret it forever!

The scene was very cumbersome to describe. In fact, Sheng Wenshi had only stayed in the air for a little more than a minute. After all, there were still many people waiting to enter the scene. It was naturally impossible for a helicopter to stay in the air.

At this time, the West Fourth Loop Stadium had already been crowded with people. Sheng Wenshi took a cursory look. At least 40,000 people were present. On the stadium floor, there were more than 20 huge sponge mats. They were used to cushion the impact of the iron cage landing on the ground. After all, if the cage were directly released to the ground, it was easy to cause a shock to the human leg.
After a lot of hard work, Sheng Wenshi finally sat in his VIP seat.
After he and his colleagues just sat down, they were once again shocked by what they saw.
Beside them, there were up to a hundred celebrities sitting together!

“Let me see, let me see.” Sheng Wenshi began from the beginning. “2013 Best Newcomer Award winner Qiu Ruida, best arranger Zuo Yushu, best lyricist Huang Yuande... What the heck, even the 2013 Golden Horse King He Chenglong has come! Just the opportunity to see so many celebrities up close would have made the ticket worth the price!” Thinking of this, Sheng Wenshi wiped his face. “The abilities of this Young Master is so insane in the entertainment circle. Even if these people were offered money, it would have been hard to invite them, no?”

What Sheng Wenshi said was true. These stars were all big names, the really famous ones. It was no exaggeration to say that in the entertainment circle of the whole Heavenly State, they were all ranked at the top. Except for the various awards ceremonies or real entertainment shows, it was definitely not easy to see them together.
In his impression, the last time these people appeared in front of the TV screen was during the 2012 Best Film and Television Entertainment Awards Ceremony which occurred every three years.

However, the reality was that Hong Dali didn’t spend a penny to invite them. The celebrities themselves even had to pay for the high ticket cost themselves. Even if one were to say this, no one would believe it.
One must know that for a VIP seat, even the cheapest one cost 2000 yuan.
But whether he believed it or not, when the facts were placed in front of him, Sheng Wenshi had no choice but to believe in what he saw.
“Aiyo, isn’t this Old Sheng?!”
While Sheng Wenshi was thinking, a familiar voice came from the side. “Haha, I didn’t expect our seats to be so close!”

After turning around, Sheng Wenshi saw Ding Chengzhi’s familiar face and smiled. “Haha, Old Ding, even you have come. It’s certainly rare to see you out. I didn’t expect the two of us to sit so near. Are you here to join in the fun too?”

After Ding Chengzhi asked for a small favor from the one sitting next to Sheng Wenshi, he changed his seat to Sheng Wenshi’s side. He then mysteriously said, “Speaking of it, it was all due to Young Master that I managed to grab a seat here. I was here since 4:00 PM. If you had been even a bit later, you would have been late.”
“What?!” After hearing what Ding Chengzhi said, Sheng Wenshi was astounded. “You were here since four?! Are you so free? You sat here and waited for four hours?”
Ding Chengzhi glanced at his surroundings before softly saying, “Four hours? I can be considered to have come late. Do you see Jia Chenglong?”
“Yes, I have. What about him?” Sheng Wenshi asked weirdly.
“He was here since half past two.” Ding Chengzhi said. “Our film crew, Lin Haolin, was here since 2:00 PM. He saw He Chenglong waiting from 2:30 PM till now. Impressive, isn’t it?”
“Impressive!” Sheng Wenshi then continued, “The question is, why did he get here so early? Being an actor, he should not be really close to those from the music industry.”

“What do you mean by not close?” Ding Chengzhi helplessly said. “If it were others, he might not really get along with them, but we are talking about the Young Master. Let alone He Chenglong, even if it were ten He Chenglongs, they would have to come over!”
“What the heck?!” Sheng Wenshi asked with his mouth agape. “Why?”
“Do you still rememberThe Gale Flashfilmed by our crew?” Ding Chengzhi asked. “The one which Young Master said should be renamed.”
“Yes, I do. Hasn’t the whole script and plot been changed now?” Sheng Wenshi asked puzzledly. “What’s wrong?”

“What’s wrong?” Ding Chengzhi said. “Did you see the martial arts scene? That was the real thing, real ancient martial arts! Not that I’m bragging to you, but do you know of the old man in the video? I saw him break a block of wood the size of an arm with his bare hands easily!” Speaking up to here, Ding Chengzhi said seriously, “What we saw was real kung fu. He Chenglong can be said to be the best kung fu master in the country. How do you think he responded when he saw the video?”

“What the heck! You saw it with your own eyes?!” Sheng Wenshi was completely stunned this time. “I was wondering why he came over. With the old man’s emergence, his title of ‘Best Kung Fu Master’ would be hard to keep!”

Ding Chengzhi chuckled. “Otherwise, why do you think he is in such a hurry? In my point of view, he must be more anxious than anyone else. After all, the throne of the ‘Best Kung Fu Master’ is likely to be lost. He must now be thinking about how to get along with the Young Master. Otherwise, his future will not be good.”
“The Young Master is really...” Sheng Wenshi shook his head and smiled. “Ai, who could expect such a publicly acknowledged prodigal to have such great abilities?”

“Prodigal?” Ding Chengzhi shook his head. “He’s not just a normal prodigal. He’s a super prodigal! Let me tell you about it. Have you heard of how our movie had to change its script? One part of it was changed absurdly. The Young Master wanted the male lead to unintentionally fall into a cave with a jade statue of a goddess. Guess what he said next?”
“What?” asked Sheng Wenshi.

“The Young Master said that the jade statue used must be real!” Ding Chengzhi sighed. “Seriously! A jade statue with the height of a person! Adding up the cost of the raw materials and carvings, such a statue would cost at least 300,000! Director Lin asked if we could use 3D printing or stones to replace it, but the Young Master disagreed no matter how we persuaded! Ai, I have never seen such a prodigal. Just a prop in a simple movie cost 300,000!”
“What the heck! You must be kidding!” Sheng Wenshi exclaimed. “No one else would even think of doing this, right?”

“I know, right!” Ding Chengzhi continued to sigh. “But the thinking process of Young Master is indeed different from the normal person. After being with Young Master for a while, I understood that it was definitely not by accident for Young Master to filmUnexpectedly!. Young Master’s mystical ideas make it hard for me not to admire him. I dare to say that with the change in plot and script ofThe Gale Flash, the attendance rate for the film will increase by at least 30%!” Ding Chengzhi said while extended three fingers. “There is only one word to describe how the new plot is compared to the old one—impressive!”

Sheng Wenshi helplessly said, “The longer I come into contact with Young Master, the more I find out how mysterious he is. Ai, Old Ding, with Young Master’s way of doing things, he will definitely give us a surprise with this ‘I Am a Singer,’ right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - A Stunning Opening Ceremony
paragraphs: “Is there a need to ask that?” Ding Chengzhi affirmed. “There will definitely be a surprise. It’s just a matter of whether the surprise is big or super big. Alright, let’s not talk about any more nonsense and look at the big screen. The opening ceremony of ‘I Am a Singer’ is about to... What the heck!”
Speaking up to here, just as he turned to look towards the screen, he couldn’t help but curse.
Because at this time, on the isolated road, sounds of footsteps could be heard, and the next scene he saw would be ingrained in his mind for a lifetime!
On the road, with ten people in a row, amounting up to 50 rows, security guards dressed in neat uniforms were marching forward slowly towards him!
“You... you are kidding, right?!” Seeing this scene, Sheng Wenshi was utterly shocked.

Of course, Ding Chengzhi, who was beside him, was also stunned. “This... this ... how many security guards did the Young Master employ! What the heck! Fifty rows of security guards with 10 in each row? Isn’t that a total of 500 security guards leading the opening ceremony?!”

At this time, on the big screen, while the five hundred security guards were striding forward, the sky was also filled with twenty plus helicopters flying around—of course, among these twenty pluses, 20 were responsible for transportation while only three or four were responsible for shooting the scenes. However, at first sight, it seemed as if the whole sky was filled with helicopters doing an aerial performance.

In addition to the 500 security guards at the beginning, the giant spotlights on the rooftops of surrounding skyscrapers all shone on the main road. Just this spectacular scene caused the audience who did not enter the stadium to feel it was worth it to have come and deeply feel they didn’t come here for nothing today. As for those that didn’t come, all they could feel was regret—perhaps the decision of saving ten dollars to purchase a ticket would remain as regret for a lifetime!

Behind the 500 security guards leading the way were the eight stars that would be participating in “I Am a Singer.” Each of them walked with a small team behind them that included their agents, five security guards, and ten reporters.

Just the entrance of the stars was enough to make people scream—wherever the celebrities went, they were welcomed with screams and chants, just like international celebrities. It was no exaggeration to say that just by this scene, no one would doubt that they were the world’s top celebrities.

Chu Zhongqin walked in the forefront suavely, waving to the audience while making his way forward. Coupled with his clothes which were decorated with diamonds, his long hair flowing in the wind, and his sunglasses...

The current him seemed to resemble the world’s international superstar from earth, Micheal Jackson, receiving screams from the audiences. Some of the audience even fainted due to overexcitement. The security guards nearby immediately took these people to rest.
Just by the opening ceremony, “I Am a Singer” had already left many speechless, their visual appetite satisfied!
But this was far from over!

Behind the eight singers was a more vast and mighty team! With fifty rows of 10 security guards as one platoon, a total of nine platoons followed behind the singers. These security guards held the red flag of the Heavenly State and shouted the pledge throughout. The magnificent spectacle was almost comparable to that of a National Day parade.
Before “I Am a Singer” had even started its formal performance, the atmosphere of the crowd was already brought to the climax!
Numerous audiences shouted the names of the stars present and waved at them as if they were triumphant heroes!

At this time, the stars sitting in the West Fourth Loop Stadium were all regretting to the point where their intestines turned green—when they first heard from Zhang Cai’s phone call, they declined to participate as they felt the show was not a match to their status. As a result, from the way things had turned out, they had already lost at least millions of potential revenue.

At least, for the eight singers who participated in the performance today, solely this opening ceremony could double or triple their net worth. The worst part was that there was no upper limit to how much their reputation could rise...

Many singers were now ready to contact Miss Zhang Cai, the most popular agent in 2014, to discuss their appearance in the next few episodes. However, it was obvious that with only one free slot every two episodes, it would certainly be a headache to acquire it.
When the pack of security guards reached the main door of West Fourth Loop Stadium, they came to a halt.
The 5000 security guards divided themselves into two teams and stood guard at both sides of the pathway they had just opened while the eight singers slowly made their way inside.

After they had all entered, all the gates of West Fourth Loop Stadium closed. After that, the giant screens on the surrounding walls of the stadium began to stream the respective actions of the eight singers.
After entering the West Fourth Loop Stadium, the singers entered their respective waiting rooms and started to receive interviews by reporters, casually talking about their current moods, etc.

While they were in the midst of their preparation for the performance, six enormous mirrors suddenly rose up from the ground on the central stage of the stadium. And at the same time, the spotlights on the rooftops of the surrounding 18 skyscrapers were directed at the six mirrors!

The interior of the six mirrors were all made up of smaller mirrors, and as the spotlights shone on the mirrors, they began to reflect extremely beautiful lights. Coupled with the colorful decorations on the stage and lighting from the helicopters in the sky, the stage of “I Am a Singer” at this time could only be described with one word—Sci-fi.
Yes, the brilliant lighting effects looked as if they were produced from a sci-fi movie.
And at the same time, in the center of the stage, a circular platform slowly rose from the stage.
Miss Zhang Cai, one of the general managers of Caiwei Entertainment as well as the “I Am a Singer” host this time around, stood on the platform and slowly appeared in front of everyone!

For the event, Zhang Cai was dressed in a gorgeous evening gown. Originally, Zhang Cai’s looks could only be considered above average. However, after dressing up and putting on makeup, she became a world-class beauty. Everyone’s attention was attracted towards her the moment she appeared on stage.
Even Miao Nianyan, who was considered the best makeup artist in the entertainment circle, couldn’t help but exclaim: “This... this is absolutely beautiful!”

Sheng Wenshi and Ding Chengzhi knew Zhang Cai a fair bit. However, when they saw her appearance on stage, even they couldn’t help but be surprised. “Oh my god, Young Master is certainly willing to spend! The total amount spent on Zhang Cai’s makeup and dress is definitely not small!”

In fact, their guess was on the mark. Zhang Cai’s stylist was the world’s top French aristocratic dinner stylist, Mr. XX—naturally, the prodigal Hong Dali didn’t care to remember, the only thing he knew was that it cost him 50,000 for the stylist to put makeup on Zhang Cai.

“Ladies and gentlemen, good evening! Welcome to the performance of the first episode of “I Am a Singer.” Zhang Cai stood on stage with a relaxed and confident smile on her face. With a steady and clear voice, she said, “I’m the host, Zhang Cai. In this competition, there will be 5,000 members of the audience who will rate their favorite singers. For now, let us draw lots to see who is the first to come up on stage!”
As Zhang Cai’s introduction speech ended, the show which would shock the whole of Heavenly State officially started!
In the West Fourth Loop Stadium, VIP room.

Hong Dali brought his classmates along to have some snacks while watching the show. Ling Yi smiled and said, “Big Bro Dali, how does this show work? Although the venue is amazing, just watching them sing is quite boring.”
Du Xinzhen, on the other hand, said, “What are you in such a hurry for? I know at the tip of my fingers that Big Bro Dali definitely has something hidden up his sleeves!”

“Of course, I have something unique prepared.” Hong Dali said with a smile. “Otherwise, this kind of show would indeed be boring to watch. However, it can’t be shown today. It will only be officially rolled out during the end of episode two. Today is purely meant to test the waters. At present, it seems that the show is quite successful.”

“It’s indeed quite successful.” Lang Hao, who had always been going against Hong Dali’s words in the past, couldn’t help but be impressed by Hong Dali this time around. “This is no longer a small success. It’s more like an immense success! As long as nothing wrong happens during the show, the next episode will definitely be more popular, and the price of the tickets can skyrocket!” Speaking up to here, Lang Hao rushed up and hugged Hong Dali’s arms. “Big Bro Dali, teach me how to be a prodigal! In the future, I’ll be your most loyal follower!”

“Squandering is an art that requires talent!” Hong Dali twitched his nose and said, Your talent does not seem that good, and your bones are not that special. It’s difficult for you to become a prodigal!”

“Haha!” Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin, who was standing at the side, suddenly laughed and said, “You see, it’s not easy to become a prodigal. To become a successful prodigal like Dali, you need to have at least the same amount of luck Dali has first!”
“I...” Lang Hao fell helplessly on the sofa. “I was unlucky since young, seems like it’s hopeless...”
“It’s inevitable that your luck is bad.” Hong Dali did not forget to insult him. “If you don’t squander, how can your luck be good!”

Hong Dali chatted with his classmates in the VIP room. Meanwhile, Sheng Wenshi, Ku Ge’s chief editor, was looking at the huge screen hanging on the stage. It was currently broadcasting the ongoing interviews with the eight singers.

“Old Ding, why is that reporter acting so mysterious?” Sheng Wenshi asked strangely. “I have never seen reporters covering their faces. Shouldn’t it be the celebrities that normally have their faces covered?”
“En, it’s indeed strange.” Ding Chengzhi thought for a while and suddenly said in shock, “Right! A celebrity! The reporter herself is a big celebrity!”

At this time, a young man seated next to him inched closer and asked, “Chief Ding, did you managed to guess it?” The young man looked pretty handsome and was dressed in a branded suit, with a blood-red birthmark in the center of his forehead. It was Hong Dali’s new lackey, the young master of Mu family, Mu Zixiao!

Sheng Wenshi strangely said, “A big celebrity? This reporter is a big celebrity?” He looked at the reporter on the screen carefully. The more he looked, the bigger he widened his mouth. “This... this is not... Li Nianwei, right?!”

“This... this ... how many security guards did the Young Master employ!
What the heck!
Fifty rows of security guards with 10 in each row?
Isn’t that a total of 500 security guards leading the opening ceremony?!”

At this time, on the big screen, while the five hundred security guards were striding forward, the sky was also filled with twenty plus helicopters flying around—of course, among these twenty pluses, 20 were responsible for transportation while only three or four were responsible for shooting the scenes.
However, at first sight, it seemed as if the whole sky was filled with helicopters doing an aerial performance.
In addition to the 500 security guards at the beginning, the giant spotlights on the rooftops of surrounding skyscrapers all shone on the main road.
Just this spectacular scene caused the audience who did not enter the stadium to feel it was worth it to have come and deeply feel they didn’t come here for nothing today.
As for those that didn’t come, all they could feel was regret—perhaps the decision of saving ten dollars to purchase a ticket would remain as regret for a lifetime!

Behind the 500 security guards leading the way were the eight stars that would be participating in “I Am a Singer.” Each of them walked with a small team behind them that included their agents, five security guards, and ten reporters.
Just the entrance of the stars was enough to make people scream—wherever the celebrities went, they were welcomed with screams and chants, just like international celebrities.
It was no exaggeration to say that just by this scene, no one would doubt that they were the world’s top celebrities.
Chu Zhongqin walked in the forefront suavely, waving to the audience while making his way forward.
Coupled with his clothes which were decorated with diamonds, his long hair flowing in the wind, and his sunglasses...
The current him seemed to resemble the world’s international superstar from earth, Micheal Jackson, receiving screams from the audiences.
Some of the audience even fainted due to overexcitement.
The security guards nearby immediately took these people to rest.
Just by the opening ceremony, “I Am a Singer” had already left many speechless, their visual appetite satisfied!
But this was far from over!
Behind the eight singers was a more vast and mighty team!
With fifty rows of 10 security guards as one platoon, a total of nine platoons followed behind the singers.
These security guards held the red flag of the Heavenly State and shouted the pledge throughout.
The magnificent spectacle was almost comparable to that of a National Day parade.
Before “I Am a Singer” had even started its formal performance, the atmosphere of the crowd was already brought to the climax!
Numerous audiences shouted the names of the stars present and waved at them as if they were triumphant heroes!

At this time, the stars sitting in the West Fourth Loop Stadium were all regretting to the point where their intestines turned green—when they first heard from Zhang Cai’s phone call, they declined to participate as they felt the show was not a match to their status.
As a result, from the way things had turned out, they had already lost at least millions of potential revenue.
At least, for the eight singers who participated in the performance today, solely this opening ceremony could double or triple their net worth.
The worst part was that there was no upper limit to how much their reputation could rise...
Many singers were now ready to contact Miss Zhang Cai, the most popular agent in 2014, to discuss their appearance in the next few episodes.
However, it was obvious that with only one free slot every two episodes, it would certainly be a headache to acquire it.
When the pack of security guards reached the main door of West Fourth Loop Stadium, they came to a halt.
The 5000 security guards divided themselves into two teams and stood guard at both sides of the pathway they had just opened while the eight singers slowly made their way inside.
After they had all entered, all the gates of West Fourth Loop Stadium closed.
After that, the giant screens on the surrounding walls of the stadium began to stream the respective actions of the eight singers.
After entering the West Fourth Loop Stadium, the singers entered their respective waiting rooms and started to receive interviews by reporters, casually talking about their current moods, etc.
While they were in the midst of their preparation for the performance, six enormous mirrors suddenly rose up from the ground on the central stage of the stadium.
And at the same time, the spotlights on the rooftops of the surrounding 18 skyscrapers were directed at the six mirrors!
The interior of the six mirrors were all made up of smaller mirrors, and as the spotlights shone on the mirrors, they began to reflect extremely beautiful lights.
Coupled with the colorful decorations on the stage and lighting from the helicopters in the sky, the stage of “I Am a Singer” at this time could only be described with one word—Sci-fi.
Yes, the brilliant lighting effects looked as if they were produced from a sci-fi movie.
And at the same time, in the center of the stage, a circular platform slowly rose from the stage.
Miss Zhang Cai, one of the general managers of Caiwei Entertainment as well as the “I Am a Singer” host this time around, stood on the platform and slowly appeared in front of everyone!
For the event, Zhang Cai was dressed in a gorgeous evening gown.
Originally, Zhang Cai’s looks could only be considered above average.
However, after dressing up and putting on makeup, she became a world-class beauty.
Everyone’s attention was attracted towards her the moment she appeared on stage.
Even Miao Nianyan, who was considered the best makeup artist in the entertainment circle, couldn’t help but exclaim: “This... this is absolutely beautiful!”
Sheng Wenshi and Ding Chengzhi knew Zhang Cai a fair bit.
However, when they saw her appearance on stage, even they couldn’t help but be surprised.
“Oh my god, Young Master is certainly willing to spend!
The total amount spent on Zhang Cai’s makeup and dress is definitely not small!”
In fact, their guess was on the mark.
Zhang Cai’s stylist was the world’s top French aristocratic dinner stylist, Mr.
XX—naturally, the prodigal Hong Dali didn’t care to remember, the only thing he knew was that it cost him 50,000 for the stylist to put makeup on Zhang Cai.
“Ladies and gentlemen, good evening!
Welcome to the performance of the first episode of “I Am a Singer.” Zhang Cai stood on stage with a relaxed and confident smile on her face.
With a steady and clear voice, she said, “I’m the host, Zhang Cai.
In this competition, there will be 5,000 members of the audience who will rate their favorite singers.
For now, let us draw lots to see who is the first to come up on stage!”
As Zhang Cai’s introduction speech ended, the show which would shock the whole of Heavenly State officially started!
In the West Fourth Loop Stadium, VIP room.
Hong Dali brought his classmates along to have some snacks while watching the show.
Ling Yi smiled and said, “Big Bro Dali, how does this show work?
Although the venue is amazing, just watching them sing is quite boring.”
Du Xinzhen, on the other hand, said, “What are you in such a hurry for?
I know at the tip of my fingers that Big Bro Dali definitely has something hidden up his sleeves!”
“Of course, I have something unique prepared.” Hong Dali said with a smile.
“Otherwise, this kind of show would indeed be boring to watch.
However, it can’t be shown today.
It will only be officially rolled out during the end of episode two.
Today is purely meant to test the waters.
At present, it seems that the show is quite successful.”
“It’s indeed quite successful.” Lang Hao, who had always been going against Hong Dali’s words in the past, couldn’t help but be impressed by Hong Dali this time around.
“This is no longer a small success.
It’s more like an immense success!

As long as nothing wrong happens during the show, the next episode will definitely be more popular, and the price of the tickets can skyrocket!” Speaking up to here, Lang Hao rushed up and hugged Hong Dali’s arms.
“Big Bro Dali, teach me how to be a prodigal!
In the future, I’ll be your most loyal follower!”
“Squandering is an art that requires talent!” Hong Dali twitched his nose and said, Your talent does not seem that good, and your bones are not that special.
It’s difficult for you to become a prodigal!”
“Haha!” Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Tang Muxin, who was standing at the side, suddenly laughed and said, “You see, it’s not easy to become a prodigal.
To become a successful prodigal like Dali, you need to have at least the same amount of luck Dali has first!”
“I...” Lang Hao fell helplessly on the sofa.
“I was unlucky since young, seems like it’s hopeless...”
“It’s inevitable that your luck is bad.” Hong Dali did not forget to insult him.
“If you don’t squander, how can your luck be good!”
Hong Dali chatted with his classmates in the VIP room.
Meanwhile, Sheng Wenshi, Ku Ge’s chief editor, was looking at the huge screen hanging on the stage.
It was currently broadcasting the ongoing interviews with the eight singers.
“Old Ding, why is that reporter acting so mysterious?” Sheng Wenshi asked strangely.
“I have never seen reporters covering their faces.
Shouldn’t it be the celebrities that normally have their faces covered?”
“En, it’s indeed strange.” Ding Chengzhi thought for a while and suddenly said in shock, “Right!
A celebrity!
The reporter herself is a big celebrity!”

At this time, a young man seated next to him inched closer and asked, “Chief Ding, did you managed to guess it?” The young man looked pretty handsome and was dressed in a branded suit, with a blood-red birthmark in the center of his forehead.
It was Hong Dali’s new lackey, the young master of Mu family, Mu Zixiao!
Sheng Wenshi strangely said, “A big celebrity?
This reporter is a big celebrity?” He looked at the reporter on the screen carefully.
The more he looked, the bigger he widened his mouth.
“This... this is not...
Li Nianwei, right?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - Miracle
paragraphs: Sure enough, as if to prove Sheng Wenshi right, the female reporter slowly took off her scarf and glasses on her, and a beautiful face emerged on the huge screen. With such a close-up shot, everyone inside and outside the stadium went crazy!

The entire West Fourth Loop Stadium turned weirdly quiet for a while. After five seconds, cheers that resembled an earthquake began to sound, wave after wave. Countless people yelled out Li Nianwei’s name. Some had even started to cry and sob. The audience in the stadium were moved and excited, as they felt it was too worth it for them to have come. The people outside the stadium were beating their own chests—why did they purchase the tickets so late?! If they had bought their tickets early, wouldn’t they have had the chance to be physically close to their goddess?!
“Weiwei, I love you!” “Goddess, you’re my goddess!”
The stadium was filled with overwhelming cheers. Just this shot of Lin Nianwei was enough to make everyone excited to dawn this evening!

“Hong Dali has certainly thrown in his all!” Sheng Wenshi said powerlessly. “He even dared to let Miss Li Nianwei act as a temporary reporter to interview the stars. It’s such overkill. He has really squandered to the extreme...”

“To squander to such an extent can also be said to be a clever decision.” Ding Chengzhi had to admit. “With just this segment, it would let the program’s ratings burst the charts. Furthermore, the tickets for the next few episodes will definitely be highly sought after!”

“I have to admit, he is really good.” Sheng Wenshi smiled bitterly. “His ideas are not bad. Look at the famous domestic singers sitting on the side, many of them seem to be making calls already. They’re definitely trying to seek for the opportunity to participate in this show.”

“What use is there to call now,” Ding Chengzhi snorted. “Only one singer is eliminated every two episodes. How can the slot be so easily acquired? But in my opinion, even if they were asked to give hundreds of thousands to Young Master, they would definitely be willing!”

“I think so too.” Mu Zixiao, who was sitting beside them, said with a smile. “Dali’s actions can be described as godlike. We’re definitely not comparable to him. When I first saw him throw in so much money for a mere concert, I made fun of him. But now, my face has been slapped swollen by myself.”
“My face is also swollen.” Sheng Wenshi shook his head helplessly. “Forget it, if we look too much, it will be numb. Hey, let’s watch the show first.”
Thus, under the cheers of the audience, “I Am a Singer” first episode’s contest draw began.

“Chu Zhongqin, Liu Yuqiong, Xia Yuyao, Fei Chang, Yang Jun, Xiong Mao, Jiang Ruoyu, Li Wei.” Looking at these contestants, Sheng Wenshi touched his chin and said, “Speaking of which, this lineup cannot really be considered as the nation’s most famous singers. But have you found out that there is a special trait in this lineup? It seems that the one behind the scenes of this program is quite smart.”

Ding Chengzhi nodded. “En, these singers are good, but they were unable to shine due to various reasons. Liu Yuqiong is talented but had no opportunity to show his skills. Xia Yuyao has good singing skills, but unfortunately, she’s not really pretty. Fei Chang and Yang Jun are not low in net worth and should be here after being invited by Chu Zhongqin. Xiong Mao is one of the best low-toned singers, but because of his appearance and age, his popularity is not that high. Jiang Ruoyu has good abilities and good looks and is also the talented hind but has had no opportunity to shine. Li Wei has good singing abilities and has had a few big-selling albums. Unfortunately, there were no good songs in his later albums, causing his popularity to get lower and lower. Finally, Chu Zhongqin—he can be considered the big brother of the music world, abilities wise. There is no doubt he is good.”

“Yeah, such a lineup, haha, there is definitely going to be a fierce battle today.” Sheng Wenshi whispered and smiled. “By relying on his golden face, Chu Zhongqin will most likely be the first in this episode, while the remaining seven people will compete for the remaining six places. It’s certainly not an easy task!”
Ding Chengzhi nodded. “This is an open bias. Everyone will not mind. Ok, it’s starting. Let’s see who can make it to the second place this episode!”

Originally, according to the initial thinking of Sheng Wenshi and Ding Chengzhi, as with similar shows, singers would basically do the same thing after the start of the show—go up one by one, put a solo performance, and appeal to the audience for them to vote for himself or herself.
However, soon after, they were shocked.
The first to sing was the 22-year-old young singer, Jiang Ruoyu.
As she belonged to the category where she was talented but had no opportunity to shine, Sheng Wenshi and Ding Chengzhi were prepared to close their eyes and enjoy her performance.

However, just as they were ready to close their eyes, the lights on the stage suddenly dimmed. This sudden change made everyone confused. The audience had always thought that for a singer’s performance, the stage must be bright and flashy so that they could see the singer’s facial features. But they had not expected for there to be a technical fault so quickly.
“No, no,” Ding Chengzhi shook his head. “The Young Master is definitely not one who would make such a low-level mistake. I’m quite sure about this. But... what’s going on?”
Sheng Wenshi was also filled with doubt and said, confused, “With such dim lighting, how is it possible to see her face...”
As he spoke up to here, the whole stadium was suddenly engulfed in silence.
An eerie silence.
There was more than 50,000 audience in the stadium, and currently, all of them were completely silent.
It was just as if a bustling metropolis suddenly turned into a dead city.
The reason was, in fact, very simple. Starlight was illuminating next to Jiang Ruoyu!
It was real starlight! Stars slowly appeared from her side to her head, before appearing on the whole stage Jiang Ruoyu was performing on!
The stars had a variety of colors, ranging from yellow to blue to purple. They were like a child’s eyes, blinking from time to time, looking extremely beautiful!

“This... this is!!” Ding Chengzhi was completely shocked! It was not just him who was shocked, everyone present in the stadium watched in shock! Sheng Wenshi exclaimed, “What is this?! This scene is extremely beautiful...”
“It’s a Holographic Projection!” Mu Zixiao yelled at the side. “It’s the Holographic Projection in sci-fi films. God! Has Dali mastered such a technology?!”
Sure enough, with Mu Zixiao’s exclamation, tiny meteors slowly appeared around Jiang Ruoyu’s body!
Those meteors were tiny, but they looked very realistic. Those seated near couldn’t help but want to reach out to touch them and see if the meteors were real or fake!
Shock!
At this time, in the hearts of everyone, only the word “shock” could describe their feelings.
And just when everyone was exclaiming in shock, Jiang Ruoyu’s famous song, the prelude to “Starlight Teardrop,” began!
In the premium VIP room.

Looking at the scene, Ling Yi was stunned with his mouth agape. He suddenly jumped over and hugged Hong Dali’s arms. “Big Bro Dali! Is this the holographic projection in sci-fi films?! The one where the image of a real person can be projected during a call?”
Hong Dali laughed and ate a mouth of peeled jelly given by Ling Xiaoyi. He nodded. “Yep, that’s right. It’s similar to that, but regretfully, it’s currently only able to project monochrome images.”

“Big Bro Dali, I will follow you from now on!” Ling Yi burst into tears in her excitement. “I have dreamed of such technology for a long time and finally saw it today! Big Bro Dali, after the concert ends, you must bring us to see it!”

Tang Muxin smiled and said, “Look at your current behavior. It’s exactly like a country bumpkin. When the show is over, we will take you there.” To be honest, it felt really good to make fun of others.

Du Xinzhen stared at the stage below and was left tongue-tied for a long time. After a while, he finally said, “I knew at the tip of my fingers that Big Bro Dali had invested heavily into the concert this time around...” He then jumped over and hugged Hong Dali’s arm. “But I didn’t expect that Big Bro Dali would have been able to come up with such a thing! Big Bro Dali, please bring little brother here for some fun too!”

“I... I am completely impressed...” Lang Hao looked at the happenings below while twisting his thighs. “The Young Master could even come up with such technology. Look at the cheers of the audience and the excited expressions on their faces. It’s estimated that in the next episode, 50,000 tickets are definitely not enough!” Lang Hao also hugged Hong Dali’s arm. “Big Bro Dali, please teach me how to squander! I have really widened my horizons today! I’m your loyal follower from now on! I want to be like you!”
“Squandering is an art that requires talent!” Hong Dali twitched his nose and once again said his classic line. “Squandering is a skill. Y’all wouldn’t understand.”
Tang Muxin, who was standing at the side, smiled and said, “That’s true, to be able to squander and have such a successful outcome, only Dali can do it in this world!”
While Hong Dali was chatting and bullshitting with them, the audience below was completely captivated by the scene.

Jiang Ruoyu’s performance could be said to be perfect. Both the song and her live performance were amazing, and the special effects on stage could definitely be considered world-class. It was the Holographic Projection Technology we were talking about. Jiang Ruoyu was already beautiful originally. Coupled with the effects from the holographic stars, she seemed to be like a goddess. When the song reached the climax, countless meteors fell from the sky, making the performance breathtaking. Unless one had seen it personally, no one would believe that it was real.
Soon, “Starlight Teardrop” came to an end, and Jiang Ruoyu received the loudest applause in her life!
In the entire stadium, more than 50,000 hands were red, and the applause lasted for 30 seconds before it started to gradually weaken.

Outside the stadium, the countless audience was moved by the scene. This was a milestone in the music industry in the Heavenly State! This was a pioneering work in the world of music! A perfect song, coupled with the luxurious Holographic Projection Technology, this performance gave the same amount of shock as the time when humans first managed to fly a plane.
“This prodigal...” Sheng Wenshi collapsed in his chair and muttered. “This is a big story! Holographic Projection Technology, it’s actually the legendary Holographic Projection!”

“Young Master’s abilities are unfathomable!” Ding Chengzhi sighed. “No wonder the Young Master dares to say that whenever he produces something, it must be the best! If it’s not up to standard, then he will throw in all the money he can to make it the best!”
This program would not be able to have such effects if it were not for the Young Master organizing it.
“It’s... it’s an absolute miracle!”

Holographic Projection Technology, it’s actually the legendary Holographic Projection!”
“Young Master’s abilities are unfathomable!” Ding Chengzhi sighed.
“No wonder the Young Master dares to say that whenever he produces something, it must be the best!
If it’s not up to standard, then he will throw in all the money he can to make it the best!”
This program would not be able to have such effects if it were not for the Young Master organizing it.
“It’s... it’s an absolute miracle!”

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - A Storm
paragraphs: In the following time, the audience was totally absorbed in watching the performances.

Although only a total of eight singers sang on the stage, because of the Holographic Projection Technology dragging the time, everyone didn’t feel bored throughout the show. The whole place was filled with waves of screams and applause—there wasn’t even a need for Zhang Cai to hype up the atmosphere. The entire West Fourth Loop Stadium was always high in spirits and hyped up for the whole show.

For the following singers, the holographic projection continued to show its prowess. From the ocean to a forest, and even a snow-capped mountain, etc. The wide array of projections almost made the audience’ eyes pop out of their sockets.
Everyone went crazy!
The audience cheered their lungs out, wave after wave. When they met with songs they knew, the whole crowd even sang along with the singer!

It came to the point that, when Zhang Cai came out to give the closing speech, the countless audience still wanted more and strongly urged for an encore! Zhang Cai didn’t doubt that even if Young Master Dali, who always sang off the pitch, came up for a performance, he would still receive enthusiastic applause from all the audience present—as long as the holographic projection was present!

Of course, the show had to be finished at a certain time. Although Zhang Cai also hoped that the show could be longer, she still had to follow the rules. It was time for the final segment of the show, where the audience would rate and vote for the singers.

“Dear ladies and gentlemen, it’s now time to vote for the eight singers.” Zhang Cai, who was wearing an evening gown, had holographic stars revolving around her, making her look like a star goddess. Using her most gentle and pleasant voice, she said. “Tonight, the singers have undergone waves of assessment, and we have gathered 5,000 enthusiastic audience members to vote for the best singers in their minds. Each audience member can choose their three favorite singers, then press the communicator in your hand. After verification by the judges to ensure that the results are fair, we will then calculate the most popular singer.”
“Now, let the voting begin!”

In the following period of voting, it was no surprise that Chu Zhongqin won the first place with a large margin—the 5000 voters were all given a high-tech smartphone worth 800 yuan, making the result inevitable. In reality, as this was the first time performing in the show and as an elder in the music industry, he performed as if it were a matter of life or death. No one expressed their dissatisfaction towards the fact that he received the first position in this episode.
The second to seventh positions were then as follows: Jiang Ruoyu, Xia Yuyao, Liu Yuqiong, Fei Chang, Yang Jun, Li Wei.
The last position belonged to Xiong Mao.

This result was within the expectations of the audience, but it was not easy for Jiang Ruoyu to get the second place despite performing first. What was certain was that after tonight, the popularity of these singers would rise at the speed of a rocket.
The storm brought about by “I Am a Singer” swept through the entire country that night.
Tianjing Satellite TV.

Huang Taichang desperately dialed the number to contact Zhang Cai of Caiwei Entertainment. “Hello, is this Miss Zhang Cai? Ah, yes, yes, I’m Huang Zhongyang, the director of Tianjing TV. Haha, right. About that, Miss Zhang Cai,” Huang Zhongyang took a deep puff of his cigarette before wiping out the cigarette butt. “Our Beijing Satellite TV intends to pay one million yuan per episode to get the exclusive rights to the show ‘I Am a Singer.’ Could Miss Zhang Cai help in this matter?”

As the director of the TV station, Huang Zhongyang always had eyes above the top of his head. Although he couldn’t do whatever he liked, at least wherever he went, people in the entertainment circle would have to give him a face. Before, when Zhao Weichang, the president of Warwick Television, wanted to broadcast a TV series at 8:00 PM, he even had to tread carefully when talking with Huang Zhongyang.

However, it was now Director Huang that had to carefully ask Zhang Cai to grant him the exclusive rights to broadcast “I Am a singer,” and he had to even pay a high price for it. This could really be said to be what goes around, comes around.

“Okay, please wait a moment, I will need to ask Young Master’s opinion.” Zhang Cai smiled back and said. After leaving for a while, she replied, “Our Young Master has agreed, but on the condition that there are no advertisements inserted in the middle of the show.”
“I understand! I understand!” After hearing the reply, Huang Zhongyang almost wanted to rush to Hong Dali to hug and kiss him on the face.
At this point, no one cared about advertisements. With the exclusive rights to broadcast the show, Tianjing Satellite TV’s viewer’s ratings would at least double!

With such ratings, why would one still bother to sell advertisement slots? Moreover, after managing to buy this episode, it was equivalent to buying the exclusive rights for the next nine episodes! With just this exclusive right, the rise of Tianjing Satellite TV was more or less assured!
Putting down the phone, Huang Zhongyang’s forehead was covered in cold sweat. He then dialed another number—

“I want you to immediately remove all the programs from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM tomorrow night,” Director Huang screamed into the phone. “Every one of them! Not even one advertisement is allowed! All the programs have to give way to ‘I Am a Singer’! If I were to find that any advertisement had disrupted the look and feel of the show, you can roll out of the company, do you understand?!”
Shanghai’s Tianhai City, So Cool Information and Culture Development Private Limited headquarters, So Cool Video Building Twelfth floor, inside a small meeting room.

“Director Wu, about this time’s ‘I Am a Singer’ exclusive network rights...” “Yes, we absolutely can’t miss out this time around! From what we have gathered from Old Jiang and the pictures on the phone, it’s definitely the Holographic Projection Technology!”

In the conference room, all seven of So Cool company’s executives gathered together. The one seated in the main seat was dressed in a suit, with a bright face and neatly combed hair. He was the president of the So Cool Enterprise, Wu Youdao.

“Let me say it.” This time, no one bothered to talk nonsense, Wu Youdao said directly, “To tell the truth, I have already discussed the issue of “I Am a Singer” with Miss Zhang Cai before. The network exclusive rights will cost us 1.5 million per episode for a total of ten episodes. As to how much resources to allocate for the show, it will be up to you all to decide.”
After he finished speaking, there was a brief silence before the whole conference room exploded in a frenzy!
“Director Wu, are you sure that it’s us that are giving them 1.5 million?! Every episode?!” “This... this... we have to spend money to ask them to let us broadcast their show?!”

“I know what everyone is worried about.” Wu Youdao said slowly. “I will not beat around the bush. ‘I Am a Singer’ is definitely worth the price. Whenever the Young Master organizes something, it’s definitely different. None of the people who have seen the live show said that the show was bad. In fact, it’s us who have gotten it cheap. Other competitors even bid a sky-high price of three million, but in the end, they were still declined as the Young Master felt that we have had a good partnership before.

“There are already three or four domestic video streaming websites. If we don’t take them, we will lose out. Just by the response during the “I Am a Singer” live show, I absolutely believe that the Young Master did not cheat me.

“So, we would rather earn less and get the rights of the show than lose it to others. If the exclusive rights to the show are taken by other websites, I’m sure that within a month, we will have a new strong competitor emerging. And it’s very much possible that they might even take us down.”
After he had said his piece, Wu Youdao took in a deep breath and asked, “What do you all think?”
“I agree.” Everyone nodded their heads. “We have seen the live show. Its response was definitely stunning.”
“Director Wu, I suggest that it’s best for us to allocate the best resources for the show.” One of the executives below said. “Better than when we broadcastedUnexpectedly! last time!”
“Then, it’s decided. Tomorrow at 8:00 PM, the show will be broadcasted together with Tianjing Satellite TV.” Director Wu decided.
The next day, Wednesday.
In the morning, almost all streets and alleys in the whole country were covered with flyers about “I Am a Singer.” Numerous news reports about “I Am a Singer” were spreading fast.

In the beginning, the earliest insider news first spread from the mouth of a teenager in the West Fourth Loop of Tianjing City. It then swept through the entire internet, and then, it was covered by the various entertainment media companies.
The news all had a common point.
Tonight at 8:00 PM, Tianjing Satellite TV would be broadcasting the show without any advertisements in between.
And at the same time, “I Am a Singer” would also be broadcasted on So Cool Video website, with the best resources.
Everyone in the world waited in anticipation.
“Have you heard about ‘I Am a Singer’?” one person asked his colleague.
“I have heard of it, but what’s so good about it? Isn’t it just an ordinary talent show?” The other party was unaware of the latest happenings.

The latter immediately became proud. The latter laughed and said, “An ordinary talent show? It’s indeed a talent show, but there’s nothing ordinary about it. The singers of the show itself can only be regarded as normal celebrities, but what’s impressive is the atmosphere at the live show. It was absolutely stunning!”
“A talent show can be so impressive?!” The colleague was shocked.

“That’s a must. Whenever Dali produces something, it must be the best!” With a big laugh, he said, “Go watch the broadcast, it will surely not let you down. I received a photo my cousin sent me. Ai, I’m unable to use words to describe how good it was.”
“So impressive?!” The colleague silently thought: It’s said to broadcast at 8:00 PM tonight. I must definitely take a look when the time comes!

Such a scene appeared in countless offices, and everyone seemed filled with energy. They waited until 8:00 PM in the evening to go home and watch “I Am a Singer,” to see if it were really as shocking as what everyone said it to be. Whether or not Dali’s production was the best!

Of course, many people were caught by their bosses because of the discussion. Then, without exception, the bosses also expressed deep curiosity about this so-called biggest show in history. Thus, the staff were not punished but even gained their bosses’ praise...
