chapters.title: Chapter 142 - Craziness
paragraphs: Wednesday Night, 8:00 PM.
On TV and So Cool live broadcast.
Within just a short ten minutes, the whole Heavenly State erupted.
People had never thought that an ordinary talent show could produce such an overwhelming stage.
Fundamentally speaking, “I Am a Singer” was indeed an ordinary talent show. No matter how creative a form it had, it was still a talent show.
However, no one had expected that such an ordinary talent show could have such a breathtaking stage and venue.

From the five thousand security guards in the beginning to the helicopter picking up the audience, and then to the giant spotlights on top of the surrounding skyscrapers, it had left everyone dumbstruck. With just these, it was enough to make everyone crazy.
This could not be simply expressed as throwing in money.
For such a scene, only one word was appropriate to describe it—prodigal.
Yes, squandering like a prodigal. It had only been ten minutes since the start, but it was analyzed by experts in the industry that it had cost at least three million yuan.

Three million for an opening scene of ten minutes—it was no wonder that countless people had completely kneeled down in the end. They only had one idea left in mind: “When Dali produces something, it must be the best! If it’s not up to standard, he will throw in all the money needed to ensure it’s the best!”
Such a scene could indeed not be described as art—not even the slightest bit was linked to art.

But no one would object that this opening ceremony created through burning money was indeed perfect! It could even be said that many people might not even be able to see such a scene in their lifetime.

After the shocking opening scene and Li Nianwei’s flawless face was displayed on the screen, “I Am a Singer” immediately caught on fire. The fire was beyond people’s imagination and burned throughout the entire entertainment circle.
Goddess Li Nianwei.

This star who had never received any endorsement contract since her debut, a Goddess-level figure whose reputation rose in the entertainment circle like a comet was actually willing to serve as an interview reporter on the spot! And it was precisely because of this that her net worth skyrocketed again—because when the camera caught her close-up, even the most discerning person couldn’t pick out the slightest bit of problem on her.
Then, the entire Holographic Projection Technology was completely unveiled in front of everyone for the first time.
In just a split second.
The whole world went crazy.

In this world where entertainment was lacking, Holographic Projection Technology meant a lot. It managed to produce a dreamlike landscape of unparalleled beauty. People didn’t even dare to use beauty to describe it and praised it as it was much better than that. It could be said that this was a milestone in the history of entertainment. This episode of “I Am a Singer” was a big jump in the entertainment industry in human history.
From a normal stage, it had transformed into a mystical one.
“I Am a Singer” immediately went on fire in the whole world.
Colleagues, Turkey friends, Weipo, and major portals reported and discussed “I Am a Singer” at an unprecedented rate, causing the show’s fame to spread like a virus.
Almost all the teenagers who kept up with the trend discussed “I Am a Singer”—the shocking opening, the perfection of Goddess Li Nianwei, and the power of Holographic Projection Technology.
The administrators of the major websites smiled at the crazy site traffic. Just a report related to “I Am a Singer” would cause the site traffic of the website to skyrocket.
With a single report from a large portal, traffic data had soared to millions and continued to climb to new heights.
In an internet cafe.
“‘I Am a Singer’ is so cool! But it’s too short, lasting only an hour and a half. It’s not enough at all!”

“When Dali produces something, it must be the best! If someone were to have told me that in the past, I would have mocked him. But now, I’m in complete in agreement with this whatsoever declaration. He’s just like a god!”
“Ai, does this Dali have any other productions before this? To have been able to come up with such a show, he’s definitely not a simple person!”
“After hearing you say that, I’m indeed quite curious now. Let me check.”
Five minutes later, a scream sounded in the internet cafe.
“This Dali is actually the organizer of Goddess Li Nianwei’s concert and the producer ofUnexpectedly!!”
“It’s him? It’s actually him?!”

Everyone went crazy. “He was the one who came up with the God-level plan for the concert of the Goddess Li Nianwei?? The one where more than forty luxury cars were used as lighting?” “The producer ofUnexpectedly!?!” “No wonder! It’s no wonder that he dares to say that whenever Dali produces something, it must be the best! His abilities are through the sky!”
Unknowingly, because of this news, Li Nianwei’s concert andUnexpectedly! downloads reached new heights.

“I Am a Singer” went on fire all over the country. After the broadcast at 8:00 PM on Wednesday, news media reports swiftly followed, and there was a lot of discussion about the show. The comments were quite professional. Those that didn’t know much only knew it was good. They didn’t put superficial comments but mainly focused on talking about the Holographic Projection Technology of the show and the overall quality of the singers.

“When I saw the unveiling of the Holographic Projection Technology, I was completely stunned. The technology of Heavenly State has already reached such a height. It’s something that certainly makes me over the moon.”

“I really like the fact that ‘I Am a Singer’ has no judges. I have had enough of those unreliable judges. There is no need for comments, no need for scoring. The audience’s votes directly decide whether the singer leaves or stay. This is awesome.”

“A simple opening with no nonsense. A draw for the sequence of singing before the first singer directly enters the stage. Once the singer is up, the music starts rolling. I like this. There is no need for interviews. The role of the singer is to sing. There is no need for so many intermissions. Jiang Ruoyu’s ‘Starlight Teardrop’ was really good.”

“When I heard them sing, I felt that my true love was back. On top of their strong foundational singing skills, their songs were filled with so much emotion. When I watch the other talent shows, the singers either have skill but no emotion, or no emotion and no skill. But through this episode of “I Am a Singer,” I have finally heard and seen the most touching song. A good song with a good singer solely focused on singing and bringing out the best.”

“This show is truly good. What’s rare is that it didn’t insert any advertisements in the whole process. Of course, if you have to say that this is to advertise the organizer, Caiwei Entertainment, then I have nothing to say.”

Of course, the main focus of these reports were all on the show itself. The real person behind the scene, Hong Dali, was left unreported—this was not because they didn’t want to, but Caiwei Entertainment had issued a statement that they were not allowed to talk about it. Otherwise, they would be sued.

It must be said that Hong Dali was really a person who was quite afraid of trouble. He always believed that his job was to spend money every day. As for how much money was earned, his lackeys would help him calculate it. He couldn’t bother to use his brain cells on that.

And the result of this was that Young Master Dali, the one who had proclaimed “Whenever Dali produces something, it must be the best! If it’s not up to standard, then he would throw in all the money he can to make it the best!” became more and more mysterious.

However, in just one day, the online search for Hong Dali, the God-level organizer, was much hotter than that of the big stars. The number of click rates increased, and the mystery continued to grow. One could see millions of posts related to him in one day.
Of course, there were also some who said otherwise on the internet.
However, towards such discussions, Hong Dali naturally didn’t even bother to look at them.

It had to be said that the people of the Heavenly State were quite simple—they didn’t care what the mess was. As long as the picture quality was good, the singer was good, the atmosphere was good, the show was good.
And these were definitely not an issue for “I Am a Singer” which had Hong Dali behind.

The continuous broadcast of “I Am a Singer” shocked countless people. Almost without any resistance, everyone accepted the claim “When Dali produces something, it must be the best!”. And at this time, the vice president of Caiwei Entertainment, the manager of the Goddess Li Nianwei, Zhang Cai, threw out the second piece of shocking news—
“The second episode ofUnexpectedly! is going to be recorded soon.” During the news conference, Zhang Cai said.

Thus, the whole of Heavenly State was once again drowned in madness. How could people forget the toy knife that shined brightly? How could people forget the impeccable martial arts effects that were through the sky? How could people forget the classic line “I have no regrets in my youth?”

With the skyrocketing fame of “I Am a Singer” and Zhang Cai’s speech, it causedUnexpectedly!’s download count to reach a new peak. Countless people became curious about this micro-movie, and overnight, Hong Dali become the male God in the hearts of many girls!
Of course, if someone’s happy, there would be someone frustrated.
Tianjing Satellite TV’s Huang Zhongyang was now rolling back and forth in joy and grief. He was feeling painful and happy at the same time.

“Hey, this is Tianjing Satellite TV. Ah, really sorry, our TV station’s advertisement slots have been filled to midnight until 12:00 AM.” Huang Zhongyang was happy and anxious. Then, he said, “At present, the ratings of our TV station have reached 4.6% and is still growing. It can’t be helped. I too want to answer to your company, but there really is no more slots left.”

“What? Your company intends to have the advertisement in the early morning slot?” Huang Zhongyang wiped his cold sweat. “But there’s already a show in that time slot... Oh, ok, ok, I will try to arrange it.”
Unlike Huang Zhongyang’s who was living in grief and happiness, Zhao Wei of Warwick Films was sitting at his desk looking at the ratings’ report in his hand, with sweat all over his forehead.
The ratings of the series he shot were terrible, though Huang Zhongyang had already given him sufficient face.

Because there were too many advertisements inserted in the TV series, countless viewers kept complaining: “Can you not insert advertisements in TV dramas? The advertisements keep popping up here and there...”
After hearing the netizens comments, Director Zhao almost wanted to die.
What was most frustrating for him was that he had no way to change the status quo. He couldn’t possibly ask the other party to insert commercials, right?

From the five thousand security guards in the beginning to the helicopter picking up the audience, and then to the giant spotlights on top of the surrounding skyscrapers, it had left everyone dumbstruck.
With just these, it was enough to make everyone crazy.
This could not be simply expressed as throwing in money.
For such a scene, only one word was appropriate to describe it—prodigal.
Yes, squandering like a prodigal.
It had only been ten minutes since the start, but it was analyzed by experts in the industry that it had cost at least three million yuan.
Three million for an opening scene of ten minutes—it was no wonder that countless people had completely kneeled down in the end.
They only had one idea left in mind: “When Dali produces something, it must be the best!
If it’s not up to standard, he will throw in all the money needed to ensure it’s the best!”
Such a scene could indeed not be described as art—not even the slightest bit was linked to art.
But no one would object that this opening ceremony created through burning money was indeed perfect!
It could even be said that many people might not even be able to see such a scene in their lifetime.
After the shocking opening scene and Li Nianwei’s flawless face was displayed on the screen, “I Am a Singer” immediately caught on fire.
The fire was beyond people’s imagination and burned throughout the entire entertainment circle.
Goddess Li Nianwei.

This star who had never received any endorsement contract since her debut, a Goddess-level figure whose reputation rose in the entertainment circle like a comet was actually willing to serve as an interview reporter on the spot!

And it was precisely because of this that her net worth skyrocketed again—because when the camera caught her close-up, even the most discerning person couldn’t pick out the slightest bit of problem on her.
Then, the entire Holographic Projection Technology was completely unveiled in front of everyone for the first time.
In just a split second.
The whole world went crazy.
In this world where entertainment was lacking, Holographic Projection Technology meant a lot.
It managed to produce a dreamlike landscape of unparalleled beauty.
People didn’t even dare to use beauty to describe it and praised it as it was much better than that.
It could be said that this was a milestone in the history of entertainment.
This episode of “I Am a Singer” was a big jump in the entertainment industry in human history.
From a normal stage, it had transformed into a mystical one.
“I Am a Singer” immediately went on fire in the whole world.
Colleagues, Turkey friends, Weipo, and major portals reported and discussed “I Am a Singer” at an unprecedented rate, causing the show’s fame to spread like a virus.
Almost all the teenagers who kept up with the trend discussed “I Am a Singer”—the shocking opening, the perfection of Goddess Li Nianwei, and the power of Holographic Projection Technology.
The administrators of the major websites smiled at the crazy site traffic.
Just a report related to “I Am a Singer” would cause the site traffic of the website to skyrocket.
With a single report from a large portal, traffic data had soared to millions and continued to climb to new heights.
In an internet cafe.
“‘I Am a Singer’ is so cool!
But it’s too short, lasting only an hour and a half.
It’s not enough at all!”
“When Dali produces something, it must be the best!
If someone were to have told me that in the past, I would have mocked him.
But now, I’m in complete in agreement with this whatsoever declaration.
He’s just like a god!”
“Ai, does this Dali have any other productions before this?
To have been able to come up with such a show, he’s definitely not a simple person!”
“After hearing you say that, I’m indeed quite curious now.
Let me check.”
Five minutes later, a scream sounded in the internet cafe.
“This Dali is actually the organizer of Goddess Li Nianwei’s concert and the producer ofUnexpectedly!!”
“It’s him?
It’s actually him?!”
Everyone went crazy.
“He was the one who came up with the God-level plan for the concert of the Goddess Li Nianwei??
The one where more than forty luxury cars were used as lighting?” “The producer ofUnexpectedly!?!” “No wonder!
It’s no wonder that he dares to say that whenever Dali produces something, it must be the best!
His abilities are through the sky!”
Unknowingly, because of this news, Li Nianwei’s concert andUnexpectedly! downloads reached new heights.
“I Am a Singer” went on fire all over the country.
After the broadcast at 8:00 PM on Wednesday, news media reports swiftly followed, and there was a lot of discussion about the show.
The comments were quite professional.
Those that didn’t know much only knew it was good.
They didn’t put superficial comments but mainly focused on talking about the Holographic Projection Technology of the show and the overall quality of the singers.
“When I saw the unveiling of the Holographic Projection Technology, I was completely stunned.
The technology of Heavenly State has already reached such a height.
It’s something that certainly makes me over the moon.”
“I really like the fact that ‘I Am a Singer’ has no judges.
I have had enough of those unreliable judges.
There is no need for comments, no need for scoring.
The audience’s votes directly decide whether the singer leaves or stay.
This is awesome.”
“A simple opening with no nonsense.
A draw for the sequence of singing before the first singer directly enters the stage.
Once the singer is up, the music starts rolling.
I like this.
There is no need for interviews.
The role of the singer is to sing.
There is no need for so many intermissions.
Jiang Ruoyu’s ‘Starlight Teardrop’ was really good.”
“When I heard them sing, I felt that my true love was back.
On top of their strong foundational singing skills, their songs were filled with so much emotion.
When I watch the other talent shows, the singers either have skill but no emotion, or no emotion and no skill.
But through this episode of “I Am a Singer,” I have finally heard and seen the most touching song.
A good song with a good singer solely focused on singing and bringing out the best.”
“This show is truly good.
What’s rare is that it didn’t insert any advertisements in the whole process.
Of course, if you have to say that this is to advertise the organizer, Caiwei Entertainment, then I have nothing to say.”
Of course, the main focus of these reports were all on the show itself.
The real person behind the scene, Hong Dali, was left unreported—this was not because they didn’t want to, but Caiwei Entertainment had issued a statement that they were not allowed to talk about it.
Otherwise, they would be sued.
It must be said that Hong Dali was really a person who was quite afraid of trouble.
He always believed that his job was to spend money every day.
As for how much money was earned, his lackeys would help him calculate it.
He couldn’t bother to use his brain cells on that.
And the result of this was that Young Master Dali, the one who had proclaimed “Whenever Dali produces something, it must be the best!
If it’s not up to standard, then he would throw in all the money he can to make it the best!” became more and more mysterious.
However, in just one day, the online search for Hong Dali, the God-level organizer, was much hotter than that of the big stars.
The number of click rates increased, and the mystery continued to grow.
One could see millions of posts related to him in one day.
Of course, there were also some who said otherwise on the internet.
However, towards such discussions, Hong Dali naturally didn’t even bother to look at them.
It had to be said that the people of the Heavenly State were quite simple—they didn’t care what the mess was.
As long as the picture quality was good, the singer was good, the atmosphere was good, the show was good.
And these were definitely not an issue for “I Am a Singer” which had Hong Dali behind.
The continuous broadcast of “I Am a Singer” shocked countless people.
Almost without any resistance, everyone accepted the claim “When Dali produces something, it must be the best!”.
And at this time, the vice president of Caiwei Entertainment, the manager of the Goddess Li Nianwei, Zhang Cai, threw out the second piece of shocking news—
“The second episode ofUnexpectedly! is going to be recorded soon.” During the news conference, Zhang Cai said.
Thus, the whole of Heavenly State was once again drowned in madness.
How could people forget the toy knife that shined brightly?
How could people forget the impeccable martial arts effects that were through the sky?
How could people forget the classic line “I have no regrets in my youth?”
With the skyrocketing fame of “I Am a Singer” and Zhang Cai’s speech, it causedUnexpectedly!’s download count to reach a new peak.
Countless people became curious about this micro-movie, and overnight, Hong Dali become the male God in the hearts of many girls!
Of course, if someone’s happy, there would be someone frustrated.
Tianjing Satellite TV’s Huang Zhongyang was now rolling back and forth in joy and grief.
He was feeling painful and happy at the same time.
“Hey, this is Tianjing Satellite TV.
Ah, really sorry, our TV station’s advertisement slots have been filled to midnight until 12:00 AM.” Huang Zhongyang was happy and anxious.
Then, he said, “At present, the ratings of our TV station have reached 4.6% and is still growing.
It can’t be helped.
I too want to answer to your company, but there really is no more slots left.”
“What?
Your company intends to have the advertisement in the early morning slot?” Huang Zhongyang wiped his cold sweat.
“But there’s already a show in that time slot...
Oh, ok, ok, I will try to arrange it.”
Unlike Huang Zhongyang’s who was living in grief and happiness, Zhao Wei of Warwick Films was sitting at his desk looking at the ratings’ report in his hand, with sweat all over his forehead.
The ratings of the series he shot were terrible, though Huang Zhongyang had already given him sufficient face.
Because there were too many advertisements inserted in the TV series, countless viewers kept complaining: “Can you not insert advertisements in TV dramas?
The advertisements keep popping up here and there...”
After hearing the netizens comments, Director Zhao almost wanted to die.
What was most frustrating for him was that he had no way to change the status quo.
He couldn’t possibly ask the other party to insert commercials, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - The System’s Mission
paragraphs: Tianjing City, villa by Hong Lake in the southwest, villa no. 16.

Hong Anbao violently threw the wine glass onto the floor. “Damn it! Why is that rascal Hong Dali’s luck so good!? Everything he squanders in something, he always manages to get back such a big reward!? I Am a Singer, I Am a Singer! Damn it! How the heck did this show become so popular? How can it become so popular!? My plan was almost going to succeed, but this happened! Damn it, this can’t do, I need to think of something! There are only three best slots for the younger generation during the family meeting! Mu Yuxi that b*tch definitely will take up one of them, and Big Uncle’s son, Hong Anjin, definitely will count as one of them too. If Hong Dali takes up the last slot, I will be left with nothing!”

It was no wonder that he was nervous, only three people would be awarded as one of the most capable members of the younger generation. The one in the first place would obtain a 100 million yuan of capital, the second 80 million yuan, and the last 50 million yuan.
Seeing that Hong Dali’s show was reaping such high rewards, Hong Anbao was really getting nervous.
Especially as recently, his Fierce Bull beverages was obviously loosing to Might Beverages, the sales performance constantly going downwards!
“This can’t do, I must think of something! I can’t just sit around and wait!” Hong Anbao fiercely said.
Disregarding how Hong Anbao was worried about himself, the popularity of “I Am a Singer” was still on the rise.
Thursday afternoon, as the forum for “I Am a Singer” was created on Sangle, the number of members shortly exceeded 500,000 and continued to increase rapidly.
Friday, the official Weibo for “I Am a Singer” was formed, and the number of members who followed it reached 200,000 in the morning. As word got around, every hour saw an increase of 10,000 or so.
Saturday, the media started to focus on introducing the Holographic Projection Technology and translated the report in several languages, posting it on the articles of other countries too.
Sunday, city center, Sangle headquarters, 16th floor.

The secretary was full of sweat as he read the report in his hand. He carefully reported to Hong Weiguo: “CEO Hong, the number of people using our search engine increased by another 4% these few days. The main reason was because of ‘I Am a Singer’ that Young Master Dali hosted. From the looks of it, there’s still a lot of room for growth. After all, similar toUnexpectedly!, ‘I Am a Singer’ also has ten episodes...”
Hong Weiguo helplessly shook his head. “This little rascal. He spent seven to eight million just for a TV show, he is really daring.”
The secretary stood at one side, asking, “CEO Hong, then, what should we do next...”

Hong Weiguo touched his chin, suddenly changing the subject. “We don’t have to do anything. Oh right, that child, Lin Chuyin, how is she doing lately? I remember that she brought Dali to her lab the other day.”

The secretary said, “Yes, that’s right. Currently, Miss Chuyin treats Young Master Dali quite well. The Holographic Projection Technology was her creation, and she gave it to Young Master Dali. But Young Master Dali’s moral quality is very good—on the day he got the technology, he helped Miss Chuyin to apply for its patent. From the current looks of things, Miss Chuyin didn’t object to it. Oh right, one of the few projects that Young Master Dali requested to develop was to build a laboratory for Miss Chuyin. The venue is at the outer area of Tianjing Mountain, and work has already started.”

Hong Weiguo took in a deep breath. “What is this little rascal planning to do exactly? He wants to build a mountain stronghold at Fengyuan Lake to be a bandit lord, and instead of building villas at Tianjing Mountain, he plans to build a laboratory. After producing ‘I Am a Singer’ andUnexpectedly!, he went to play in the movie industry...”
Hearing Hong Weiguo’s muttering, the secretary softly said, “CEO Hong, I think that Young Master Dali seems to be... seems to be...”
“Seems to be what?” Hong Weiguo asked.

The secretary wiped his sweat and said, “He seems to be planning on taking over all of the industries. There’s also Zhong Dian website, buying of land, and recently, he made a research laboratory in Chenhui Building 10th floor... He’s involved in too many areas...”

Once he remembered the things that Hong Dali recently did, Hong Weiguo wanted to laugh. “This little prodigal. If he wants to play around, then let him be. There aren’t any major projects anyway, only ten million and below. It’s not a problem.”

“OK, I will go and arrange it now.” Being able to become Hong Weiguo’s secretary, his eye power was naturally not bad. But as he was leaving, he didn’t forget to ask one last thing, “But CEO Hong, according to reports, Young Master Dali seems to be starting to earn money.”

“How much did he earn? Hm, let me count.” Hong Weiguo started to count those assets of Hong Dali that might be earning money. “Ye Lai Xiang, the internet downloads forUnexpectedly! and ‘I Am a Singer,’ plus the copyright fees and such... He should have earned 2 million or so, right?”
“Er...” The secretary flipped through the report, then difficultly swallowed down his saliva. “CEO Hong, what you said is... a bit too little.”
“Too little? Then, how much is it?” Hong Weiguo curiously asked.

The secretary tabulated: “Currently, the fee to broadcast each episode of ‘I Am a Singer’ is one million. The fee for So Cool video-sharing website is one 1.5 million. Plus the entrance fee for each performance of ‘I Am a Singer,’ the current estimation after deducting the cost is that Young Master Dali can earn about three million yuan of pocket money every week.”
“...” Hong Weiguo was totally speechless.

The secretary continued to report: “And from Miss Zhang Cai’s latest report, there seems to be a foreign TV station that plans to buy the rights to host ‘I Am a Singer’ overseas. The discussion is still in progress, but details haven’t been finalized yet.”
Hong Weiguo laughed loudly. “This little rascal, it seems that he is giving us a big surprise this time as well. OK, you can leave first. Let me think this over carefully.”
“OK.” The secretary instantly exited the room.
After the secretary left, Hong Weiguo fiercely clenched his fist. “Well done, Dali! By the time of the family meeting, let’s see who still dares to say anything against you, hahaha!”
Chenhui Building, Caiwei Entertainment.

Zhang Cai held two documents and reported to Hong Dali: “Young Master, currently, there are people from South Korea and Merika who want to buy the rights to ‘I Am a Singer.’ Young Master, your instructions are...”

“South Korea?” Hong Dali was planning to say that he didn’t plan to sell the rights, but once he imagined selling “I Am a Singer” to the “Oppas” in South Korea, the thought of it felt quite enjoyable. “How much did they offer?”
Zhang Cai looked at the document and said, “They offered three million yuan to buy the lifelong rights to host ‘I Am a Singer.’”
“Three million...” Hong Dali smiled in disdain. “Are they trying to fool a ghost? No.”

Hearing him say this, Tang Muxin, who was at the side, was instantly alarmed. She softly reminded him, “Dali, this is just the right for them to host the show, we don’t have to give them anything else.”
Hong Dali still objected. “I know that. The problem is that the price is too low! Those Koreans are rich anyway, it’s fine. What about Merika?”
“The people from Merika offered four million US dollars, but they request that we lend them the Holographic Projection Technology.” Zhang Cai asked, “Then, Young Master, for them...”

“No.” This time, Holographic Projection Technology was even more straightforward. As the Holographic Projection Technology was still not yet fully completed, it still needed to be kept a secret. Otherwise, once they borrowed the Holographic Projection Technology and directly developed the Colored Holographic Projection Technology and applied the patent for it, it would be a huge loss! Therefore, he decisively rejected. “Just four million, and they want to borrow the Holographic Projection Technology? Tell them to f*ck off! They think I don’t know what they are truly thinking of?”
This time, Tang Muxin totally agreed with him. “Dali, you’re really smart. I thought you rejected because you thought the price was too low, but it was actually because of this. Not bad at all.”

Laying on Li Nianwei’s thigh, Hong Dali changed his position and said, “That’s for sure, it’s not like I’m lacking money. This Holographic Projection Technology is very important, we can’t lend it out easily. What do we do if they learn the technology through it? I’m not afraid that they will imitate our technology, but I’m afraid that they will defeat our legal one with their imitated one!”
Imitated defeating the legal, this was something that the QQ company from his previous life often did. Hong Dali couldn’t afford to be careless.
“Then, I shall go back and reject them.” Since the Young Master had already decided, Zhang Cai naturally knew what to do.

“Ah~~ I shall sleep for a while more.” After giving out a long yawn, Hong Dali closed his eyes. But in his mind, he hurriedly pulled out the Great Prodigal System. Now that the third mission had been completed, he was only left with adding in the attribute points!

System: “The third mission has been completed, an extra 15 attribute points shall be rewarded. At the same time, as all of the beginner missions have been completed, the System shall be going through a countdown to the upgrade phase. Once the host has reached 100 points in each attribute, the System shall undergo the upgrade immediately. Once the System is upgraded, only the attributes will be maintained at the maximum. The other monetary values will all be erased.”

What this meant was simple. As the beginner missions had all been completed, the remaining thing to do was just to accumulate attribute points to maximize his attributes. Once that was done, the System would upgrade itself. Once the upgrade started, regardless of how much extra attribute points he had left—and whether he added them or not—the stats would go back to the default maximum, and the rest of the values and attribute points would be erased.
He believed that, by that time, the System would definitely have more and better functions—in fact, there was already two quite good Side Missions:

[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Unknown. Current Progress: 0/1000. Mission Reward: The title “Animals’ Best Friend.” Title Effect: The host will not be attacked by any big animals as long as the host does not attack them first. Title Level: Junior. Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed. Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]

[Side Mission 2: Nature’s Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Protect the environment. Current Progress: 232/1000. Mission Reward: The title “Nature’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Obtain the favor of Nature, the ability to freely float in water. Title Level: Junior. Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed. Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
These were good missions... Hong Dali smiled in delight.

Once the upgrade started, regardless of how much extra attribute points he had left—and whether he added them or not—the stats would go back to the default maximum, and the rest of the values and attribute points would be erased.
He believed that, by that time, the System would definitely have more and better functions—in fact, there was already two quite good Side Missions:
[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal.
Mission Requirement: Unknown.
Current Progress: 0/1000.
Mission Reward: The title “Animals’ Best Friend.” Title Effect: The host will not be attacked by any big animals as long as the host does not attack them first.
Title Level: Junior.
Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed.
Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
[Side Mission 2: Nature’s Little Prodigal.
Mission Requirement: Protect the environment.
Current Progress: 232/1000.
Mission Reward: The title “Nature’s Best Friend.” Title Effect: Obtain the favor of Nature, the ability to freely float in water.
Title Level: Junior.
Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed.
Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
These were good missions...
Hong Dali smiled in delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - Do You Think That I Can’t Count!?
paragraphs: Being a high-level perfectionist, when Hong Dali saw these two Side Missions, he was so excited that he couldn’t sleep.
Since there was no rush to upgrade the System and no time restriction, he definitely had to complete these two Side Missions!

As for the Mission Reward... since it was for the purpose of squandering anyway, what Hong Dali enjoyed was the process of doing the mission. As for what the reward was, he wasn’t concerned over it at all!

Hong Dali pretended to sleep while considering.Yeah, these two Side Missions are not bad, indeed. I shall start doing them once I’m done with adding the attribute points! How should I add the attribute points? Split it evenly or add it on a single attribute first? Coupled with the mission reward, I have a total of 94 attribute points now. I can definitely max one of the attributes, but strength, speed, and reflexes are interlinked. If I add everything evenly, there won’t be much of a point if my body cannot react fast enough to my reflexes. It also won’t do if my speed is fast but I can’t react in time... Then, this means that strength is the least important of them all.

After a long time considering, Hong Dali fiercely clenched his teeth and thought: Strength: 36. Speed: 41. Reflexes: 52. Strength is not as important, I don’t have much use for it now. Not like I will be fighting with others. Then, for the 94 attribute points, I shall add 40 to Reflex and 54 to Speed. That will result in 95 in Speed and 92 in Reflex—not bad. It’s decided, then!

He then added the attribute points as he had decided. Again, a golden light that only Hong Dali could see flashed by. Hong Dali instantly felt his mind lighten up and his body became more agile... OK, this was purely his imagination.
Regardless of that, this Great Prodigal System was definitely legit. Therefore, Hong Dali wasn’t suspicious at all of the results of adding in the attribute points.
What he was considering now was how to complete the two Side Missions.

For the first one, The Caring Little Prodigal, from the title effect, it was apparent it had to do with animals. The question was how exactly go about doing it. But there wasn’t much fear in that since it definitely had to do with caring for them.
As for the second one, the System actually said that the Current Progress was already 232/1000, how did that happen? Could it be that he unknowingly already started doing this Mission?

No matter how he thought, he couldn’t remember what he did regarding the environment.Fengyuan Lake? There are mountains and water there. Other than that, only the outer area of Tianjing Mountain is left. Wait! The outer area of Tianjing Mountain? Didn’t I send people to clear the trash in that area? So this means that the second Mission refers to clearing trash such as tissues and plastic bags? Heh heh, as long as it’s this, things will be much easier. I will just have to ask someone about it later to confirm.

Thinking up to this point, just as Hong Dali was preparing to take a good nap, he suddenly heard a commotion going on outside. Being a well-known prodigal and hedonist, Hong Dali was instantly angered. “Who is that! Shut up! How am I supposed to sleep!? Do you believe that I’m going to get someone to kick you to the first level!”

Just when he finished shouting, a group of three angrily barged in. The lead person, a middle-aged man, instantly bombarded Hong Dali with questions upon seeing him. “We have already offered you a good price just for the right to host and broadcast in our South Korea. Why did you reject!? Are you looking down on the citizens from the Republic of Korea!?” After they barged in, another four Merikans followed in behind them.
What the heck, there were still those who forced others to trade these days?
Hong Dali looked at Zhang Cai, who was following behind them, and asked in a puzzled tone, “Sister Cai, have they taken the wrong medicine?”

Zhang Cai helplessly said, “It was like this. I have already told them that we don’t have any plans to sell the rights overseas currently, but they kept saying that we’re rejecting them because we think that the price is too low. So, they ran here to ask you.”
“Oh, I see.” Hong Dali sniffled and looked at the four Merikans behind them. “What about you guys?”

One of them, a glasses yellow-bearded man, said, “Oh, it’s like this. My dear Mr. Hong, we also want to buy over the rights to host ‘I Am a Singer,’ and our price is four million US dollars. But we also wish that Mr. Hong can lend us the Holographic Projection Technology.”

“This price is acceptable.” Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said towards Zhang Cai, “Sister Cai, you can follow them and bring the equipment over. Once they finish the performances, bring it back immediately.”
Zhang Cai tolerated the urge to laugh. “Ok, Young Master. I will go there personally.”

This Young Master is really too evil. These Merikans want to steal the technology, but now that Hong Dali has already thrown down his words, they can borrow the technology, but it can’t go through their hands. This way, even if they want to steal the technology, they have no way of doing it. But they can’t reject. Otherwise, it will be obvious that something fishy is going on.

As expected, the bearded guy’s face turned gloomy. But since he had already said so, it was impossible to take back his words now. In the end, he could only clench his teeth and nod. “OK! Dear Mr. Hong, you’re really formidable.”
Hong Dali grinned and replied, “When you learn to become a prodigal like me, you will be as formidable too.”

“You actually dared to look down upon the citizens from the Republic of Korea, we can also offer three million! We want the same treatment!” Seeing that the Merikans bought over the hosting rights, the Koreans instantly objected.
Hearing them say so, Hong Dali was instantly angered. “They offered four million in US dollars. You’re only offering three million, do you think that I can’t count?”
The Korean arrogantly said, “We don’t need the Holographic Projection Technology! So, we feel that our offer already shows our sincerity. Three million is enough!”
“Oh, but the problem is, I still don’t plan to sell...” Hong Dali nonchalantly shrugged his shoulders.

“This is racial discrimination, we will sue you!” The Koreans were furious upon hearing this. They wanted to reason with him, but Hong Dali stared at them with eyes like a dead fish’s, and with an emotionless face, he resolutely ordered, “Throw them out simnida.”
At this moment, there weren’t any more words that needed to be said. Instantly, three male lackeys, along with a few security guards, pulled them out...

Hong Dali concluded: “If I sell the rights to these few Oppas, wouldn’t they just announce that ‘I Am a Singer’ belongs to their country? I definitely can’t agree with that. I must not give them any chance at all simnida.”
Tang Muxin laughed till her stomach ached. She held her stomach and said, “Dali, you’re really too evil, hehe.”
Li Nianwei smiled and shook her head. This Young Master, if anyone took him for a fool, they would definitely suffer the consequences.

Everyone laughed for a while. Then, the three lackeys, along with the security guards, came back gallantly and full of vigor. They walked up to Hong Dali and saluted. “Young Master, we have completed the mission!”
“Reward! Everyone 5,000!” Hong Dali laughed loudly. Having settled these simnidas, he was in quite a good mood. “Lackeys, let’s go down to Zhong Dian website and take a look!”
“Roger that!” The lackeys instantly led the way.
Chenhui Building, level eight, Zhong Dian website headquarters.

“Welcome, Young Master!” Hearing that Hong Dali was here to inspect their work, the various staff from Zhong Dian gathered and lined up in two rows, shouting the greeting in unison. At the same time, they all put on their happiest face—the God of Fortune had come again, they would be fools if they didn’t smile!
Hong Dali was never stingy toward his own workers. “Reward! Everyone 2,000!”

Instantly, three male lackeys rushed forth. Then, a female lackey even carried a cash counting machines in her arms—Hong Dali really admired her for this idea, and therefore, the female lackey instantly received a reward of 5,000 yuan.
Thus, a group of Zhong Dian employees lined, and the cash counting machine started to count the cash. The efficiency really improved a lot, and Hong Dali expressed that he was very satisfied with it.

After all the tips were distributed, Hong Dali casually sat on the main seat. The Director of Zhong Dian, Yang Zhiqi, walked up. This time, he learned from the previous lesson and didn’t waste time with officialities. He directly reported: “Young Master, the daily IP for Zhong Dian website has reached 500,000 and is still rising. Every day, there are about 40 to 50 new authors starting on a new novel. The number of novels that were updated these past three days has increased from 500 plus to 1200. Also, the readers also expressed interest in the novels written by the five Great Gods.”

Hong Dali was quite satisfied with the progress. “Yup, not bad, not bad at all. Later, give everyone another 1,000 yuan red packet each. Also, I heard that you have increased the price for the severance fee for those five? That’s a good idea!”

“Yes, yes. That was Director Sun’s idea.” Although he was unwilling, Yang Zhiqi didn’t dare to steal Sun Wenyang’s credit. “Director Sun’s strategies are all quite useful. Young Master, do you think you should...” Saying so, he made a gesture of counting money.

Other things aside, in the future, this Sun Wenyang would definitely be one of the most popular people in Zhong Dian. If he could maintain a good relationship with him now, it would be easier to discuss things with him in the future, right?
How could Hong Dali not reward such a capable employee? “Reward! 5,000!”
Sun Wenyuang immediately rushed forth and expressed his gratitude. “From now on, I will definitely do my best to spend money as much as I can. I will definitely not let Young Master down.”
Hong Dali humphed like the eunuch who follows the emperor. “Yup, you’re quite capable. Not bad!” Then, he asked Director Yang, “Is there any more good news?”

Yang Zhiqi said, “Yes! Some companies want to buy over the TV adaptation rights for Dark Dragon of the Universe’s novel. They offered 500,000, but I thought that you might need it one day, so I didn’t dare sell it.”

Hong Dali raised his hand. “Not selling is the correct thing to do, you did well! 5,000! Oh right, there weren’t any advertisements this period, it’s much more comfortable reading novels now. You did well for this matter!”

Yang Zhiqi furiously wiped away his sweat. “Yes, yes. But, Young Master, there are already 30 plus companies wanting to advertise on our website now. The price isn’t low, either. I have already calculated before. In a month’s time, we can earn as much as one million. Do you think...” Speaking to this point, he immediately explained, “I don’t mean to say that we’re in lack of this little money. But if we don’t accept them, they will go over to Turkey Bookstore to put up their advertisements. We shouldn’t let our opponents take this opportunity to earn money, right?”

Hong Dali instantly decided without another word. “No! Don’t accept even a single one of them! I’m using the website to squander, not to earn money. As for where they put their advertisements, what that has got to do with me? Reject all of them!”

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - Nouveau Riche!
paragraphs: Oh my, such a good price. A million per month isn’t a small amount! Previously, our website was only sold for 2,400,000 yuan. Now, a month’s advertisement is worth one million, but he actually rejected it...Yang Zhiqi felt depressed. But even though this was what he thought, he didn’t dare to say it. In the end, he only helplessly said, “OK. Currently, I don’t have any more good news. Do you have any orders, Young Master...”

Hong Dali nodded and said, “Yup. Oh, speaking of which, that five are Great God-level authors now, right? It should be quite interesting meeting them. Let’s do this. Organize an end-year meeting for Zhong Dian this week. Find a good time and ask those authors with good results to attend!”

He thought for a while and added, “Those who are qualified to attend will have their expenses reimbursed. Also, we will give them Chu Zhongqin or Jiang Ruoyu’s autograph! Yup, there’s also photo-taking with them too.”
“OK, I understand!” Upon hearing Hong Dali’s suggestion, Yang Zhiqi’s eyes lit-up.

This idea of organizing a year-end meeting for authors was really good. This could not only increase the interaction between authors and editors but was also a great gimmick! Those who attended could even get this year’s most popular celebrity’s autograph and take pictures with them—this was basically a gift from the heavens!
Thinking of this, Yang Zhiqi totally kneeled down to Hong Dali. “Young Master, I’m fully impressed with your idea!”
Over the next few days, along with “I Am a Singer” andUnexpectedly!’s popularity, the entire online literature industry was in an uproar!

Speaking of which, those online bookstores that expanded to a certain extent all had annual meetings to boost the relationships between established authors and the bookstore, and also to increase interaction between them as well. There was nothing much in this actually, but along with the news released from Zhong Dian, the whole online literature industry was astonished.

The legendary secretive Young Master would be appearing on Zhong Dian’s annual meeting! They could obtain rewards from him! Although the money might not be a lot, the most important thing was the power of the Young Master himself! As long as Young Master took a liking to them, they would become the sixth Great God in the Zhong Dian website!
Truly a Great God who could earn over a million a year!
Not only that, those who attended the meeting could also obtain the autograph and take a picture with the current top celebrity!

Picture taking and autograph! They were all authors who wrote novels, how could they not be familiar with the standard methods used in their novels? A poor writer met with the current most popular celebrity due to destiny and fate, fell in love, got a promotion, became a CEO, married the celebrity, and attained the pinnacle of life. Thinking about this, wouldn’t they become agitated?
Therefore, Zhong Dian’s first annual meeting after was convened in a blaze. It was only the second day after Hong Dali’s inspection of Zhong Dian, 2:00 PM on Saturday.

When Hong Dali brought Tang Muxin, his nine lackeys, Li Nianwei, Zhang Cai, Chu Zhongqin, Jiang Ruoyu, and the rest to the venue and entered, Director Yang Zhiqi instantly shouted, “Young Master has arrived!” His voice was so high-pitched that it sounded like a eunuch’s.

“Greetings, Young Master!” Once they entered, the five Great Gods of Zhong Dian website stood in front. Front left to right were respectively: Dark Dragon of the Universe, Drunk Venom, Ultimate Sky Limit, Treasure Slayer, and Smile of the Vagrant. At their back was the other smaller gods of Zhong Dian website, and behind them was the staff of Zhong Dian website.
From this arrangement, one could tell that Yang Zhiqi did indeed spend a lot of effort.
It wasn’t difficult for the staff from Zhong Dian website to see Hong Dali. Therefore, there was no need for them to steal this opportunity from the authors.

As for these authors, being able to be the first to see Hong Dali would definitely make them touched. Once they were touched, it would be difficult for the people from other online bookstores to snatch them away—with Young Master Dali, this God of Fortune here, the authors would only join other online bookstores if their heads were kicked by a donkey.
“Oh my, hello, hello, everyone!” Once Hong Dali entered the room, he raised his right hand up high, like the head of the Nazis. “Reward! Everyone 2,000!”

Then, the various authors saw what exuberance really meant—the male lackey behind Hong Dali immediately carried forth a gigantic chest. Once it was opened, they could see 100 yuan stacks of valued cash piled inside. Then, two female lackeys each carried a cash counting machine and came up...

Swisssh—The entire lounge was filled with the sound of the cash counting machines counting money. There were at least 200 plus authors who attended the meeting—2,000 yuan per person would add up to 400,000 in total. Plus those employees, at least 500,000 were given out just like that...
“Thank you, my Lord!” The authors all kneed down, totally conquered by him.
What was called a nouveau riche? This was what a true nouveau riche was like! Just tips alone were worth 500,000. He gave it away without even batting an eye!

After finishing tipping everyone, Hong Dali laughed cheerfully and walked up and shook hands with everyone. “Oh my, you must be Dark Dragon of the Universe? Not bad, not bad, your ‘God Slayer’ was quite entertaining!”
Dark Dragon of the Universe didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. “Young... Young Master, my novel is ‘Endless Universe’...”

“It’s same, it’s same, hahaha!” Hong Dali normally didn’t remember the author of the novels that he read. Thus, he made such a mistake right at the start. Even with his thick skin, he couldn’t help but blush. “It’s quite well-written! Reward, 10,000!”
A male lackey instantly placed a stack of cash in Dark Dragon of the Universe’s hands.
Hong Dali didn’t forget to remind: “Everyone, remember. This guy is a nouveau riche! Later, remember to ask him to treat you all to a big health care1later!”
“Sure!” Everyone replied.
Tang Muxin lightly pulled on Hong Dali’s sleeve and softly asked, “Dali, what does big health care mean?”

“Big health care means...” Hong Dali’s head was full of sweat. “It refers to a high-quality health care center!” Seeing that Tang Muxin was going to ask further, Hong Dali hurriedly shook the next person’s hand. “Oh my, you must be Drunk Venom. Your novel is really well written—my favorite thing to do in class is to read your novel. It helps to lighten my spirits! Reward!”
Another 10,000 yuan.
And so, he shook five person’s hands, giving out 50,000 in total...

The other authors were all envious and jealous, but there was nothing they could do. These five author’s novels were really well-written. In just a months’ time, the bookmarks for their novels all exceeded 100,000, and the number of orders per chapter2exceeded 20,000. They were well liked by readers. The other authors really had to admit that these five people deserved this treatment.
After all the authors had shaken hands with Hong Dali, it was time for his speech.

The sound of applause erupted from below.

Author two sent over a photograph.

From this arrangement, one could tell that Yang Zhiqi did indeed spend a lot of effort.
It wasn’t difficult for the staff from Zhong Dian website to see Hong Dali.
Therefore, there was no need for them to steal this opportunity from the authors.
As for these authors, being able to be the first to see Hong Dali would definitely make them touched.

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - Some Celebrate, Some Worry
paragraphs: As the saying goes, when some people celebrated, there would be some worrying.
In just a month’s time, Zhong Dian website rose to fame, while over at Turkey Bookstore, they were having a miserable time.
Turkey Bookstore, big conference room.

Liu Mingcheng furiously slammed on the table. “All of you are useless pieces of sh*t! The originally supreme Turkey Bookstore! The Turkey Bookstore with a daily IP of 1.2 million plus! Look at all of you, in just a month, the site traffic has dropped to such a standard!? 0.6 million! Only 0.6 million is left! What about Zhong Dian website? Their daily IP has already exceeded 0.5 million and is still increasing rapidly!”
Speaking up to this point, Liu Mingcheng’s voice seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth. “Shouldn’t you guys be telling me how this happened!?”
When he asked this, the whole conference room was silent. Everyone lowered down their head and didn’t dare to say a single word.

“Zheng Wenhao!” Liu Mingcheng pointed at Director Zheng. “You name is called Wenhao1, what now, why aren’t you Wenhao anymore! You caused the daily site traffic of Turkey Bookstore to drop from 1.2 million to 0.6 million and still falling! What do you have to say!?”

Zheng Wenhao frantically tried to wipe away his cold sweat. “Young... Young Master, previously, I saw that you were in a bad mood. So, I thought that boosting our sales performance would make you happy. Just at that time, a few companies wanted to post advertisements on Zhong Dian website but were rejected and came over to us. Therefore, I thought...”

Liu Mingcheng scolded, “Thought, you thought your butt! Advertisements, is there anyone putting advertisements like you guys? I opened up the website just now and saw the whole screen full of advertisements. Not only that, even another seven to eight of them popped up. How do you expect readers to read in this kind of condition? Have all your experiences and sense went to the drain!?”

Liu Mingcheng continued to scold, “Furthermore! Where’s the money from the advertisements!? So many advertisements, but where is the money? Where has the money gone to? 4,000 per day, you f*cking only give me 4,000 a day, 120,000 a month, and you caused such a big online bookstore to be ruined just because of this!”

Speaking up to this point, Liu Mingcheng almost wanted to kick this useless person. “Did your eyes grow on your butt? You still dared to laugh at Hong Dali for being a prodigal, I think that you’re the real prodigal! He rose from almost nothing to today’s achievement in such a short time, what about you guys? Now that the site traffic is cut in half, half of the authors have also left! Originally, every three days, there were about 3,000 novels that were updated, but we’re left with only 1,600 now. And that’s because these novels are already at the finishing phase!”
“Looking again at Zhong Dian website! The number of updates every three days has reached 1,200 novels and is still rising!”

Liu Mingcheng got angrier the more he spoke. “At that time, you told me that the advertisement fees weren’t a small amount, the money already reached their doorsteps and yet, he still pushed it away, there must be something wrong with his brain. I see that you’re the idiot with something wrong in the brain!”

“Then... then what should we do?” Zheng Wenhao had totally broken down. If this carries on, he would definitely lose his position of director. He must think of a plan fast. “Young Master, I, I really wanted to earn more money to make you happy. Then, then, let’s take down the advertisements!”

“You only thought of taking down the advertisements now!?” Liu Mingcheng was indeed the second Young Master of the Liu Family. Although he couldn’t be compared to his brother Liu Mingxin, he did indeed have the capability to cut his losses. “Remove all of the advertisements and change the payout method to the same as the Zhong Dian’s! Then, I want a lot of advertisements to promote our website!”
“But.. but...” Zheng Wenhao’s whole body was drenched. “Then we will... will...” He willed for half a day before finally gathering his courage and saying, “Then we won’t have any source of income!”

Liu Mingcheng was so angry that he jumped. “Income!? You still dare to mention income to me!? Such a large Turkey Bookstore has come to this stage because of you guys, and you still dare to mention income to me!? If you guys have income, then who is going to pay for my loss!? Who is going to be responsible!?”

“This... this...” Zheng Wenhao totally couldn’t say anything now. Because of his wrong decision, the site traffic of Turkey Bookstore directly shrunk to half its original size. He couldn’t talk his way out of this situation even if his body were full of mouths. In the end, he only helplessly said, “O... OK, I understand...”
“If the site traffic couldn’t increase in two months, all of you can get out of here!” Liu Mingcheng violently slammed the door. “A bunch of useless sh*t!”

Regarding how depressed Liu Mingcheng was, Hong Dali naturally had no idea of it. In fact, he had never considered Liu Mingcheng to be his rival. After having seen his brother Liu Mingxin, Liu Mingcheng didn’t seem to be any threat no matter how he looked at it. It was just like how a rich young master who could hug a celebrity every day wouldn’t set his eyes on a prostitute.
After all, the difference in quality between them was too huge.
Therefore, at this time, Hong Dali was in Chenhui Building’s ninth floor happily doing the shooting for the second episode ofUnexpectedly!.
Still the male lackey with a slightly deep voice: “This episode is sponsored and broadcasted by Zhong Dian website—” Hong Dali: “Our aim, is the sea of stars.”
Without a doubt, once this episode was released, the site traffic of Zhong Dian website would definitely rise sharply...
During the shooting ofUnexpectedly!.

Hong Dali’s face looked foolish yet cute as he half opened his eyes and stared like a dead fish, saying, “My name is Wang Dachui, and today is the day for my interview. I will definitely get this position!” As he said so, he looked at the slightly plump male lackey beside him. That male lackey was not only eating a packed lunch, but he was also digging his nose at the same time. “This type of fat and round loser also dared to come and compete with me, he is definitely seeking his own death!”
Then, a sweet-looking female lackey immediately walked up. “Oppa it has been hard on you mwah! You must do your best for your interview later!”
“...” Hong Dali stared with his dead fish-like eyes, slighting opened his mouth, and sent the female lackey off with his eyes. “Hehe...”

“Brouhaha!” When the storyline was shot up to this point, the people around had already collapsed onto the floor in laughter. Tang Muxin grabbed her stomach and laughed. “Dali, how did you manage to think of such a scenario. Hehe, this is so funny that it’s killing me, hahaha!”
Hong Dali, who had already finished shooting, said with a calm face, “Oh, your tolerance level is really low.”
The interview started.
Another male lackey with a fearsome face: “What is your specialization?”

“This kind of attitude, is he looking down on me!? I really want to tell him loudly where I’m from!” Hong Dali crossed his hands, his expression was as if he were someone very impressive. “I’m the holder of the first-class award from the Heavenly State’s Tianjing University’s course of Finance Management!”
“Ah—!!” The male lackey kowtowed his head on the office table. “I kneel down to you!”
The scene changed.
“But what I actually said was...” Hong Dali’s face was dispirited and low. “I’m from the College of Tractor Mechanics... the course of Hand-held Tractors...”
The surrounding people collapsed in laughter again.

“Not long later, I will have a raise in salary, be promoted, become CEO, get married to a rich and beautiful woman, and reach the pinnacle of life. Just thinking about it makes me a little excited...”
Two hours later.
Hong Dali stretched his waist. “Ah, the shooting has finally finished!”
He violently puffed and weirdly looked at the people around him. “What’s up with your expressions? Is there something wrong?”

Tang Muxin laughed till she couldn’t straighten her back. “Dali, you’re too talented. You can really make a spoof. Such a simple video of an interview has become so interesting due to your ideas, hehe.” As she said so, she jumped to Hong Dali’s side and reached out her tender, small hand to pinch Hong Dali’s face. “How did you come up with it? Quick, tell me, tell me!”
“Let go, let go, the pain!” Hong Dali hurriedly escaped from Tang Muxin’s demon grasp. “A valiant life doesn’t need to be explained!”

“Cheh, pretending to be mysterious!” Tang Muxin pouted. But, after all, she was just a pure and innocent girl. Very quickly, she smiled again and asked, “Dali, you’re really evil. Turkey Bookstore’s site traffic is already low enough, and now, with this advertisement for Zhong Dian website, you’re causing them to fall even more! Why didn’t I realize that you were so clever last time?”
“How can I live if I let you see through me.” Hong Dali did a bit of warm up to exercise the muscles and bones in his body and said, “OK, I shall leave the end stage production to you, Sister Cai.”

“Young Master, don’t worry. I have already prepared everything.” Zhang Cai smiled and said, “Young Master, are you planning on going out for a walk? Let Nianwei follow you, she has nothing to do here anyway.” When she finished this sentence, she suddenly said again, “Oh right, Chu Zhongqin came to look for you just now. I don’t know what it’s for.”

Hong Dali weirdly said, “Chu Zhongqin? What could he want from me? It couldn’t be that he wants to play the hidden rules with me? Speaking of which, I’m not interested in males...” Regardless of that, Hong Dali had to admit that Chu Zhongqin did have some discerning character. Hong Dali said, “Ask him to come here first.”
Not long later, Chu Zhongqin diligently ran over. Once he saw Hong Dali, he immediately bowed and said, “Young Master, I’m here.”

“How’s your practice these two days? Your opponents are not weak, don’t expect me to cover for you every time.” He blocked the possibilities for this topic directly. If not, it wouldn’t be interesting if he used this kind of method every time in the show. “What do you want?”

Surprisingly, Chu Zhongqin didn’t mention a word about “I Am a Singer.” “Oh, it’s like this. When I was resting after finishing with practice, I looked at Weibo and happened to see that, at Tianjin’s west fourth loop, at the southwest corner, there is a private zoo that seems to be changing its business service. It plans to sell away the animals. Therefore, I was wondering, since Young Master likes to raise dogs, you must have a liking towards other animals. Such an opportunity is quite rare, so I immediately came to inform you.” When he finished, he didn’t forget to add, “Hehe, speaking of which, I’m an acquaintance of the owner of the zoo. If Young Master is interested, I can help you contact him.”

“Oh?!” Upon hearing Chu Zhongqin’s news, Hong Dali’s eyes immediately lit-up like lightbulbs. “Seriously! Awesome! Your news is too awesome! I was thinking that just raising dogs wasn’t interesting enough, hahaha! Good! Reward! 20,000!”

“Thank you, my Lord.” An experienced old guy like Chu Zhongqin wouldn’t waste such a good opportunity. He immediately said, “I have received a lot of help from you. Therefore, I should show some gratitude too. Then, shall I contact him now?”

“OK, go quickly!” Hong Dali laughed loudly. “Oh my, the animals of a private zoo going on sale, this is really not bad. Just the cost to feed them for a day should be quite a bit, right? This time, the outer area of Tianjing Mountain can be put to good use, haha.”

Upon hearing Hong Dali mention the outer area of Tianjing Mountain, Tang Muxin’s eyes lit up as well. “Dali, you’re really something! When you wanted to buy the outer area of Tianjing Mountain, I thought it was just because you wanted to squander. But now, from the looks of things, if you buy over the animals, you can build a small zoo there or something. That should be quite a good idea, at least it will reap some rewards!”
Hong Dali said, “There is no rush for rewards. After Old Chu has contacted the owner, let’s go and take a look at the animals first!”
Very quickly, Chu Zhongqin diligently ran back, smiled, and said, “Young Master, I have contacted him. The owner asked when could we go over, he will come and fetch us.”
Hong Dali liked to go to the zoo to look at animals from a young age. He definitely wouldn’t waste such an opportunity. “Is there a need to ask? We’re going now!”
