“Shouldn’t you guys be telling me how this happened!?”
When he asked this, the whole conference room was silent.
Everyone lowered down their head and didn’t dare to say a single word.
“Zheng Wenhao!” Liu Mingcheng pointed at Director Zheng.
“You name is called Wenhao1, what now, why aren’t you Wenhao anymore!
You caused the daily site traffic of Turkey Bookstore to drop from 1.2 million to 0.6 million and still falling!
What do you have to say!?”
Zheng Wenhao frantically tried to wipe away his cold sweat.
“Young...
Young Master, previously, I saw that you were in a bad mood.
So, I thought that boosting our sales performance would make you happy.
Just at that time, a few companies wanted to post advertisements on Zhong Dian website but were rejected and came over to us.
Therefore, I thought...”
Liu Mingcheng scolded, “Thought, you thought your butt!
Advertisements, is there anyone putting advertisements like you guys?
I opened up the website just now and saw the whole screen full of advertisements.
Not only that, even another seven to eight of them popped up.
How do you expect readers to read in this kind of condition?
Have all your experiences and sense went to the drain!?”
Liu Mingcheng continued to scold, “Furthermore!
Where’s the money from the advertisements!?
So many advertisements, but where is the money?
Where has the money gone to?
4,000 per day, you f*cking only give me 4,000 a day, 120,000 a month, and you caused such a big online bookstore to be ruined just because of this!”
Speaking up to this point, Liu Mingcheng almost wanted to kick this useless person.
“Did your eyes grow on your butt?
You still dared to laugh at Hong Dali for being a prodigal, I think that you’re the real prodigal!
He rose from almost nothing to today’s achievement in such a short time, what about you guys?
Now that the site traffic is cut in half, half of the authors have also left!
Originally, every three days, there were about 3,000 novels that were updated, but we’re left with only 1,600 now.
And that’s because these novels are already at the finishing phase!”
“Looking again at Zhong Dian website!
The number of updates every three days has reached 1,200 novels and is still rising!”
Liu Mingcheng got angrier the more he spoke.

“At that time, you told me that the advertisement fees weren’t a small amount, the money already reached their doorsteps and yet, he still pushed it away, there must be something wrong with his brain.
I see that you’re the idiot with something wrong in the brain!”
“Then... then what should we do?” Zheng Wenhao had totally broken down.
If this carries on, he would definitely lose his position of director.
He must think of a plan fast.
“Young Master, I, I really wanted to earn more money to make you happy.
Then, then, let’s take down the advertisements!”
“You only thought of taking down the advertisements now!?” Liu Mingcheng was indeed the second Young Master of the Liu Family.
Although he couldn’t be compared to his brother Liu Mingxin, he did indeed have the capability to cut his losses.
“Remove all of the advertisements and change the payout method to the same as the Zhong Dian’s!
Then, I want a lot of advertisements to promote our website!”
“But.. but...” Zheng Wenhao’s whole body was drenched.
“Then we will... will...” He willed for half a day before finally gathering his courage and saying, “Then we won’t have any source of income!”
Liu Mingcheng was so angry that he jumped.
“Income!?
You still dare to mention income to me!?
Such a large Turkey Bookstore has come to this stage because of you guys, and you still dare to mention income to me!?
If you guys have income, then who is going to pay for my loss!?
Who is going to be responsible!?”
“This... this...” Zheng Wenhao totally couldn’t say anything now.
Because of his wrong decision, the site traffic of Turkey Bookstore directly shrunk to half its original size.
He couldn’t talk his way out of this situation even if his body were full of mouths.
In the end, he only helplessly said, “O...
OK, I understand...”
“If the site traffic couldn’t increase in two months, all of you can get out of here!” Liu Mingcheng violently slammed the door.
“A bunch of useless sh*t!”
Regarding how depressed Liu Mingcheng was, Hong Dali naturally had no idea of it.
In fact, he had never considered Liu Mingcheng to be his rival.
After having seen his brother Liu Mingxin, Liu Mingcheng didn’t seem to be any threat no matter how he looked at it.
It was just like how a rich young master who could hug a celebrity every day wouldn’t set his eyes on a prostitute.
After all, the difference in quality between them was too huge.
Therefore, at this time, Hong Dali was in Chenhui Building’s ninth floor happily doing the shooting for the second episode ofUnexpectedly!.
Still the male lackey with a slightly deep voice: “This episode is sponsored and broadcasted by Zhong Dian website—” Hong Dali: “Our aim, is the sea of stars.”
Without a doubt, once this episode was released, the site traffic of Zhong Dian website would definitely rise sharply...
During the shooting ofUnexpectedly!.
Hong Dali’s face looked foolish yet cute as he half opened his eyes and stared like a dead fish, saying, “My name is Wang Dachui, and today is the day for my interview.
I will definitely get this position!” As he said so, he looked at the slightly plump male lackey beside him.
That male lackey was not only eating a packed lunch, but he was also digging his nose at the same time.
“This type of fat and round loser also dared to come and compete with me, he is definitely seeking his own death!”
Then, a sweet-looking female lackey immediately walked up.
“Oppa it has been hard on you mwah!
You must do your best for your interview later!”
“...” Hong Dali stared with his dead fish-like eyes, slighting opened his mouth, and sent the female lackey off with his eyes.
“Hehe...”
“Brouhaha!” When the storyline was shot up to this point, the people around had already collapsed onto the floor in laughter.
Tang Muxin grabbed her stomach and laughed.
“Dali, how did you manage to think of such a scenario.
Hehe, this is so funny that it’s killing me, hahaha!”
Hong Dali, who had already finished shooting, said with a calm face, “Oh, your tolerance level is really low.”
The interview started.
Another male lackey with a fearsome face: “What is your specialization?”
“This kind of attitude, is he looking down on me!?
I really want to tell him loudly where I’m from!” Hong Dali crossed his hands, his expression was as if he were someone very impressive.
“I’m the holder of the first-class award from the Heavenly State’s Tianjing University’s course of Finance Management!”
“Ah—!!” The male lackey kowtowed his head on the office table.
“I kneel down to you!”
The scene changed.
“But what I actually said was...” Hong Dali’s face was dispirited and low.
“I’m from the College of Tractor Mechanics... the course of Hand-held Tractors...”
The surrounding people collapsed in laughter again.
“Not long later, I will have a raise in salary, be promoted, become CEO, get married to a rich and beautiful woman, and reach the pinnacle of life.
Just thinking about it makes me a little excited...”
Two hours later.
Hong Dali stretched his waist.
“Ah, the shooting has finally finished!”
He violently puffed and weirdly looked at the people around him.
“What’s up with your expressions?
Is there something wrong?”
Tang Muxin laughed till she couldn’t straighten her back.
“Dali, you’re too talented.
You can really make a spoof.

Such a simple video of an interview has become so interesting due to your ideas, hehe.” As she said so, she jumped to Hong Dali’s side and reached out her tender, small hand to pinch Hong Dali’s face.
“How did you come up with it?
Quick, tell me, tell me!”
“Let go, let go, the pain!” Hong Dali hurriedly escaped from Tang Muxin’s demon grasp.
“A valiant life doesn’t need to be explained!”
“Cheh, pretending to be mysterious!” Tang Muxin pouted.
But, after all, she was just a pure and innocent girl.
Very quickly, she smiled again and asked, “Dali, you’re really evil.
Turkey Bookstore’s site traffic is already low enough, and now, with this advertisement for Zhong Dian website, you’re causing them to fall even more!
Why didn’t I realize that you were so clever last time?”
“How can I live if I let you see through me.” Hong Dali did a bit of warm up to exercise the muscles and bones in his body and said, “OK, I shall leave the end stage production to you, Sister Cai.”
“Young Master, don’t worry.
I have already prepared everything.” Zhang Cai smiled and said, “Young Master, are you planning on going out for a walk?
Let Nianwei follow you, she has nothing to do here anyway.” When she finished this sentence, she suddenly said again, “Oh right, Chu Zhongqin came to look for you just now.
I don’t know what it’s for.”
Hong Dali weirdly said, “Chu Zhongqin?
What could he want from me?
It couldn’t be that he wants to play the hidden rules with me?
Speaking of which, I’m not interested in males...” Regardless of that, Hong Dali had to admit that Chu Zhongqin did have some discerning character.
Hong Dali said, “Ask him to come here first.”
Not long later, Chu Zhongqin diligently ran over.
Once he saw Hong Dali, he immediately bowed and said, “Young Master, I’m here.”
“How’s your practice these two days?
Your opponents are not weak, don’t expect me to cover for you every time.” He blocked the possibilities for this topic directly.
If not, it wouldn’t be interesting if he used this kind of method every time in the show.
“What do you want?”
Surprisingly, Chu Zhongqin didn’t mention a word about “I Am a Singer.” “Oh, it’s like this.

When I was resting after finishing with practice, I looked at Weibo and happened to see that, at Tianjin’s west fourth loop, at the southwest corner, there is a private zoo that seems to be changing its business service.
It plans to sell away the animals.
Therefore, I was wondering, since Young Master likes to raise dogs, you must have a liking towards other animals.
Such an opportunity is quite rare, so I immediately came to inform you.” When he finished, he didn’t forget to add, “Hehe, speaking of which, I’m an acquaintance of the owner of the zoo.
If Young Master is interested, I can help you contact him.”
“Oh?!” Upon hearing Chu Zhongqin’s news, Hong Dali’s eyes immediately lit-up like lightbulbs.
“Seriously!
Awesome!
Your news is too awesome!
I was thinking that just raising dogs wasn’t interesting enough, hahaha!
Good!
Reward!
“Thank you, my Lord.” An experienced old guy like Chu Zhongqin wouldn’t waste such a good opportunity.
He immediately said, “I have received a lot of help from you.
Therefore, I should show some gratitude too.
Then, shall I contact him now?”
“OK, go quickly!” Hong Dali laughed loudly.
“Oh my, the animals of a private zoo going on sale, this is really not bad.
Just the cost to feed them for a day should be quite a bit, right?
This time, the outer area of Tianjing Mountain can be put to good use, haha.”
Upon hearing Hong Dali mention the outer area of Tianjing Mountain, Tang Muxin’s eyes lit up as well.
“Dali, you’re really something!
When you wanted to buy the outer area of Tianjing Mountain, I thought it was just because you wanted to squander.
But now, from the looks of things, if you buy over the animals, you can build a small zoo there or something.
That should be quite a good idea, at least it will reap some rewards!”
Hong Dali said, “There is no rush for rewards.
After Old Chu has contacted the owner, let’s go and take a look at the animals first!”
Very quickly, Chu Zhongqin diligently ran back, smiled, and said, “Young Master, I have contacted him.
The owner asked when could we go over, he will come and fetch us.”
Hong Dali liked to go to the zoo to look at animals from a young age.
He definitely wouldn’t waste such an opportunity.
“Is there a need to ask?
We’re going now!”

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - Donald Duck
paragraphs: Chu Zhongqin’s mood now was quite good.

This was but just a piece of small news, and getting a tip from the Young Master was just a small matter, the important thing was that he made Young Master happy. Next time, he would definitely get back a huge reward. What kind of person was Hong Dali? The type that could give out hundreds of thousands of money in tips—a God of Fortune. He definitely wouldn’t lose anything from following such a person.

As for playing around with Hong Dali in such a mad way even though he was already at such an old age, Chu Zhongqin never considered that to be a problem—Young Master definitely was the reincarnation of the God of Fortune. Thinking of it this way, Hong Dali would even be a few thousand years older than him!
Just as Chu Zhongqin was secretly feeling happy for himself, Hong Dali grinned and asked, “Is your friend reliable? Why did he suddenly quit? What was the problem?”
Tang Muxin said “A private zoom, just the land should be worth quite a bit of money, right? Why did he quit?”

“Reliable, he’s definitely reliable!” Chu Zhongqin slowly said, “Actually, regarding this friend of mine, his family is quite well to do, and he also likes animals. Therefore, he invested in this zoo. Honestly speaking, I didn’t expect him to sell away the animals too. But he didn’t explain in detail over the phone just now. I thought that since we will be going over anyway, there was no need to ask the details.”

Hong Dali looked at the scenery fly past from outside the window, nodded and said, “Yup, we can ask him when we reach there. Actually, I’m more interested in those animals.” As he said so, his face was full of excitement. He asked, “Is there tigers, lions, pandas and such?”
If he were able to lead a tiger out onto the streets, that would definitely be an incredible scene!

Chu Zhongqin considered for a while and said, “I haven’t gone there for a long time, so I’m not sure. But given the scale of his zoo, there should be some rare species inside. If not, there wouldn’t be much visitors there since long ago.”
Hong Dali laughed loudly. “Haha, that’s true. Very good, very good.”
Soon after, the car slowed down to a stop. The driver, Wang Mingyu, turned around and said, “Young Master, we have arrived.”

As the group majestically got down from the car, a middle-aged uncle of about 50 years old hurriedly walked up to welcome them. Once he saw Hong Dali, he greeted, “Young Master, you have arrived. Please come in!” This uncle was quite plump, wearing a suit where his stomach protruded out and showed the belt. Hong Dali was sure that this guy couldn’t even see his the tip of his own feet!
Hong Dali was pleased with him calling him Young Master and decisively rewarded him. “Yup, reward! 10,000! How may I address you?”

The uncle bowed and said, “My name is Tang Ya. Young Master, you may call me Tang Sanzang1or Donald Duck2. It’s my honor for Young Master to take time from your busy schedule to visit. Oh my, speaking of which, I have heard of Young Master since long ago but never had the opportunity to meet you in person. Now that I have seen you today, you are indeed a dragon amongst man. Extraordinary, extraordinary indeed! Hahaha!”
The nine lackeys behind Hong Dali almost had a facial nerve paralysis from hearing him talk—this dude’s bootlicking skills were at the ultimate level! They must learn from him in the future!
Hong Dali followed him in. “You mouth can really speak. Anyways, Donald Duck, are you planning on selling all of the animals?”

“Sigh, it’s a long story.” Tang Ya brought them inside a conference room and invited him to sit in the main seat. He sat at one side, shook his head and said, “I didn’t want to sell them either. I have loved animals since I was young. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have opened this zoo. Seeing stray dogs going hungry, I would rather eat less myself to buy food for them. Then, after some trading, I made a small fortune and bought a piece of land to build a zoo, which is here.”
His words were quite sincere, Hong Dali somewhat felt that he was similar to himself. He nodded and said, “Indeed, animals are man’s best friend. Then, why are you selling them now?”

Tang Ya laughed bitterly, took out a map, and said, “I have no choice. Young Master, take a look. This is the map of our Tianjing City. In the past few years, just in the area in the west fourth loop alone, there are already three new parks opened. A normal man such as myself obviously can’t fight against these state-owned parks. Actually, at the start, my ticket price was cheap. Therefore, the visitor volume was still acceptable. I could earn about a million or so per year. Although it wasn’t much, it was enough for a living. But now, people would rather spend more money to crowd around in those big parks. After all, it’s much more fun there, there’s stuff to see and play. Unlike here, there are only animals to see. They only need to walk one round, and that’s it. So naturally, people don’t like to come here anymore.”
When he finished speaking, Hong Dali fully understood the situation.

Plainly speaking, he only had a single service here which was the animals. The size was also not big enough, visitors only had to walk one round, and that was it. At most, they could only take some pictures as a memorial. Combined with the impact of those big parks, Tang Ya naturally didn’t have a good time.

“Then, Donald Duck, how are the species of the animals? What kind of animals do you have here?” In the end, Hong Dali still had to take a look at the species of the animals before deciding. If there were not a lot of species and were only left with common animals, he would still buy them and just treat it as doing charity. But, his attitude wouldn’t be as good as now—he was a person who earned tens of thousands every minute, he didn’t have time to waste here.

Speaking of animals, Tang Ya’s words flowed out non-stop. “The species are quite complete here. From tigers and lions to monkeys and orangutans, then to eagles, cinereous vulture, peacocks, and pheasants, there are quite a lot. If it weren’t because my zoo did indeed have quite a lot of animals and because the ticket is also cheap, I would have gone bankrupt a long time ago. Young Master, don’t you agree?”
Hearing that there was even tigers and lions, Hong Dali’s eyes lit up. “Yup, not bad, not bad! There’s even tigers and lions!?”

Tang Ya said, “Yes, there are! Speaking of which, it was because my luck was quite good!” Mentioning this, Tang Ya’s face was full of pride. “I opened this zoo quite long ago. At that time, tigers weren’t as rare as they are now. The country wasn’t strict in its control. When they heard that I wanted to invest, the related authorities even gave me a certificate of the cultivation of animals. They granted me the right to privately raise large-sized animals such as tigers and lions.” As he spoke, he hurriedly took out a few certificates from his office bag. “Young Master, take a look. This is the credential to raise tigers, this one is for the lions, this one for the elephants, and oh, there’s also this one. This one is the most valuable, the credential to raise pandas!”

“You even have the credential to raise pandas!? Tang Muxin was astonished. She grabbed Hong Dali’s elbow and violently shook it. “Dali, can you let me raise a panda!? Then, it can fight with my Xiao Xiaobai!”
Hong Dali: “OK! Then, do you have pandas here!?”
Pandas! They were pudgy, cute and adorable, weren’t they! The most important thing was, there was even the credential to raise them!

In his previous life, Hong Dali wasn’t sure of this type of stuff. But here, with this credential, he definitely could raise them himself! Once he thought about a pudgy panda crawling around in his bedroom at home, his saliva almost drooled out!

Unfortunately, Tang Ya regretfully shook his head. “It’s a pity to say that I don’t have any here. Pandas are too rare. Even with the credential, it’s difficult to find pandas that are willing to be raised by humans.”
Tang Muxin: “That’s such a pity... if only there were pandas here.”

“What you said does make sense...” Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “Never mind, there’s no rush. If the opportunity comes, I will inquire on that.” As he spoke, he stood up and said, “OK, let’s go take a look at the animals. Oh my, hearing you speak about them already makes me a bit anxious to see them, haha!”
Tang Ya hurriedly got up. “OK! I shall bring you to see them now. Young Master, this way please.”

They left the conference room with Tang Ya taking the lead. As he walked, he introduced the place to Hong Dali. “I bought this piece of land when I decided to build the zoo. If it weren’t for this, my zoo would have been torn down and relocated ages ago. Now, there’s a total of 60 plus different types of animals here. In total, there are about 500 plus animals.”

As they talked, they came to a huge grass patch with a few puppies rolling around on the ground. Tang Ya said, “These puppies are very good tempered. You can touch and hug them as much as you like. Kids love them.”

Then, they continued to walk. A few steps later, they reached the goldfish aquarium. Beautiful goldfishes were swimming around in twos and threes in the tank—a lot of them Hong Dali couldn’t even put a name on. But this didn’t affect their viewing of them. Hong Dali looked and said, “Not bad, we can just bring this back home. Dad and Mum will definitely like it!”

After the goldfish aquarium, it was the bird park. They walked and looked at the same time. In just two to three minutes, Hong Dali had already seen peacocks, parrots, and other beautiful birds. He even saw two one-meter talk eagles, their eyes coldly looking at the group of people. When they saw Hong Dali looking at them, they violently spread their wings. When they opened, the wingspan was as long as two meters and more—it was almost horrifying.
“Haha, good, good fellow!” Hong Dali laughed loudly, expressing his satisfaction.
They continued to walk forward. In front was the area for pets.

This was a world of dogs. There were not just those that Hong Dali had brought before. Although the zoo didn’t seem really big, the species of dogs were quite complete. There were Dachshunds, Sheepdogs, Great Pyrenees, Dalmatians, and so on. One of the Great Pyrenees was the most obedient. It let Hong Dali touch it and didn’t make any noise, just sleeping there. When it got comfortable from the touch, it even turned over and revealed its stomach, causing Tang Muxin to gurgle.
There were also some other types of small animals such as coypus, cats, and so on. All of them were very adorable.
One extremely adorable white cat immediately swayed over when it saw Hong Dali walk towards them, meowing out to him.

Tang Ya hurriedly introduced. “This is a Scottish Fold. This small cat was born this year on January 18th. It’s only four months old now. It was quite timid and gluttonous, but I wonder what is wrong with it today. It actually didn’t get scared when it saw you, this is really surprising.”

“Dali, can you let me raise a panda!?
Then, it can fight with my Xiao Xiaobai!”
Hong Dali: “OK!
Then, do you have pandas here!?”
Pandas!
They were pudgy, cute and adorable, weren’t they!
The most important thing was, there was even the credential to raise them!
In his previous life, Hong Dali wasn’t sure of this type of stuff.
But here, with this credential, he definitely could raise them himself!
Once he thought about a pudgy panda crawling around in his bedroom at home, his saliva almost drooled out!
Unfortunately, Tang Ya regretfully shook his head.
“It’s a pity to say that I don’t have any here.
Pandas are too rare.
Even with the credential, it’s difficult to find pandas that are willing to be raised by humans.”
Tang Muxin: “That’s such a pity... if only there were pandas here.”
“What you said does make sense...” Hong Dali touched his chin and said, “Never mind, there’s no rush.
If the opportunity comes, I will inquire on that.” As he spoke, he stood up and said, “OK, let’s go take a look at the animals.
Oh my, hearing you speak about them already makes me a bit anxious to see them, haha!”
Tang Ya hurriedly got up.
“OK!
I shall bring you to see them now.
Young Master, this way please.”
They left the conference room with Tang Ya taking the lead.
As he walked, he introduced the place to Hong Dali.
“I bought this piece of land when I decided to build the zoo.
If it weren’t for this, my zoo would have been torn down and relocated ages ago.
Now, there’s a total of 60 plus different types of animals here.
In total, there are about 500 plus animals.”
As they talked, they came to a huge grass patch with a few puppies rolling around on the ground.
Tang Ya said, “These puppies are very good tempered.
You can touch and hug them as much as you like.
Kids love them.”
Then, they continued to walk.
A few steps later, they reached the goldfish aquarium.
Beautiful goldfishes were swimming around in twos and threes in the tank—a lot of them Hong Dali couldn’t even put a name on.
But this didn’t affect their viewing of them.
Hong Dali looked and said, “Not bad, we can just bring this back home.
Dad and Mum will definitely like it!”
After the goldfish aquarium, it was the bird park.
They walked and looked at the same time.
In just two to three minutes, Hong Dali had already seen peacocks, parrots, and other beautiful birds.
He even saw two one-meter talk eagles, their eyes coldly looking at the group of people.
When they saw Hong Dali looking at them, they violently spread their wings.
When they opened, the wingspan was as long as two meters and more—it was almost horrifying.
“Haha, good, good fellow!” Hong Dali laughed loudly, expressing his satisfaction.
They continued to walk forward.
In front was the area for pets.
This was a world of dogs.
There were not just those that Hong Dali had brought before.
Although the zoo didn’t seem really big, the species of dogs were quite complete.
There were Dachshunds, Sheepdogs, Great Pyrenees, Dalmatians, and so on.
One of the Great Pyrenees was the most obedient.
It let Hong Dali touch it and didn’t make any noise, just sleeping there.
When it got comfortable from the touch, it even turned over and revealed its stomach, causing Tang Muxin to gurgle.
There were also some other types of small animals such as coypus, cats, and so on.
All of them were very adorable.
One extremely adorable white cat immediately swayed over when it saw Hong Dali walk towards them, meowing out to him.
Tang Ya hurriedly introduced.
“This is a Scottish Fold.
This small cat was born this year on January 18th.
It’s only four months old now.
It was quite timid and gluttonous, but I wonder what is wrong with it today.
It actually didn’t get scared when it saw you, this is really surprising.”

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - The Corn of Capricorn
paragraphs: “Hehe, this little fellow is quite fun, is it a Capricorn?” This little white cat was quite cute, the more Hong Dali looked at it, the more Hong Dali liked it. He laughed and stretched out a finger towards it. “Do you like me?”
This little white Scottish Fold heard Hong Dali’s words and actually stretched out its small claw with a pink pad and lay it on Hong Dali’s finger. Then, it meowed again.
“Hahaha, this is really fun.” As Hong Dali looked around and saw some corn bits not far, probably to feed the animals, he directly gave the cat a name. “From now on, your name is Corn, hehe.”
“Meow~~” The little white cat meowed again, seemingly satisfied.
“Wait here first, OK. I will come back for you after I finished with the tour.” After comforting the little cat, Corn, Hong Dali snapped his fingers and said, “Let’s continue looking around!”
Besides the pet park were the lions and tigers’ park.

One had to say, even though the zoo was almost going bankrupt, Tang Ya still managed it quite well. It was quite clean, and from the looks of their color, the food for those lions and tigers was not bad either.

The tigers and lions were leisurely strolling around in the room covered by a glass panel, not afraid of strangers at all. A tiger even swaggered towards Hong Dali and scratched its back on the platform at the side.

“Haha, Donald Duck. Looks like you are really liked by the animals.” Hong Dali couldn’t help but want to touch its beautiful fur but was stopped by the glass panel. But very quickly after, Hong Dali stared at one direction as if he had discovered a new continent. “A tiger cub! There’s actually a tiger cub here!”

Following his gaze, indeed, there was a small cub about two to three months old in the corner of the room. It was laying on the ground drinking milk. Tang Ya hurriedly said, “I casually gave this tiger cub the name Tigre. It actually had another three brothers, but they were bought by a circus just as they were born. Now there’s only one left, my heart aches so much.”

“What a stupid name, it don’t sound nice at all.” He immodestly changed its name. “I shall give it a name!” He touched his chin, thought for a while, and soon, his eyes lit up. He remembered a funny French movie that he watched in his previous life called “Ruby & Quentin.” One of the male leads was very interesting. He slapped his thigh and decided. “He shall be called Quentin from now on! Brouhaha!”
“What a dumb name...” Tang Muxin covered her face. “Even Tigre sounds better...”

“Hehe, my name is Quentin, and I’m from Montargis, this shall do!” Hong Dali laughed loudly and said, “Next time, I shall bring it out with me and go shopping. Oh my, with Quentin leading the way in front, I can feel how domineering that will be by just thinking about it!”

They walked and talked at the same time. After leaving the tigers and lions park, they reached the bear mountain. A charmingly naive black bear sat at the bottom, foolishly staring at Hong Dali and group. There were also some lazily lying on the ground yawning.

The last interesting place was the monkey mountain. There were at least ten plus monkeys in it running all over the place. One of the most interesting ones had a very long tail. They frequently used their friend’s tail as a swing, causing Tang Muxin to giggle.

The most frightening was the black orangutan. Hong Dali never thought that an orangutan could be so big, it was like a small mountain. When it saw so many people looking at itself, its only reaction was to lazily dig at its nose.
Hong Dali couldn’t help but praise. “Speaking of which, Donald Duck, your animals here are quite complete. It’s really surprising that a private zoo like yours could actually obtain so many animals.”

Donald Duck laughed and said, “Hehe, I just happened to meet with the good times. When this place was just being developed, raising animals was still quite simple. Over these ten plus years, precious animals are getting lesser and lesser. No matter how wonderful they are, it’s hard to adopt them. Coupled with the impact of those state-owned parks and that I’m not willing to let these animals go hungry, I could only find some kind-hearted wealthy person to take over them.”

Tang Ya’s words were very sincere, Hong Dali didn’t doubt his intentions at all—such a big bunch of animals, all of their fur were shining. Just one look, and he knew that their food supplies must be quite good.

After they were done talking, Tang Ya brought Hong Dali and his group back to the conference room. Once they were seated, he continued, “Sigh, speaking of which, I know that it wouldn’t be easy to find someone to take over them. After all, there are too many. It should be fine if there were just a few species, some rich person might be willing to buy them home to look at them when they have nothing to do. But with so many animals here, things are more difficult. They can’t open a zoo and also can’t place them at home. Furthermore, if I only sell the more valuable ones, the remaining would probably die from hunger. After all, few people are willing to let them return to the wild—that would be akin to doing charity. That’s not easy.”
One has to admit, Tang Ya was stating the facts and not trying to lure Hong Dali into buying them first.

This number of animals, 600 plus of them with all kinds of sizes, once the valuable ones were sold, no one would buy the remaining ones. Yet, Tang Ya didn’t have the financial means to continue feeding them. Therefore, he would be only left with two options at that time. One was to release them back to the wild, the other was to wait till they died from hunger.

These animals were used to staying in the zoo, their ability to hunt for food was practically gone. If they were released back to the wild, the result would be that most of them would still die from hunger.

Tang Ya helplessly shook his head. “I’m worried, really worried. Therefore, when I heard that Mr. Chu was following Young Master recently, relying on the fact that I had seen him once before, I could only request of him to help me introduce you to me. I hope that Young Master won’t blame him.”
Chu Zhongqin, who was standing at the side, was slightly embarrassed. “Young Master, this matter, I really didn’t have a choice...”

“Yup, it’s fine. Next time, don’t go roundabouts, just tell me directly if you have something to say.” Hong Dali wasn’t concerned over this matter at all. He only asked, “The question is, these animals, if I buy them, where should I place them? Even if I start building a place now, it will also need time, right?”

“This matter...” Tang Ya thought for a while. This wasn’t a small problem. If there wasn’t a place for them to stay, it was impossible to buy them. It was not like they could just all be placed in a cage, right? In the end, Tang Ya clenched his teeth and said, “I still have about two months of preparation time before I have to start changing the business here. In these two months, if Young Master is OK with it, you can still let them stay here. There are breeders available here, anyway. After two months, your place should probably be ready. Then, we can just directly move them there.”

Lastly, he didn’t forget to add, “If Young Master doesn’t mind, at that time, you can directly bring back the breeders with you. You only need to change the contract a bit. Their pay is 1,200 yuan a month, and you only have to provide for their lunch.”

OK, now even the breeders were also prepared, this saved Hong Dali much trouble. He directly said, “Then, it’s settled. As for the animals, how much will it cost to buy all of them? You should be aware that a buyer like me is hard to find.”

“I’m aware, I’m aware!” Hearing that Hong Dali had agreed, Tang Ya was delighted. This Young Master was a well-known prodigal, he had never gone back on his words before. He instantly took out a report form, passed it over, and said, “The specific accounts are all here. I have placed the price according to the lowest in the current market. We’re all animal lovers, I definitely won’t take advantage of you, Young Master.”
Hong Dali definitely wouldn’t be willing to read this kind of form. He directly tossed it to Ling Xiaoyi. “Xiaoyi, help me take a look.”

Ling Xiaoyi took over the form and meticulously looked through it. She nodded and said, “Young Master, according to my estimation, the total price should be about 2.7 million. The price he asked for is very reasonable.”

“Then, that’s fine.” Hong Dali directly decided. “I will give you three million yuan. 2.7 million is yours, 0.3 million is for the food expenses for the animals. If the money is not enough, you pay for it first. Then, next time just count everything together.”
Tang Ya hurriedly took out the contract. “OK! Young Master is indeed straightforward! Young Master, you just have to sign here.”
“Can do.” Hong Dali crookedly wrote his name on the contract. Just as he handed it over to Tang Ya, aDingsound violently sounded in his mind. Hong Dali took a look and was immediately astonished.

[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Help the pitiful small animals. Current Progress: 588/1000. Mission Reward: The title “Animals’ Best Friend.” Title Effect: The host will not be attacked by any big animals as long as the host does not attack them first. Title Level: Junior. Additional explanation: This mission does not have to be completed. Once the System finishes upgrading, it will be erased.]
The previously unknown mission requirement was shown now. As Hong Dali had expected, it was to help pitiful animals.

Of course, this wasn’t the reason for his surprise. The real surprise was that his actions today of squandering over these animals out of this love for them actually brought the progress to 588/1000! More than half! How awesome was that!
Now, both of the Side Missions had been half completed. The other Side Mission, Nature’s Little Prodigal, the Mission Progress was also more than half, at 532/1000.
Hong Dali sighed in his heart.Oh my, when one’s luck comes, it can’t be blocked even if I tried...
But once he thought of this, Hong Dali was totally astonished...
Because he suddenly realized something. The words in the System almost caused him to faint—

Current attribute points from squandering: 36 points. Host’s attributes: Strength: 36. Speed: 95. Reflexes: 92. Health: 100. Sexual capability: 100. The current number of attribute points left before the host reaches maximum stats is 41 points.
What the heck!
I totally forgot about this because I was beside myself with joy!
This means that the System will upgrade if I just squander another 4.1 million!

It isn’t important that the System will upgrade, but if I don’t complete the Side Missions before then, they will be erased! Erased means that they will never appear again! This can’t do, this definitely can’t do!

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - Quentin
paragraphs: Hong Dali’s head was full of sweat. He hurriedly asked Ling Xiaoyi, “Xiaoyi, how much of the trash at the outer area of Tianjing Mountain hasn’t been cleared? Can the process go faster?”

Ling Xiaoyi took out a notebook from her pocket and said, “Young Master, they already cleared half of it. The area is too big, and a lot of trash hanging on trees need workers to climb up to remove them. It’s slightly troublesome.”

“Oh, I don’t care anymore.” Hong Dali fiercely said, “Continue to send more people, this matter is very urgent for me...” He almost mentioned the System by accident but quickly changed his words. “The animals can’t wait too long...”
“OK, I understand.” Ling Xiaoyi hurriedly replied.

Hong Dali continued to give orders. “Also! Xiaoyi, immediately go and find some men to bring me all the stray dogs and cats and raise them! I want as many of them as there is! Oh right, I want the live ones!” Now that he was certain what the Mission needed, he had to start work immediately.
There was only 4.1 million left, time waited for no one!
Luckily, finding stray dogs and cats shouldn’t require a lot of money. Otherwise, Hong Dali would really cry.

Tang Muxin’s mouth opened so wide that it formed an “O” shape. “Dali! Why are you taking in so many stay dogs and cats for!? Don’t tell me you’re going to use them to feed the tigers and lions? Snacks!?” When she finished, she felt that Hong Dali wasn’t this kind of person and said, “No, that’s not right. You aren’t this kind of cruel person.”

“Of course, I’m not this kind of person.” Hong Dali rolled his eyes. He said in a very natural way, “How can I waste such a good opportunity to squander? Furthermore, don’t you think that those stray dogs and cats are pitiful?”

“That’s true.” Tang Muxin agreed with him. “I can’t stop you from squandering, anyway. You can have it your way. Having a loving heart isn’t a bad thing, at least you still have some brain when squandering, hehe.”
Hong Dali said in disdain, “What do you mean by having some brain? I have lots of brains!”

In the next two days, in the whole Tianjing City suddenly appeared a large group of people who went around searching for stray dogs and cats. They asked everyone and anyone they saw for information on where to find them. Later, people started to warmly name them the “Clan of Dog and Cat Searchers,” causing Hong Dali to become quite speechless.
Regardless of how speechless he was, he was lying on his classroom table now, continuously looking at the System’s screen—
[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Helping the pitiful animals. Current Progress: 757/1000.]
[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Helping the pitiful animals. Current Progress: 938/1000.]
[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Requirement: Helping the pitiful animals. Current Progress: 1142/1000.]
The progress of the Mission would change every hour.
[Current Progress: 1353/1000...]
[Current Progress: 1579/1000...]
In the end, when the value stopped changing for an entire three hours, aDingsound finally came from the System.

[Side Mission 1: The Caring Little Prodigal. Mission Status: Completed. Current Progress: 1885/1000. Mission Reward: The title “Animals’ Best Friend.” Title Effect: The host will not be attacked by any big animals as long as the host does not attack them first. Title Level: Junior.]
After this announcement, there was even an additional explanation—
[Degree of Mission Completion: Perfect.

Additional Explanation 1: The host rescued animals that needed help because he truly liked them, not just to complete the mission. Additional Reward: Title Effect is enhanced, and the Title Level has the possibility of being increased.

Additional Explanation 2: This title is a secret title. The host does not need to wear it, it will come into effect once the mission is completed. If the host does not attack, any type of animal will not attack the host. At the same time, if the level of adoration of the host increases towards any type of animal, the animal will not actively show hostility towards other humans when the animal is with the host.]
Seeing these two additional explanations, Hong Dali laughed till his mouth couldn’t even close.
What an awesome reward!
This means that I can have an eagle standing on my shoulder, hold a tiger in my hand, and go out on the streets, doesn’t it? Damn, just thinking about it already makes me feel excited!
I reckon there isn’t any prodigal and hedonist in the history of mankind that can be as flamboyant as me!

“Let’s go out!” Now that he had already obtained the Title, there was nothing more to hesitate about. He decisively walked out of the classroom to find Quentin and walk him. “Teacher, I’m applying for leave to go out and do something!”
Teacher: “Ah, OK. Walk slower, don’ tire yourself.”
“Yup, I know.”Look at that, when I apply for leave to go out the teacher even has to show concern for me. This just shows how formidable I am!
After exiting the school, the nine lackeys instantly appeared. “Young Master!”
“To the zoo, let’s go!” Hong Dali laughed loudly and directly boarded the car. “It was too boring today for me to stay on. Let’s go bring out that small tiger cub and go walk around!”
The driver almost choked to death from his own saliva. “Young Master, that’s a tiger. Even if it’s just a cub now, there is also wildness in it. If you get bitten...”
Hong Dali was calm. “Nothing will happen, don’t worry. It’s only a few months old. Oh right, buy some lamb and beef on the way. It should be hungry by now, right?”
Tang Ya’s zoo.

“Young Master, you really intend to bring back Quentin as a pet to raise?” Tang Ya’s face was full of cold sweat. This was a tiger—it might be fine when it was still small, but it grew very fast. If it bit Hong Dali in the next half a year to a year, he could only run and hide overseas.
“Don’t worry, I will be fine, hehe.” Hong Dali didn’t explain why he was so sure that he would be fine. It was easier to just go over instead of explaining to them. “Faster, lead the way!”
“O... OK...” Tang Ya’s sweat rushed out.
But since Young Master had already made his request, he definitely didn’t dare to reject him. He could only hope that nothing would go wrong.

After reaching the tigers’ park, Tang Ya asked the breeder to go and bring the cub out. A short while later, a small ball of fluff was placed in front of Hong Dali. “Young Master, it’s here. Please be careful, never leave it by your side when you’re asleep. Otherwise, it may bite you.”

The breeder wasn’t saying that for no reason. Animals like tigers would not do anything dangerous when its owner played with it awake. But once the owner slept, there was no telling what it would do. The breeders had interacted with these animals for a long time. Even so, they still had to be very careful around animals such as tigers and lions.
“Don’t worry.” Hong Dali squatted down, stretched out a finger, and softly touched Quentin, the tiger cub. “Quentin, come and let me kiss you!”
Weirdly enough, under everyone’s astonished gazes, Quentin actually rolled on the floor and revealed its fluffy stomach to him. It even rubbed itself against Hong Dali’s finger!

“Hahaha! Good boy!” Hong Dali was greatly delighted. Animals such as tigers were ferocious in nature, and even a newly born cub that was just a few months old would also show hostility to others not of its own kind. But now, it actually reacted so friendly towards Hong Dali. Without a doubt, the effect of the title “Animals’ Best Friend” was outstanding!

“Let’s go, I’m bringing you out for a walk!” Hong Dali didn’t forget to remind Tang Ya. “Oh right, bring me that small cat, Corn, as well. Since they’re both felids, I might as well walk them together!”
Tang Ya’s sweat rushed out. “How is this and that the same?”

Hong Dali carried up Quentin and held it in his arms. As he walked, he laughed and said, “Hahaha, from now on, I’m your owner. Come, let me kiss you!” Saying so, he reached forward with his mouth.
As everyone around him was scared to the point their heart almost jumped out from their throats, Quentin actually reached out with its small head and licked Hong Dali!

“Hahaha! Good boy!” Hong Dali was very proud of himself. “From now on, I’m your boss. You must listen to me, do you hear? If I ask you to go east, you cannot go west. If I ask you to catch dogs, you cannot chase chickens! If someone wants to hit me, then you must go bite him!”
Quentin’s only response was to make some noise.
ROARRR—!!!
There was a saying that a tiger’s roar could shake an entire forest. Tang Muxin didn’t know if it could shake the city, but when she saw Hong Dali carrying Quentin in his arms, she was truly shaken.
“Dali!” Tang Muxin screamed, rushed up, and wanted to carry Quentin away. “Are you asking for death, what if it bites you? Quick, pass it to me. I will send it back!”

Speaking of which, although girls liked small and fluffy animals, tigers obviously weren’t one of them—at least, there was a difference between carrying it in their own hands and watching it from afar. But when Tang Muxin saw Hong Dali carrying Quentin, her first natural reaction was to rush up and separate them. This caused Hong Dali to feel really strange.
“You aren’t afraid of tigers?” Hong Dali was puzzled. “I remember that when we went to the zoo, you didn’t dare to stand too near them.”
“You’re asking the obvious. How can I not be scared?” Tang Muxin sniffled her tiny, cute nose. “But I’m even more afraid that it will bite you!”
“You’re so concerned for me?” Hong Dali was dazed.

Tang Muxin’s face went red and softly said, “That’s... that’s for sure! After all, I’m your fiancée in name, OK?” She didn’t continue to say out the last part, but Hong Dali could sense it. She didn’t seem to dislike him as much as when they just met anymore.
Hong Dali grinned and said, “Actually, it’s really nothing. Quentin, come, let’s kiss!”
Quentin resolutely licked Hong Dali.

“It... it can understand your words!?” Tang Muxin was stunned again. This time, she didn’t try to snatch Quentin away. Instead, she carefully reached out for it. “Then, can you ask it to kiss me too? It was so cute just now!”

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - Lin Zixuan
paragraphs: This was practically an advantage that was sent to his doorstep. Hong Dali decisively commanded, “Kiss your future sister-in-law!”
Then, Quentin licked Tang Muxin.
Seeing how obedient Quentin was, Tang Muxin wasn’t scared anymore. She grinned and said, “So itchy! Dali, can you let me hug him for a while? He seems really docile, not at all troublesome.”
“Sure.” Hong Dali placed Quentin in Tang Muxin’s arms. “You can carry him for a while. I’m tired, anyway.”
Once Quentin landed in her arms, he moved here and there, causing Tang Muxin to giggle. Just at this time, Hong Dali suddenly shouted, “The big villain is here. Quick, hide!”
Then, Quentin buried his head into Tang Muxin’s chest, causing her face to blush. “You big villain! Both of you are big villains! This silly thing is taking advantage of me!”
Hong Dali sniffled and said, “It’s a she. I checked. So it’s not counted as taking advantage of you, right...”
Ptui![1. The sound of spitting]
Today, the whole of the west fourth loop was alarmed.
“Mummy, look. There’s a little tiger there!” A little girl of about four years old pointed at Quentin who was walking beside Hong Dali’s leg. “It’s so adorable, it really is a tiger!”
“That... that is...” Mummy’s head was full of sweat. “That can’t be a real tiger, can it...”
Quentin looked at their direction, panted loudly, and continued its walk, full of valiance and vigor.
“It really is a tiger—AHHH!!!” Mummy was almost shocked to death. She quickly grabbed her child and carried her away. “Quick, let’s get out of here. Be careful, it will eat you!”

“It wouldn’t do that. Mummy, look, a small white kitty is lying on top of that tiger’s head. How cute!” The little girl acted like she discovered a new continent, struggling to get down. “Mummy, I want to go and look at them, please?”

“Well...” The tiger’s head did have a kitty lying on top of it, it shouldn’t be so fearsome then...” OK, I will go and ask them if we can take a picture. You stay here first. But be careful, it may bite you.”
“Yup, OK.” The little girl nodded her head obediently.
Mummy carefully approached Hong Dali and asked him from two meters away, “This... this Young Master. My, my child would like to see your small tiger cub, is that... is that OK?”

This proved the saying that a mother’s love was the most mighty and courageous in the Universe. In normal times, facing Hong Dali, who was obviously a hedonist, normal people would definitely stay as far away from him as possible. But now, to fulfill her child’s wish, she gathered her entire courage.

Luckily, although Hong Dali’s aspiration was to be the greatest prodigal in this world, his moral quality was still not bad. “Oh, sure. If she wants to take a look, then let her come. But remember, she needs to be gentle.”
Hearing Hong Dali’s approval, Mummy let out a long breath. She turned around and waved to her child. “Baby, come here. Come see the tiger cub!”

“OK!” The little girl diligently ran over to Hong Dali’s side. Then, she squatted down and, bit by bit, moved towards Quentin. After a while, she finally stepped in front of it. The little girl cocked her head and looked at Quentin, hesitated for a while, and gradually reached out with her small hand and carefully touched the fur on Quentin’s back.

Speaking of which, because o Hong Dali’s “Animas’ Best Friend” Title Effect, Quentin was more docile than the most docile dog. She actually closed her eyes and rubbed her head against the little girl’s tender, small hand.

Giggle.“Mummy, she’s so obedient!” The little girl was so happy that she kept laughing. Mummy saw that she was happy and felt that this was a rare chance, so she quickly took out her phone and took this classic and heartwarming picture.
Tang Muxin secretly pulled on Hong Dali’s sleeve. “Dali, Quentin is really docile. How did you do it?”

If it were someone else answering this question, it would be difficult for them to reply. But for Hong Dali, it was just a piece of cake. “This fellow also wants to be a prodigal. Yup, a tiger prodigal. This is what is known as getting influenced by what you interact with...”
Tang Muxin: “...”

Very quickly, their activities attracted many other small children nearby. Seeing that there was a small and cute tiger here that allowed people to touch it and wouldn’t get angry, they all begged their parents to let them go too. In just a short moment, Hong Dali and his group were surrounded by a lot of people.
Luckily, this was his territory. These people frequently saw him walking the dogs around, and therefore, didn’t ask for his autograph and picture taking for their children...
Basically, everyone’s attention was captured by the lovable tiger cub, Quentin.
Momentarily, the snapping sounds of picture taking didn’t stop at all.

Since he didn’t have anything to do anyway, Hong Dali decided to share his job with other people! At this time, Hong Dali felt quite satisfied. He felt like an emperor who was inspecting his land and people in disguise—he had to admit, this was quite a good feeling.

Just as the people were taking pictures with Quentin, Hong Dali suddenly saw a little girl in the distance. She popped out from a corner, looking at the crowd. She was about 13 to 14 years old, her face black from dirt, hiding her original complexion. She looked frightened. When she saw Hong Dali looking at her, she immediately pulled back in fear and lowered her head.

“What’s up with this girl?” Hong Dali curiously looked again. As expected, after that little girl pulled back and hid, she secretly popped out again after a while. She looked at Quentin, who was surrounded by children, her face full of longing.

“Hm? She wants to look at Quentin too but doesn’t dare to come?” Since he was a hedonist, he should act like one too. Hong Dali didn’t waste any words and immediately ordered one of the male lackeys, “Go and bring that child over here.”
“No problem!” The male lackey was indeed a professional. He used a speed worthy of a 100-meter race challenge and brought back the girl in just ten seconds... or maybe eight seconds.

When she was in front of him, Hong Dali carefully sized her up. Although there was a lot of dirt on the child’s face, her eyes were pitch black and spirited. She obviously didn’t look like an ordinary young beggar.
“What’s your name?” Hong Dali sniffled. “Why didn’t you dare to come over?”

“My... my name is Lin Zixuan...” The little girl said in a crisp voice. When she spoke, her two rows of bright and shiny, white teeth could be faintly seen, totally not fitting with her outside appearance.
Having said her name, Lin Zixuan wriggled her finger, softly saying, “Big Brother, I, I don’t have any money. Can, can you let me go, please?”

When she said that, Hong Dali was instantly amused. “It’s not like I’m going to snatch your money, what are you afraid of? Speaking of which, how did you get yourself so dirty? Where are your parents? Why didn’t they take care of you? Let me send you home, OK?”

“I... I don’t want to go home...” Lin Zixuan’s eyes rolled about, and suddenly, her lips flattened, her pair of spirited eyes filled with tears. “My father sold me to a rich family to be their child bride. I secretly ran off halfway, and I’m not sure where I can go now. I haven’t had a full meal in days...”
Such a small Lolita ran away from home and ended up in the Imperial Capital, Tianjing?
What an amazing journey. Hong Dali asked, “Then, how did you come here? Can you tell me? If you tell me, I will buy for you big buns and soup.”

“Really?” Lin Zixuan seemed unable to believe her ears. But once she thought about how Hong Dali could even bring a tiger out on the streets, he probably wouldn’t go back on his words. Instantly, she softly said, “I, I secretly hid in a chest in the storage compartment of a big bus. I was very sleepy and fell asleep. When I woke up, I was already here...”
Hid in a chest that was in the storage compartment of a big bus, and arrived here once she woke up?

By right, people who still do child brides shouldn’t be anywhere around the Imperial Capital, right? Even if she slept through the journey, she should have slept for at most ten hours or so—that shouldn’t be enough for her to get here based on the traveling time...
Just as he was puzzled, a small bus zipped past. Lin Zixuan pointed at the logo on the bus and said, “The bus had that logo as well.”
Hong Dali looked at it and instantly understood—Hurricane Express Delivery...
Fine, so this little lass treated herself as a package and mailed herself here...

Although she spoke of it simply, Hong Dali wasn’t silly—he really never heard of anyone mailing themselves as a package before. But from the current looks of things, this little lass definitely experienced some huge obstacles, that was for sure. Whatever the case, the proper thing to do now was to bring her over to have a meal first then think of a way to secretly investigate her background. Hong Dali’s background was quite unique, so he had to be careful that this might be a plot from someone targeting at him or his family.
Therefore, Hong Dali resolutely asked the lackeys to disperse the crowd and went to a nearby eatery.

Actually, with Hong Dali’s current status, he would definitely not eat at such a small place. But his reason was quite simple: After having starved for a long time, it wasn’t good for the stomach to eat something too oily. Therefore, she needed buns and plain vegetables to adjust her body first. Then, after another two days or so, he would let her eat something better.

After entering the small eatery, the lackeys naturally did everything. At the same time, Hong Dali secretly instructed one of the male lackeys to go around the vicinity to inquire on Lin Zixuan’s background. His identity was unique, so he had to ensure his safety.

As for Lin Zixuan, she was wolfing down her food. The male lackey came back very quickly. He came to Hong Dali’s side and softly said, “This little girl has been loitering around this area for quite long, about half a month. Quite a lot of people has given her food before, but it’s unclear where exactly she’s from.”
Half a month, that was when I had only just arrived in this world.

If using the time to calculate, this little lass shouldn’t be sent here as an undercover—after all, if she had already started preparing from that time, such an opportunity to meet Hong Dali and interact with him now was unlikely.

After wolfing down the two buns and bowl of plain vegetable soup that Hong Dali bought for her, Lin Zixuan blissfully rubbed her stomach. “I’m full. Big Brother, thank you!” As she said so, she stood up to leave. But Hong Dali pulled her back and said, “Why are you in such a rush to leave?”

When Hong Dali finished saying this, Lin Zixuan, whose face was full of blissfulness, instantly teared up. “Big Brother, why are you still not letting me leave? You... are you going to... to bully me?”

After a while, she finally stepped in front of it.
The little girl cocked her head and looked at Quentin, hesitated for a while, and gradually reached out with her small hand and carefully touched the fur on Quentin’s back.
Speaking of which, because o Hong Dali’s “Animas’ Best Friend” Title Effect, Quentin was more docile than the most docile dog.
She actually closed her eyes and rubbed her head against the little girl’s tender, small hand.
Giggle.“Mummy, she’s so obedient!” The little girl was so happy that she kept laughing.
Mummy saw that she was happy and felt that this was a rare chance, so she quickly took out her phone and took this classic and heartwarming picture.
Tang Muxin secretly pulled on Hong Dali’s sleeve.
“Dali, Quentin is really docile.
How did you do it?”
If it were someone else answering this question, it would be difficult for them to reply.
But for Hong Dali, it was just a piece of cake.
“This fellow also wants to be a prodigal.
Yup, a tiger prodigal.
This is what is known as getting influenced by what you interact with...”
Tang Muxin: “...”
Very quickly, their activities attracted many other small children nearby.
Seeing that there was a small and cute tiger here that allowed people to touch it and wouldn’t get angry, they all begged their parents to let them go too.
In just a short moment, Hong Dali and his group were surrounded by a lot of people.
Luckily, this was his territory.
These people frequently saw him walking the dogs around, and therefore, didn’t ask for his autograph and picture taking for their children...
Basically, everyone’s attention was captured by the lovable tiger cub, Quentin.
Momentarily, the snapping sounds of picture taking didn’t stop at all.
Since he didn’t have anything to do anyway, Hong Dali decided to share his job with other people!
At this time, Hong Dali felt quite satisfied.
He felt like an emperor who was inspecting his land and people in disguise—he had to admit, this was quite a good feeling.
Just as the people were taking pictures with Quentin, Hong Dali suddenly saw a little girl in the distance.
She popped out from a corner, looking at the crowd.
She was about 13 to 14 years old, her face black from dirt, hiding her original complexion.
She looked frightened.
When she saw Hong Dali looking at her, she immediately pulled back in fear and lowered her head.
“What’s up with this girl?” Hong Dali curiously looked again.
As expected, after that little girl pulled back and hid, she secretly popped out again after a while.
She looked at Quentin, who was surrounded by children, her face full of longing.
“Hm?
She wants to look at Quentin too but doesn’t dare to come?” Since he was a hedonist, he should act like one too.
Hong Dali didn’t waste any words and immediately ordered one of the male lackeys, “Go and bring that child over here.”
“No problem!” The male lackey was indeed a professional.
He used a speed worthy of a 100-meter race challenge and brought back the girl in just ten seconds... or maybe eight seconds.
When she was in front of him, Hong Dali carefully sized her up.
Although there was a lot of dirt on the child’s face, her eyes were pitch black and spirited.
She obviously didn’t look like an ordinary young beggar.
“What’s your name?” Hong Dali sniffled.
“Why didn’t you dare to come over?”
“My... my name is Lin Zixuan...” The little girl said in a crisp voice.
When she spoke, her two rows of bright and shiny, white teeth could be faintly seen, totally not fitting with her outside appearance.
Having said her name, Lin Zixuan wriggled her finger, softly saying, “Big Brother, I, I don’t have any money.
Can, can you let me go, please?”
When she said that, Hong Dali was instantly amused.
“It’s not like I’m going to snatch your money, what are you afraid of?
Speaking of which, how did you get yourself so dirty?
Where are your parents?
Why didn’t they take care of you?
Let me send you home, OK?”
I don’t want to go home...” Lin Zixuan’s eyes rolled about, and suddenly, her lips flattened, her pair of spirited eyes filled with tears.
“My father sold me to a rich family to be their child bride.
I secretly ran off halfway, and I’m not sure where I can go now.
I haven’t had a full meal in days...”
Such a small Lolita ran away from home and ended up in the Imperial Capital, Tianjing?
What an amazing journey.
Hong Dali asked, “Then, how did you come here?
Can you tell me?
If you tell me, I will buy for you big buns and soup.”
“Really?” Lin Zixuan seemed unable to believe her ears.
But once she thought about how Hong Dali could even bring a tiger out on the streets, he probably wouldn’t go back on his words.
Instantly, she softly said, “I, I secretly hid in a chest in the storage compartment of a big bus.
I was very sleepy and fell asleep.
When I woke up, I was already here...”
Hid in a chest that was in the storage compartment of a big bus, and arrived here once she woke up?
By right, people who still do child brides shouldn’t be anywhere around the Imperial Capital, right?
Even if she slept through the journey, she should have slept for at most ten hours or so—that shouldn’t be enough for her to get here based on the traveling time...
Just as he was puzzled, a small bus zipped past.
Lin Zixuan pointed at the logo on the bus and said, “The bus had that logo as well.”
Hong Dali looked at it and instantly understood—Hurricane Express Delivery...
Fine, so this little lass treated herself as a package and mailed herself here...
Although she spoke of it simply, Hong Dali wasn’t silly—he really never heard of anyone mailing themselves as a package before.
But from the current looks of things, this little lass definitely experienced some huge obstacles, that was for sure.
Whatever the case, the proper thing to do now was to bring her over to have a meal first then think of a way to secretly investigate her background.
Hong Dali’s background was quite unique, so he had to be careful that this might be a plot from someone targeting at him or his family.
Therefore, Hong Dali resolutely asked the lackeys to disperse the crowd and went to a nearby eatery.
Actually, with Hong Dali’s current status, he would definitely not eat at such a small place.
But his reason was quite simple: After having starved for a long time, it wasn’t good for the stomach to eat something too oily.
Therefore, she needed buns and plain vegetables to adjust her body first.
Then, after another two days or so, he would let her eat something better.
After entering the small eatery, the lackeys naturally did everything.
At the same time, Hong Dali secretly instructed one of the male lackeys to go around the vicinity to inquire on Lin Zixuan’s background.
His identity was unique, so he had to ensure his safety.
As for Lin Zixuan, she was wolfing down her food.
The male lackey came back very quickly.
He came to Hong Dali’s side and softly said, “This little girl has been loitering around this area for quite long, about half a month.
Quite a lot of people has given her food before, but it’s unclear where exactly she’s from.”
Half a month, that was when I had only just arrived in this world.

If using the time to calculate, this little lass shouldn’t be sent here as an undercover—after all, if she had already started preparing from that time, such an opportunity to meet Hong Dali and interact with him now was unlikely.
After wolfing down the two buns and bowl of plain vegetable soup that Hong Dali bought for her, Lin Zixuan blissfully rubbed her stomach.
“I’m full.
Big Brother, thank you!” As she said so, she stood up to leave.
But Hong Dali pulled her back and said, “Why are you in such a rush to leave?”
When Hong Dali finished saying this, Lin Zixuan, whose face was full of blissfulness, instantly teared up.
“Big Brother, why are you still not letting me leave?
You... are you going to... to bully me?”
